description:
Our bikes are our transport, our recreation, our toys, and Knog has found a sneaky way to help protect them. The Scout is the sleek little alarm and Bluetooth tracking unit that mounts to your bike’s water bottle mount - or under your water bottle cage. You arm the Scout via a small side mounted button, through the app, or when your Apple device, running the free iOS app, walks away from your bike. Once armed, the motion sensitive device sounds a piercing siren and sends you an alert, if someone other than you, moves your bike. Should your bike be stolen, the Knog app will track your bike’s location, so you can get it back.

  • Tracking is done via Apple’s Find My network, triangulating your bike’s location via the Scout’s Bluetooth™ connection pinging off of other Apple devices
  • Only works with iOS devices
  • Motion sensor gives a warning beep for little movements, if your bike keeps moving, the Scout sounds the alarm and lets you know via an app notification
  • Armed via an onboard button, with the app, or through proximity to an iPhone running the free app
  • Includes a high visibility cover, should you want to advertise your security system
  • Battery lasts for 6 months and takes only 4 hours to recharge (via USB-C)
  • LEDs let you know battery and alarm status
  • IP66 weather protection means the scout isn’t bother by rainstorms or dust storms
  • Includes tamper resistant screws for mounting the Scout on its own and not under a water bottle cage
  • Updatable firmware keeps your alarm up to date and reliable

description:
For the first time ever, Garmin’s most accessible full-feature Forerunner is ready to help you train for your first triathlon. Multi-sport mode was previously reserved for the top tier Forerunners, but now the 255 can take you through a swim, bike, and run training session all within a single workout file. Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate optical heart rate monitor, the 255 reads your pulse straight off your wrist, no need for a chest strap. Running metrics like speed and distance information are handled by the onboard GPS and internal accelerometers. These sensors all work together, turning your movement into data, making sure you get credit for all you do, in the gym, the pool and on the trails. The 255 can even give your training a soundtrack, with the ability to connect to multiple music services and storage for up to 500 songs. Having your phone on hand and connected via the free Garmin Connect app, opens a world of smartwatch functionality. Garmin Connect lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport – transition between activities within a single workout at the press of a button, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym focused activities (strength training – with rep counter, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, indoor rowing and yoga) and more
  • Stream music through a paired smartphone using Spotify, iHeartRadio, Pandora or Deezer. Or, download playlists and podcasts via your favourite music service, e.g. Spotify (premium account required), you can even drag and drop MP3s from your computer – holds up to 500 songs (depending on sound quality)
  • A powerful, internal antenna connects to 3 different satellite constellations, GPS, GLONASS and Galileo. Multiple networks, combined with satellite position caching, give you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal wherever you are
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (through a connected smartphone) allows you to share your location and heart rate with friends, family, or coaches
  • Race widget helps make race day a little less stressful, providing course specific performance info, weather and more
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and even provides a personalized daily workout suggestion
  • UltraTrac™ mode allows you to stay in the field longer, reducing the GPS recording rate in order to conserve battery
  • Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides reliable constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max – which now takes ambient temperature into consideration, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Training status uses data from past workouts to learn your fitness level and tell you how effective your training is
  • Acute load compares the intensity of recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter

description:
Whether you’re learning to run, or you need a little extra motivation that upcoming 5K, this watch will help you find your stride. Tucked under the Forerunner 55’s clean lines is the technology to help you train smarter. Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate optical heart rate monitor, pulse data comes straight off your wrist. While running metrics like speed and distance are handled by the onboard GPS and internal accelerometers. These sensors all work together, turning your movement into data, so you get credit for everything, from a YouTube™ yoga session, to time in the gym, or even taking the stairs at the office. Learn how to get the most out of your training with a personalized recovery advisor and Body Battery mode. Having your phone on hand and connected via the free Connect® app, opens the world of smartwatch functionality. Connect lets you review and share activities, download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and receive texts, social media alerts and email.

  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, swimming (indoor only), gym focused activities (HIIT, Pilates, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, and yoga) and more
  • A powerful, internal antenna connects to 3 different satellite constellations, GPS, GLONASS and Galileo. Multiple networks, combined with satellite position caching, give you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal wherever you are
  • LiveTrack™, share your location and fitness data during activities (through a phone)
  • V3 low-profile Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides more reliable constant heart rate data and allows you to train without a chest strap
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, an improved race predictor and recovery advisor
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Garmin Coach provides free, personalized training plans that you can download through Garmin Connect. Train for your first 5k, improve on your next 10k, or just learn to train more efficiently
  • PacePro™, set your desired pace, then compare it to your distance splits, the Forerunner 55 compares your needed pace vs your goal pace for each split and for the course
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Fitness age takes your activity level, heart rate and BMI into account to let you know if you are performance matches your age
  • Intuitive widgets display what you need to know at a glance
  • Incident detection uses sensors to detect accidents. In the case of an accident a message and your location will be sent through your paired phone to your emergency contacts
  • If you feel unsafe, assistance mode sends out a LiveTrack link letting your contacts know where you are
  • Stress level score monitors heart rate variability while inactive to produce a stress score from 0-100, the lower the score, the lower your stress. When stress levels are high, a short breathing exercise will help lower stress levels
  • Breathwork mode guides you through mindful breathing exercises, helping you with results, from relax and focus, to coherence and more
  • Respiration tracking keeps an eye on your breaths per minute both while asleep and awake, providing nightly, daily and weekly averages
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learns your activity level and helps guide you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, letting you see your total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep in your Connect profile
  • Menstrual tracking logs physical and emotional symptoms to aid training and nutrition during phases of your cycle
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) come in via Bluetooth® connection to your phone

description:
This bundle pairs the Edge 840 with 3 powerful sensors to help you get the most out of your training. Sensors track speed, heart rate and cadence on the go or during training. On-road or off-road, this little touchscreen GPS gets you where you want to go and tells you everything about how you got there. Building on GPS technology from the Fenix line, the latest Edge computers give you access to more satellites and more signals than ever before. These updates give you a stronger GPS connection anywhere you ride, from forests, to valleys of glass and steel. Free detailed maps provide turn-by-turn directions to addresses and points of interest, so if there is gelato close by, you’ll find it. Garmin has incorporated their popularity routing into the latest map set, letting you ride the local’s favourite roads and trails, anywhere you go. Pre-loaded with TrailForks, you get access to incredible trail maps right on your Edge. Real-time Strava segment integration displays nearby segments, showing how you compare to your PR and the current KOM or QOM. When connected to your phone via the free Garmin Connect app, you can receive notifications, download training plans, review activities, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • Touchscreen plus an intuitive button layout for quick and easy navigation
  • Updated bike type specific mapping uses Garmin Connect’s database of rider’s routes and tracks, finding you the most popular way to get where you’re going, on road or off
  • Free global maps, with North America on the device and more regions downloadable for free from Garmin Express™, providing turn-by-turn routing
  • Address and point of interest navigation lets you search for places like restaurants, attractions, hospitals, accommodation, and more; the unit will even re-route you if you get off course
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite caching gives you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your ride, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, remaining ascent, and displays an elevation profile (no course required)
  • Power specific features like targeted coaching: how you’re performing on that ride and at that moment, on-the-fly recommended power targets, and cycling ability information that highlights strengths and weaknesses. Note – these features require a not included power meter
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TrailForks™ integration for access to TrailForks trail database without a cell connection
  • Strava Segment integration (requires premium) preloaded or on-the-fly via your phone, shows starred segments and results
  • Live Tracking during activities (via phone) allows you to share your location, speed, course and more, with friends, family, or coaches
  • Training plan takes you through the details of your ride: weather conditions, food and water requirements based on your fitness levels – with reminders when you should drink and eat, and more
  • Environmental factors like heat and altitude acclimation are taken into consideration when calculating performance and recovery metrics
  • Training status and daily suggested workouts help you optimize your training, guiding you where you need to push and where you may need to dial it back
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max estimate, lactate threshold, race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • HRM-Dual, and Speed and Cadence sensors use both Bluetooth™ and ANT+™ communication
  • HRM-Dual soft chest strap is comfortable and accurate, adding another layer of precision to your training data
  • Speed sensor tracks rides without phone or bike computer and synchs when in range
  • Sensors are easy to install, maintain and move between bikes
  • Speed Sensor attaches to a standard hub on either wheel and self-calibrates for accurate speed and distance while stationary (on a trainer) or on the move
  • Cadence Sensor fastens to any crank arm size and measures pedal strokes per minute
  • Bike alarm mode sounds a loud, shrill, attention getting alarm if your bike is touched
  • Incident detection uses accelerometers to detect accident and uses you phone to send a signal to predefined emergency contacts
  • inReach® compatibility, connect to an inReach for messaging and SOS support when off the grid
  • Simplified user interface puts less in between you and that first ride
  • Free Garmin Connect app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 26 hours in with full GPS and sensor support, or up to 42 in battery saver mode

description:
Get a clear view of where you’re going, on the trail and on your fitness journey. By learning some of the best features from Garmin’s fēnix and Forerunner line, and tossing in a few new ones, the epix has evolved. One of the epix Pro’s new features tackles the challenge of balancing GPS power and battery life. By matching your GPS signal to your terrain, SatIQ optimizes your runtime; flat land gets a low power signal, head into the mountains and your signal is boosted. The onboard multiband GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While the optical heart rate monitor and other sensors pay attention to how you train. When your favourite runs feel too easy, Hill score shows you why, breaking down the evolution of your running power and endurance. On those days you want to train but don’t have a workout in mind, the morning report is there. Each morning you get a summary of sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and a personalized daily workout. When you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through the free Garmin Connect app. And, classic smartwatch features help you stay connected, stream music, receive notifications, track the weather and more.

  • AMOLED screen is easy to read in any light, with deep blacks and vibrant colours
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym activities, skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations guide you through proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • SatIQ™ matches your current environment with the right GPS mode, optimizing battery life
  • Free downloadable routable TopoActive maps
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (via a phone) allows you to share your location and metrics
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the epix Pro will use tracks from other Garmin users to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Hill score displays your running strength and endurance, tracking your progress over time
  • Endurance score analyzes training data to map improvements to your overall endurance
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and provides a personalized daily workout
  • Training readiness, training status, and training load modes use data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Acute load compares recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Running dynamics info provides running power, cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor for constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor, real-time stamina tracking, and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) is a great tool to predict recovery and training response
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food)
  • Incident detection: in the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Stream music via a paired phone using Spotify, Deezer, or Amazon Music. Or, download playlists and podcasts, you can even drag and drop MP3s
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, providing total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep
  • Automatically sync your data to the free Garmin Connect app
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Flashlight with white and red light
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 15 hours with multi-band GPS, 42 hours with standard GPS, or up to 16 days in smartwatch mode

description:
Updated with an improved GPS and a few tricks taken from the fēnix line, this is an Instinct you can trust. With the Instinct 2 Solar Garmin has brought a multi-GNSS GPS and more activity profiles to their rugged Instinct line. By speaking to more satellites, you get a faster, more accurate signal in challenging conditions. GPS data is used both in navigation and in sport modes, getting you where you need to go and providing real-time speed and distance data along the way. An upgraded solar panel converts solar energy more efficiently than ever, offering potentially infinite battery life. Equipped with the latest Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor you get pulse information straight off your wrist, so there's no need to wear a chest strap. Sport profiles add custom metrics to how you train, letting you train smarter and evolve faster. When paired with the free Garmin Connect™ app on your phone, you can review activities, set up live tracking sessions, track real-time weather forecasts, receive notifications, control apps and much more.

  • Power Glass™ solar panel lets you go longer between charges, from 18 hours longer, to potentially never needing to charge your watch again – runtime is feature dependent
  • Sun gauge displays solar charge and daily sun exposure
  • Multi-GNSS signal reception supports: GPS, GLONASS, and Galileo satellite constellations, providing a faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite caching saves satellite data, for fast, accurate satellite signal in any terrain
  • Tilt compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you are stationary, ensuring that you are always facing the right direction
  • Barometric altimeter tracks ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Storm alarm tracks pressure changes and alerts you when it’s time to find shelter. Extended weather data can also come in via the connection to your phone
  • Power manager uses pre-set and custom power profiles to balance battery life and GPS accuracy
  • Garmin Pay™, make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)
  • Built-in activity modes for hiking, biking, running, strength training (with rep counter), walking, swimming, golf, yoga, climbing and more
  • Pre-loaded and customizable workouts, you can even race past activities
  • Move IQ detects and tracks activity; it appears in your Connect timeline to credit all your daily exercise
  • Mountain biking dynamics distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TracBack mode navigates you safely back to where you started
  • Course navigation, via created or downloaded courses
  • Breadcrumb trails track your trek, navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing)
  • LiveTrack™, share your location and fitness data during activities (through a phone)

  • Physiological data: VO2 max, performance indicator and recovery advisor that takes altitude and temperature into consideration
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Fitness age takes your activity level, heart rate and BMI into account to let you know if you are performance matches your age
  • 24/7 activity tracking, Instinct 2 learns your activity level and helps guide you towards a more active lifestyle
  • Sleep tracking and sleep score mode monitors rest, periods of movement, deep and light REM sleep stages and scores them in a glanceable widget

description:
Chase your next PR in style. Equipped with a bright and colourful AMOLED touchscreen display, the Forerunner 265 makes your fitness journey look better than ever. In a first for the 200-series Forerunners, the 265 provides running dynamics, including running power, right from your wrist. Heart rate data also comes off your wrist, care of Garmin’s Elevate optical sensor. The onboard multi-band GPS provides information on your speed and distance. And, all these sensors work together, turning your movement into data, giving you get credit for all you do, in the gym, the pool and on the trail. The 265 helps you start your day right, with a personalized morning report. This report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, and training effects, it even offers a daily workout suggestion. Between your morning report and the training readiness feature, the 265 helps you make the most of your training, guiding you away from overtraining or under training. Having the right soundtrack can make the difference between a regular training session, or one that leaves you smiling. When paired with your phone, your Forerunner can stream tunes to your Bluetooth headphones. And if you want to leave your phone on the sidelines… or at home, you can store up to 1000 songs right on your watch. When your phone is connected, a world of smartwatch functionality opens up. Garmin’s Connect app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • S-series’ smaller case is more comfortable and offers a more accurate heart rate signal on smaller wrists
  • AMOLED colour touchscreen has deep blacks and vibrant colours making it crisp, clear, and easy to read in any light
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport – transition between activities within a single workout at the press of a button, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym focused activities (strength training – with rep counter, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, indoor rowing and yoga) and more
  • Stream music through a paired phone using Spotify, iHeartRadio, Pandora or Deezer. Or, download playlists and podcasts via your favourite music service, e.g. Spotify premium, you can even drag and drop MP3s from your computer – holds up to 1000 songs (depending on sound quality)
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite position caching, give you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (through a connected phone) allows you to share your location and heart rate with friends, family, or coaches
  • Race widget helps make race day a little less stressful, providing course specific performance info, weather and more
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and even provides a personalized daily workout suggestion
  • Training readiness and training load modes uses data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Running dynamics info right off your wrist, providing running power, cadence, ground contact time, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides reliable constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max – which takes ambient temperature into consideration, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Training status uses data from past workouts to learn your fitness level and tell you how effective your training is
  • Acute load compares the intensity of recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Incident detection uses the internal sensors to detect if an accident has occurred. In the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your paired phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, letting you see your total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep in Connect
  • Automatically sync your data to a paired phone running the free Garmin Connect app
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) come in via Bluetooth connection to your phone
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields, watch faces, and other features
  • Internal memory stores up to hundreds of hours of activities. Garmin Connect will store all of your activity data

description:
Get out and explore. Wherever your 2-wheeled adventures take you, the Edge Explore 2 will keep you on track, and tell you all about how you got there. Paired with Garmin’s Power Mount, this bundle lets you tap into the power of your e-bike. Updated with an intuitive touch-based interface and preloaded with free maps, route planning for your next ride, or next tour, is nice and simple. Should you take a wrong turn, or a curiosity fueled detour, the Explore 2 will navigate you back to your route. Detailed mapping and routing on your Edge means you get to save your phone’s battery for pictures, and finding that next great eatery. When connected to your phone via the free Garmin Connect™ app, the Trendline™ feature will show you the most popular routes, anywhere Garmin users ride. Connect also lets you use your favourite fitness apps, receive notifications, download training plans and workouts, review activities, and even keep an eye on the weather.

  • Included Power Mount connects to your Edge to your e-bike’s power, so you never need to worry about charging your Edge again, just your bike. Compatible with Cannondale SmartSense e-bikes. Garmin sells an adapter to work with a variety of Shimano and Bosch e-bike systems (not included)
  • Free global maps, with North America preloaded and more regions downloadable, for turn-by-turn routing to local points of interest, including cycling specific features like bike shops
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places like restaurants, attractions, hospitals, accommodation and more
  • Popularity routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of rider’s routes and tracks to let you ride local, anywhere you go
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your ride, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, remaining ascent and elevation profile, so you can pace yourself
  • LiveTrack share your course with contacts
  • GroupTrack displays the location and telemetry of contacts using compatible Garmin devices, you can even send pre-set messages within your group
  • Compatible with Varia™ radar units (sold separately), allowing you to keep an eye out for vehicles approaching from behind
  • inReach® compatibility provides messaging and SOS support when you ride takes you away from cell signal
  • Find my Edge feature let’s you know if your Edge loses its connection to your phone. Should your Edge fall off, you get a lost-connection alert with location and exact GPS coordinates. Once in Bluetooth™ range you can trigger an alarm on your device, letting you know exactly where it is
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max estimate, recovery time, intensity minutes, fitness age, and more (some features require not included heartrate chest strap)
  • Incident detection uses accelerometers to detect accident and uses you phone to send a signal to predefined emergency contacts
  • Bike alarm mode adds a bit of peace of mind to bathroom stops, water stops and anywhere you need to refuel or de-fuel, sounding a loud, shrill, attention getting alarm if your bike is touched
  • A powerful, internal antenna connects to 3 different satellite constellations, GPS, GLONASS and Galileo. Multiple networks, combined with satellite position caching, give you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal
  • Shimano Steps e-bike integration displays, range, battery status, gearing, and more
  • Trainer support provides ride data during your indoor training sessions, and you can even ride previous routes when paired with a compatible smart trainer
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields, and other features
  • In the box: Edge Explore 2, Power Mount, USB-C cable, tether and manuals
title: Garmin Edge Explore 2 Power Mount Bundle

description:
Ruggedly refined, the Instinct Crossover bring a little “class” to the tool watch world. Underneath its analogue hands, the Instinct Crossover has all the power that the Instinct line is known for. Outfitted with a multi-GNSS GPS and dozens of activity profiles, this watch will help you get the most out of your time in the gym, on the trails, and just about everywhere else. The updated GPS connects to more satellites, so you get a faster, more accurate signal in challenging conditions. GPS data is used both in navigation and in sport modes, getting you where you need to go and providing real-time speed and distance data along the way. Equipped with the latest Elevate optical heart rate monitor you get pulse information straight off your wrist. When paired with the free Garmin Connect™ app on your phone, you can review activities, set up live tracking sessions, track real-time weather forecasts, receive notifications, control apps and much more.

  • Luminescent hands and indices let you check the time in low-light, no buttons required. Don’t worry, there’s still a backlight for when you want to know more than the time
  • Multi-GNSS signal reception supports: GPS, GLONASS, and Galileo satellite constellations, providing a faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • RevoDrive™ allows one-touch calibration of the watch’s hands, great in the case of an impact or when used in highly dynamic environments
  • Analogue hands do more than just tell the time, pivoting to new positions in different modes, displaying time in heart rate zones, and acting act as a progress meter for daily step goals
  • Satellite caching saves satellite data, for fast, accurate satellite signal in any terrain
  • Tilt compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you are stationary, ensuring that you are always facing the right direction
  • Barometric altimeter tracks ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Storm alarm tracks pressure changes and alerts you when it’s time to find shelter. Extended weather data can also come in via the connection to your phone
  • Power manager uses pre-set and custom power profiles to balance battery life and GPS accuracy
  • Built-in activity modes for hiking, biking, running, strength training (with rep counter), walking, swimming, golf, yoga, climbing and dozens more
  • Pre-loaded and customizable workouts, you can even race past activities
  • Move IQ detects and tracks activity; it appears in your Connect timeline to credit all your daily exercise
  • Mountain biking dynamics distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TracBack® mode navigates you safely back to where you started
  • Course navigation (including turn-by-turn directions), via created or downloaded courses
  • Breadcrumb trails track your trek, navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing)
  • LiveTrack™, share your location and fitness data during activities (through a phone)
  • Elevate™ 4.0 optical heart rate monitor has improved accuracy and twice the number of infrared sensors for more precise Pulse Ox data, and even works while swimming
  • Physiological data: VO2 max, performance indicator and recovery advisor that takes altitude and temperature into consideration
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Fitness age takes your activity level, heart rate and BMI into account to let you know if you are performance matches your age
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking, Instinct 2 learns your activity level and helps guide you towards a more active lifestyle
  • Sleep tracking and sleep score mode monitors rest, periods of movement, deep and light REM sleep stages and scores them in a glanceable widget
  • Counts flights of stairs with internal barometric altimeter data combined with step data
  • Weekly intensity minutes displayed against the ideal for health of 150
  • Incident detection uses sensors to detect accidents. In the case of an accident a message and your location will be sent through your paired phone to your emergency contacts
  • If you feel unsafe, assistance mode sends out a LiveTrack link letting your contacts know where you are
  • Automatically sync data to a phone running the Connect app
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) via Bluetooth connection to a compatible phone
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart sensors, from temperature pods, to speed and cadence pods
  • Customizable display lets you set-up your screen how you want it
  • Connect IQ allows you to download apps, widgets, templates, data fields and more
  • Rugged construction with MIL-STD-810G certification for thermal, shock and water resistance (100m)
  • Fits wrist circumference of 135-230mm
  • In the box: Instinct Crossover, charging/data cable and documentation
title: Garmin Instinct Crossover - Unisex

description:
Loaded with more than 80 activity profiles, the Spartan is ready to push limits. With an optical heartrate monitor, information comes straight off your wrist, and the included Smart Sensor monitor adds a new level of precision to your training data. Internal GPS provides speed and distance information, while an accelerometer translates your movement into performance enhancing data. Connecting to both standard GPS and GLONASS satellites, you get a fast and accurate signal. When paired with a compatible smartphone running the Movescount app, the Spartan’s capabilities are greatly increased. Through Movescount you can transfer completed activities, receive smart notifications, plan routes using heatmap information, and more. Heatmaps are one of the coolest features of the Spartan line. They display other Movescount user’s activities over local maps, making it easier to find the best runs, rides, trails, or swims, wherever you are. Activity tracker functionality keeps track of your steps and gives you an estimate of calories burnt throughout the day. Taking all activity into consideration when calculating recovery times and tracking progress.

  • Valencell’s optical heartrate monitor provides reliable constant heartrate data, and allows you to train without a chest strap
  • Optical heartrate sensors measure changes in blood volume under the skin, and work best when worn snuggly, 1 to 3 finger-widths above your wrist bone
  • Spot check your heartrate and receive a graph of 10 minutes or 12 hours of heart data. During activity heartrate data is collected every second
  • Includes Suunto Smart Sensor to capture precise heart data
  • Smart sensor stores heart rate data when underwater; forwarding this data to your Spartan Sport once you are out of the water
  • Movescount web interface allows customization of modes and display, as well as competition and comparison of activities with other Movescount users, letting you race against friends from all over the world
  • Movescount enables sharing your metrics with coaches and personal trainers, opening up a whole world of digital training plans and tips
  • Keeps track of your up-to-date on your personal bests by sport. As well as showing progress trends for activities like: running, cycling, swimming, and many more, seeing trends is a quick and easy way to gauge the effectiveness of your training
  • Loaded with 80 different sport modes, from running, swimming, cycling and many more, there is a sport specific mode for nearly every activity
  • FusedSpeed™ combines GPS and accelerometer data to provide a more stable running pace
  • 24/7 activity tracking provides a daily step goal and estimate of calories burnt
  • Breadcrumb style navigation tracks your route, which you can overlay in a variety of map apps. You can even download other routes from Movescount
  • Integrated antenna for outstanding signal reception from GPS and GLONASS satellites
  • Tilt compensated digital compass helps keep you headed in the right direction
  • Bluetooth Smart connects to a myriad of fitness sensors, from power meters to footpods, as well as smartphones featuring Bluetooth 4.0
  • Automatically syncs data to paired smartphones running the free Suunto Movescount app
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) via Bluetooth connection to a compatible smartphone
  • Free software updates add functionality and improve performance
  • In the box: Suunto Spartan Sport Wrist HR, Suunto Smart Sensor and heart rate belt (size M), USB cable, quick guide, warranty leaflet
title: Suunto Spartan Sport Wrist Heart Rate Watch with Belt

description:
After thousands of hours of testing, Garmin’s newest family of power meters is burlier and more reliable than ever. Building on the technology of the Vector 3, the Rally makes it easy to add watts to your training data. With an industry-leading 1% accuracy and measurements taken at the pedals, you can confidently say that you earned every watt it picks up. The low-profile design houses a lot of technology within the surprisingly normal-looking pedal – no external pods or new cranks needed. Bluetooth and ANT+ communication means the rally works with your smart trainer, sending data right to your favourite training app. Travelling with these pedals is now easier than ever, as you'll need nothing but a standard pedal wrench to get these on your bike – no need for a torque wrench or an annoying trip to an unfamiliar bike shop. If you’re looking to optimize your riding efficiency, the Rally is the right tool for the job.

  • Trail-friendly SPD pedal design makes it fast and simple to add power to your cross-country adventures
  • Pedal sensors have an industry-leading +/-1% accuracy
  • Built-in accelerometers track your cadence and wake the power meter up as soon as you start riding, no need to turn them on or off
  • All data is transmitted wirelessly via ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart
  • For use with compatible Edge® cycling computers, Fenix® watches, Forerunner® watches, and other ANT+ enabled head units
  • Compatible with most smart trainers and many apps like Zwift®, Strava® and Trainer Road®
  • Real-time pedaling cycling dynamics are available when paired to a compatible Garmin Edge computer
  • Detailed power metrics and graphs available through Garmin Connect software
  • O-ring sealed, updated battery caps thread into metal spindles, offering serious weather protection
  • Bulled about wake sleep updates for more reliable info in all conditions
  • Lightweight composite bodies with stainless steel wear-plate blends durability and lightweight
  • Pedal installation is quick and requires nothing but a pedal wrench
  • User-replaceable batteries (4xLR44/SR44 or 2x CR1/3N) provides 120 hours of use
  • Firmware can be updated wirelessly via a Garmin Edge, or a phone
  • Power meter technology is all contained in the spindle, letting you swap cleat ecosystems with a simple upgrade kit (sold separately), letting you add power metrics to 2 or more bikes without having to buy 2 or more power meters
  • In the box: Rally XC100 pedals (1 with power meter and 1 without), cleats, 55mm Q-factor washers and documentation

description:
Updated with an improved GPS and a few tricks taken from the fēnix line, this is an Instinct you can trust. With the Instinct 2 Solar Garmin has brought a multi-GNSS GPS and more activity profiles to their rugged Instinct line. By speaking to more satellites, you get a faster, more accurate signal in challenging conditions. GPS data is used both in navigation and in sport modes, getting you where you need to go and providing real-time speed and distance data along the way. An upgraded solar panel converts solar energy more efficiently than ever, offering potentially infinite battery life. Equipped with the latest Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor you get pulse information straight off your wrist, so there's no need to wear a chest strap. Sport profiles add custom metrics to how you train, letting you train smarter and evolve faster. When paired with the free Garmin Connect™ app on your phone, you can review activities, set up live tracking sessions, track real-time weather forecasts, receive notifications, control apps and much more.

  • S-series’ smaller case is more comfortable and offers a more accurate heart rate signal on smaller wrists
  • Power Glass™ solar panel lets you go longer between charges, 6 hours to 80 days longer – runtime is feature dependent
  • Sun gauge displays solar charge and daily sun exposure
  • Multi-GNSS signal reception supports: GPS, GLONASS, and Galileo satellite constellations, providing a faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite caching saves satellite data, for fast, accurate satellite signal in any terrain
  • Tilt compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you are stationary, ensuring that you are always facing the right direction
  • Barometric altimeter tracks ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Storm alarm tracks pressure changes and alerts you when it’s time to find shelter. Extended weather data can also come in via the connection to your phone
  • Power manager uses pre-set and custom power profiles to balance battery life and GPS accuracy
  • Garmin Pay™, make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)
  • Built-in activity modes for hiking, biking, running, strength training (with rep counter), walking, swimming, golf, yoga, climbing and more
  • Pre-loaded and customizable workouts, you can even race past activities
  • Move IQ detects and tracks activity; it appears in your Connect timeline to credit all your daily exercise
  • Mountain biking dynamics distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TracBack mode navigates you safely back to where you started
  • Course navigation, via created or downloaded courses
  • Breadcrumb trails track your trek, navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing)
  • LiveTrack™, share your location and fitness data during activities (through a phone)
  • Elevate™ 4.0 optical heart rate monitor has improved accuracy and twice the number of infrared sensors for more precise Pulse Ox data, and even works while swimming
  • Physiological data: VO2 max, performance indicator and recovery advisor that takes altitude and temperature into consideration
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Fitness age takes your activity level, heart rate and BMI into account to let you know if you are performance matches your age
  • 24/7 activity tracking, Instinct 2 learns your activity level and helps guide you towards a more active lifestyle
  • Sleep tracking and sleep score mode monitors rest, periods of movement, deep and light REM sleep stages and scores them in a glanceable widget
  • Counts flights of stairs with internal barometric altimeter data combined with step data
  • Weekly intensity minutes displayed against the ideal for health of 150
  • Incident detection uses sensors to detect accidents. In the case of an accident a message and your location will be sent through your paired phone to your emergency contacts
  • If you feel unsafe, assistance mode sends out a LiveTrack link letting your contacts know where you are
  • Automatically sync data to a phone running the Connect app
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) via Bluetooth connection to a compatible phone
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart sensors, from temperature pods, to speed and cadence pods
  • Customizable display lets you set-up your screen how you want it
  • Connect IQ allows you to download apps, widgets, templates, data fields and more
  • Rugged construction with MIL-STD-810G certification for thermal, shock and water resistance (100m)
  • Fits wrist circumference of 112-180mm
  • In the box: Instinct 2S Solar, charging/data cable and documentation

description:
By swapping the silicone strap for a nylon strap, Coros has turned their already lightweight Pace 3 into a featherweight. The latest generation of Coros’ budget-friendly multisport watch gets improved GPS, a touchscreen, and a more precise heart rate monitor. The Pace 3’s biggest win comes from the dual frequency GPS, by tapping into more satellites, the watch gets a more accurate and reliable signal, especially in challenging terrain. You see these GPS benefits in precise tracks and a stronger connection under heavy tree cover and in dense cities. The touchscreen allows you swipe around your preloaded courses, while the signature dial lets you zoom in and out, making it easy to review your route with a single finger. By adding additional sensors to the optical heart rate monitor, your heart rate data is more complete than ever and adds the ability to track blood oxygen levels. And when you want even more, you can synch with the free COROS app to build, share and download custom routes and workouts, review activities, receive texts, social media alerts and email.

  • Dual frequency GNSS support, connecting to GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou and QZSS satellite constellations providing faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Sport profiles include: running (indoor and outdoor), cycling (indoor and outdoor), swimming (pool and open water), triathlon, multisport, gym cardio, strength training and more
  • Multisport lets you transition and track different activities within a single workout
  • Strength training program has more than 200 exercises, selectable muscle groups, auto-detects reps, counts sets and provides a comprehensive breakdown in the app with body-mapped exercise tracking, including how many reps you did for each muscle group
  • Updated optical heart rate monitor measures heart rate right off your wrist and even works while swimming
  • Recovery advisor prevents over-training and helps maximize training intervals
  • Advanced training metrics: SpO2, VO2max, training effect, training load, threshold pace and more
  • Music playback via the internal storage, letting you drag-and-drop owned .mp3 files from your computer to your watch. Note – there is no music service support
  • Digital dial scrolls through modes, settings and metrics with a single finger
  • Battery profiles provide 15 hours of continuous training use with dual frequency GPS mode and 24 days in smart watch mode
  • Breadcrumb style navigation tracks your activities, can navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing), or give you a trail to follow back to where you started
  • Free COROS app has downloadable workouts, workout breakdowns, activity tracking information, third party training app integration e.g., Strava™, Training Peaks™, etc., and much more
  • Bluetooth Smart lets you connect to a variety of different sensors, including: power meters (cycling and running), cadence and speed sensors, foot pods, heart rate belts and more
  • Daily activity tracking with calories burnt, steps, floors climbed and sleep tracking
  • Night mode backlights low-light sessions, turns off when activity is complete or 1 hour after sunrise
  • ABC data via internal altimeter, barometer and compass
  • 50m water resistance
  • Nylon strap allows for more precise fitment, nice if you always find you are between holes on watch straps
  • In the box: Pace 3, charging cable and documentation
title: Coros Pace 3 Nylon Band GPS Watch

description:
What sounds better, looking for an outlet, or looking for a sunbeam? Like your favourite childhood calculator, the Suunto Vertical has solar charging. By tapping into the sun’s energy, this version of the Vertical lets you stay out longer, anywhere from 1 day to 1 year longer than the non-solar version. In a first for Suunto wearables, the Vertical pairs cutting edge antenna technology with their latest GPS chipset. This combination enables dual frequency and multi-band GPS reception, keeping you connected when your route winds through valleys and mountain ranges, or canyons of glass and steel. Preloaded with multi-layer topographical maps, you choose the view, whether you’re route planning, on the trail, or navigating urban jungles. When it is time to train, there are 95+ activity profiles, so the Vertical is ready for your next ride or your next open water swim. Updated environmental sensors keep you in the know, providing forecasts and even air quality information. Activity tracking records steps and calories, as well as monitors the quality of your sleep. All of this 24/7 performance data is used to calculate your recovery times and track fitness journey.

  • Grade 5 titanium bezel reduces the weight from the stainless version by 14%, pairing well with a virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face
  • Made in a factory powered by 100% renewable, carbon-free energy
  • Each watch is fully carbon offset via trees planted by Tree-Nation, an internationally recognized non-profit dedicated to reforestation
  • Provides a graph of solar charging, showing both 10 minute increments and previous 7 days
  • Battery runtimes with solar: 85 hours with full GPS and heart rate, 90h-1 year with your choice of GPS (more GPS = less runtime), 60 days in smartwatch mode, or 1+ year in time only mode
  • Dual frequency and multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and BeiDou) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data, connecting simultaneously to up to 5 networks and 32 satellites
  • Shaded topographic maps for North America are preloaded with more regions available for free download over Wi-Fi
  • Point of interest navigation with ETAs
  • Snap-to-Route matches your GPS track to your preloaded route (aka a .GPX file), removing inaccuracies along the way, providing a precise track
  • Heatmaps display other Suunto user’s activities over local maps, making it easy to find the best runs, rides, trails, or swims, anywhere you go
  • FusedTrack™ uses data from the internal sensors to plot your route between GPS points. By combining the data, you get a track that mirrors your actual track, with fewer GPS check-ins greatly increasing battery life
  • FusedSpeed™ combines GPS and accelerometer data to provide a more stable running pace and normalized graded pace
  • Running power comes right off of your wrist, no pod needed
  • Optical heart rate monitor provides blood oxygen level info and constant heart rate data
  • Strava Live Segment integration lets you know when your starred segments are about to begin and displays your progress. Showing your performance in the moment, and how it compares to your PR and the current KOM or QOM, and then provides results once the segment is complete (Strava premium required)
  • Free Suunto app lets you plan trips, workouts, and connect with 200+ app partners, like Strava®, Training Peaks®, Komoot®, etc
  • Suunto app enables sharing, opening up a whole world of digital training plans and tips
  • Loaded with 95+ different sport modes, from running, swimming, cycling, shallow water free diving (up to 10m), and many more
  • Pre-set intelligent battery profiles optimize features and runtimes
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • Sleep tracking monitors the quality of sleep and total sleep, rest data is used to calculate recovery times and progress
  • Tilt compensated digital compass
  • Barometric altimeter tracks ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Altitude acclimation calculated through altitude data and blood oxygenation data
  • Storm alarm tracks pressure changes
  • Bluetooth connects fitness sensors from power meters to foot pods
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) via Bluetooth
  • Fits wrists 12.5-17.5cm
  • In the box: Suunto Vertical Titanium, USB cable and documentation
title: Suunto Vertical Titanium Solar

description:
Take your remote office, really remote. With more than enough power to keep both office essentials, and good times essentials powered, the BaseCharge 600 lets you take the best of the grid with you. With years of creating clever off-grid power solutions and powerbanks, BioLite has created a line of all-in-one power station that lets you plug-in your favourite at home electronics, wherever you roam. The onboard digital display provides you with all the information you need: input/output Watts, battery capacity, runtimes, charge times, and more. Wireless charging and plenty of female charging ports, including 12V (car cigarette lighter), 2 x USB type C (one is even set-up for USB-PD), 2 x USB type A, and 2 x AC that accepts grounded and ungrounded plugs, mean that if you can recharge it, you can probably recharge it with the BaseCharge.

  • LCD power status display tells you how much power you're getting and using, as well as battery charge capacity and time remaining under current load. Resettable energy odometer lets you track your power usage, making it easy to manage remaining power
  • Wireless charging via the top mounted charging panel (1 device at a time, 10W max)
  • Charges easily via included wall charger, going from 0 to full in 7 hours, USB-C PD in 5 hours, combine a wall charger and USB-C PD to charge in 3.5 hours, or 6 hours from a compatible solar panel (6 hours is the power from 1 SolarPanel 100 in ideal conditions)
  • MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracker) technology enables a 30% more efficient charging via solar panels in low-light conditions
  • 12 checkpoint safety system constantly monitors all incoming and outgoing power, battery’s status, and provides over-charge and under-charge protection
  • Li-NMC (lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide) battery offers a longer life than standard lithium-ion batteries and better inherent safety
  • Battery can be kept plugged into a power source during storage, or fully-charge your BaseCharge every 3-6 months and store in a cool, dry place
  • Peak capacity is 622Wh (21.6V, 28.8Ah) and lasts through hundreds of cycles
  • 4 USB ports (output): 2 x type-A at 5V, up to 3A, 1 x USB-C 5V up to 3A, USB-C PD 5-20V up to 5A (100W max), All ports are regulated
  • 12V car port (regulated output): 12V (120W max)
  • 12V barrel port (output): 12V (120W max) 5.5mm OD and 2.1mm ID
  • AC inverter: 2 x 110V (600W, 1000W surge)
  • Provides pass-through power, so you can plug your BaseCharge into the wall and then your device into your BaseCharge, making sure your device stays powered should the power go out
  • Charging ports: wall/solar input, 120W (12-30V DC), up to 10A max, and USB-C PD 100W
  • Not waterproof and should not be used in the rain
  • Operating temp is 0-40°C
  • In the box: BaseCharge, wall charger, documentation
title: BioLite BaseCharge 600

description:
After taking a few years off, the epix is back. This latest generation of Garmin’s svelte do-it-all watch incorporates some the best features of the fēnix line and tucks them under the stunning AMOLED touchscreen of the Venu 2. Preloaded with North American topo maps and multi-band GPS keep you headed in the right direction, and track your speed and distance while training. Elevation data from the GPS is analyzed along side readings from the barometric pressure altimeter for precise elevation data. The epix combines elevation data with pulse metrics from the optical heart rate sensor, letting you know how acclimated you are to your current altitude. Dozens of onboard training profiles are ready to help your develop your stamina, crush that next 5k, or track your sport climbing progress. When you’re not training or in the backcountry, the epix will tell you more about your daily routine, from how you sleep, to your breathing patterns, and even when you should drink more water. Smartwatch features help you stay connected, stream music, receive texts, social media alerts and emails, track the weather and more.

  • Touchscreen plus an intuitive button layout make navigating your watch quick and easy
  • 3cm AMOLED colour display has deep blacks and vibrant colours making it crisp and clear in any light
  • Lightweight titanium bezel and case back paired with a virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face
  • Built-in modes for biking (road and mountain), running, swimming (indoor and out), HIIT (AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata and custom), climbing (bouldering and route, with selectable grading systems and difficulty), gym (strength training, cardio and elliptical, stair stepping, rowing and yoga), surfing (with SurfLine® integration) golfing (42,000+ course maps), skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations show proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga with preloaded structured workouts. And, more than 1600 exercise animations in the Connect app, so you can develop your own personalized workouts
  • Preloaded North American TopoActive map data with other continents downloadable for free
  • Up ahead feature offers at a glance performance metrics and a summary of upcoming trail features
  • Turn-by-turn and point of interest navigation
  • Round-trip mapping: choose a distance and get course options that start and stop in the same spot – great for set-distance runs
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin user’s route data to find the most popular route
  • Stream and download using Spotify (premium required), Amazon Music, and more, or add MP3s from your computer
  • Holds up to 2000 songs so you can leave the phone at home, just pair your Bluetooth headphones and hit play
  • Synched playlists can be updated via Wi-Fi
  • ClimbPro™ shows grade, total ascent and current position on an elevation profile
  • PacePro™, set your desired pace, then compare it to your distance splits, the Fenix 6 compares your needed pace vs your goal pace for each split and for the course
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Garmin Pay™, make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)
  • LiveTrack, share your location and fitness data during activities (through a phone)
  • Multiband signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Elevate™ 4.0 optical heart rate monitor has improved accuracy and twice the number of infrared sensors for more precise Pulse Ox data, and even works while swimming
  • Physiological data: VO2 max, a visual race predictor, real-time stamina tracking, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • 7-day training load lets you know if you're overtraining, under-training, or on the right path, it even provides personalized daily workouts
  • Respiration tracking counts breaths per minute asleep, awake, during yoga or in a breathwork exercise
  • Compatible with running dynamics sensors (sold separately)
  • Incident detection + assistance mode sends out a LiveTrack link letting your contacts know where you are
  • 24/7 activity tracking learns your activity level and guides you towards a more active lifestyle
  • Sleep tracking, shows total sleep hours as well as movement and restful sleep
  • Stress level score monitors heart rate variability while inactive
  • Access Garmin Connect app via Bluetooth to your phone
  • Connect IQ allows you to download apps, widgets, templates, data fields and more
  • Pre-set and custom power profiles let you maximize your battery’s power, lasting 9h – 21 days (depending on mode)
  • ABC data comes in via the internal altimeter, barometer and a tilt-compensated compass
  • In the box: epix Titanium, charging cable and documentation

Free downloadable shaded relief maps help you plan your next trip, and when connected to your phone, can even display live satellite weather. When it comes to navigating your fitness, 24/7 heartrate tracking and other metrics combine to give you a complete picture of how you train, how you recover and how you live.   • Fox 34 Rhythm front fork with the Grip damper has three settings: open for descending, medium for flowy flats, and firm for climbing. With 10 clicks of low-speed rebound adjustment you can set your preferred tracking

  • One piece suspension linkage increases stiffness while reducing weight. Delivering a ride that is poppy and supportive, with excellent small bump compliance, yet is still efficient in the climbs

  • Tektro Orion 4-piston brakes offer plenty of stopping power and precise speed control in all conditions
  • Tektro Orion levers have adjustable reach
  • ALX Alloy frame is uses hydro-formed, triple butted 6061 aluminum that has been heat treated for improved strength and durability
  • FWG frame geometry optimized for aggressive trail riding, steep descents, and comfortable climbs
  • Tapered head tube broadens at the bottom for better force transfer from fork to frame, plus stiffness to improve handling
  • Internal cable routing keeps your cables safe from trail hazards and has a nice clean look
  • Wheel fit system equips small bikes with 27.5in. wheels, and medium to extra large bikes with 29in. wheels. Polygon feels this balance offers the rider the most efficient power delivery and ergonomics for their size
  • Suspension travel varies by size, with the 29in. having 140mm of travel up front and 135mm of rear travel, and the 27.5in. 150mm of travel up front and 140mm of rear travel
  • Tranz-X dropper posts with internal cable routing, give you somewhere to sit when you need it and get your seat out of the way when you don't. 29in. – 170mm drop. 27.5in. – 150mm drop

  • Boost hub spacing offers improved rigidity and strength, and paves the way for easy upgrades down the road

  • Bikes are covered by MEC's Rocksolid Guarantee and Bike Service Agreement. You can bring your bike to any MEC bike shop for free adjustments and minor maintenance for a year after purchase
  • Based in Indonesia, Polygon has been making bikes for more than 25 years. All frames are made in-house, so design and construction are controlled from inception to shipping. You'll see them ridden in the Red Bull Rampage, UCI Downhill World Cup, and major mountain bike events around the world

description:
Never underestimate the power of an “I made it” text. The inReach Messenger refines the core features of the inReach line, into an easy to use off-grid communicator. Taking the inReach’s already impressive battery to new heights, the Messenger’s battery lets you go nearly a month between charges. By tapping into the power of Iridium’s® satellite constellation, you can send and receive text messages anywhere on the planet, staying connected even where there’s no phone coverage. Should things take a turn for the worse, a dedicated SOS button lets you call for help, no matter where you are. If you get turned around, TracBack® has you covered, displaying a path that will take you right back to where you started. The internal GPS can also imbed your location in each message, so your followers don’t have to guess where you made camp. When paired with the free Garmin Messenger® app you can use your phone to send and receive messages. Great for setting up a group chat to keep family and friends up to date on your adventures.

  • Stores customized and pre-set quick-response text messages for anticipated situations
  • Preset messages do not count against your plan’s text message allotment
  • Uses Iridium’s constellation of 66 satellites for coverage of the Earth's entire surface. Messages are buffered for up to a day
  • Iridium’s worldwide coverage lets you send texts and emails from anywhere in the world. Your plan determines how many you can send and how detailed they are. Note – some jurisdictions regulate or prohibit the use of satellite communication devices
  • Rechargeable internal battery pack delivers up to 28 days of battery life with 10-minute tracking, or 48 days with 30-minute tracking (battery life varies depending on settings and overhead interference, e.g., tree canopy, ravines, etc.)
  • TracBack mode navigates you safely back to where you started
  • Reverse charging allows you to charge your phone for 20 minutes from the inReach's USB-C port, enough time to check your map or send a longer, custom message. Note - reverse charging only works when your inReach has more than 25% battery
  • Bluetooth Smart and ANT+ compatibility lets you explore smarter with compatible wearables, activity sensors, and accessories
  • Connects via Bluetooth to phones/tablets running the free inReach Messenger app. When paired with the Messenger app you gain access to your phone’s keyboard, contacts and group text capabilities. Texts sent via the Messenger app over cellular or Wi-Fi, can only be received by other Garmin Messenger users
  • Smart network switching technology sends and receives your messages via the most reliable available network, helping ensure your messages get though, and you only use your satellite subscription when you need it
  • Garmin Explore™ website helps plan your trip and sync important details to your device
  • GPS tracking feature allows your friends and community to follow your progress via a personalized MapShare® page
  • World coverage SOS feature gives you a confirmation message from the International Emergency Response Coordination Center (IERCC) if you use it to send an SOS. 2-way texting allows you to stay in contact with rescue personnel
  • SOS messages are received by IERCC, a worldwide emergency response coordination center with 24/7/365 staffing
  • SOS button has a hard plastic cover, greatly reducing chances of an accidental activation
  • Messages have your GPS location embedded for faster finding in emergencies
  • GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou and QZSS satellite constellation support for strong signal anywhere
  • Optional weather forecasting service sends detailed weather data for your location, a specific waypoint or a GPS coordinate directly to your inReach, paired smartphone or tablet
  • SOS/PLB functionality and all off-grid communication requires a separate satellite plan to activate, GPS functionality works all the time, no plan required
  • Monthly plans are available, as well as seasonal hibernation options that allow you to pay a minimal fee during months when you are not using the device
  • Rugged housing is IPX7 water-resistant, dustproof and has a high-contrast display
  • Intuitive 3 button interface
  • In the box: inReach Messenger, USB-C charging and data cable, and documentation

description:
Get a clear view of where you’re going, on the trail and on your fitness journey. By learning some of the best features from Garmin’s fēnix and Forerunner line, and tossing in a few new ones, the epix has evolved. One of the epix Pro’s new features tackles the challenge of balancing GPS power and battery life. By matching your GPS signal to your terrain, SatIQ optimizes your runtime; flat land gets a low power signal, head into the mountains and your signal is boosted. The onboard multiband GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While the optical heart rate monitor and other sensors pay attention to how you train. When your favourite runs feel too easy, Hill score shows you why, breaking down the evolution of your running power and endurance. On those days you want to train but don’t have a workout in mind, the morning report is there. Each morning you get a summary of sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and a personalized daily workout. When you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through the free Garmin Connect app. And, classic smartwatch features help you stay connected, stream music, receive notifications, track the weather and more.

  • AMOLED screen is easy to read in any light, with deep blacks and vibrant colours
  • Lightweight titanium bezel is paired with a virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face
  • Preloaded with routable North American TopoActive maps, with other regions available for free download
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym activities, skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations guide you through proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • SatIQ™ matches your current environment with the right GPS mode, optimizing battery life
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (via a phone) allows you to share your location and metrics
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the epix Pro will use tracks from other Garmin users to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Hill score displays your running strength and endurance, tracking your progress over time
  • Endurance score analyzes training data to map improvements to your overall endurance
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and provides a personalized daily workout
  • Training readiness, training status, and training load modes use data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Acute load compares recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Running dynamics info provides running power, cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor for constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor, real-time stamina tracking, and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) is a great tool to predict recovery and training response
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food)
  • Incident detection: in the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Stream music via a paired phone using Spotify, Deezer, or Amazon Music. Or, download playlists and podcasts, you can even drag and drop MP3s
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, providing total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep
  • Automatically sync your data to the free Garmin Connect app
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Flashlight with white and red light
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 15 hours with multi-band GPS, 42 hours with standard GPS, or up to 16 days in smartwatch mode

description:
Explore confidently with access to 5 different satellite networks, class leading battery life, free topographical maps, and satellite imagery. Multiband GNSS technology gives the GPSMAP 67 more satellites and more signals to choose from, so you get fast and accurate positioning data, all over the globe. TOPO maps for Canada and the US make backcountry navigation and trip-planning simple. The free Garmin Explore™ app lets you plan trips on your computer, tablet, or phone. Once you're ready to start, send planned routes and tracks to your 67, no cell network required, and it won’t cost you a thing.

  • Preloaded with routable TopoActive maps (Canada and US 100K resolution), featuring streets and trails
  • Multiband and multifrequency signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) has access to more satellites and more signals, this provides faster, more accurate positioning and elevation data, anywhere in the world
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places you may want to go, e.g., restaurants, attractions, accommodation, etc
  • LiveTrack™ during activities (through a connected smartphone) shares your location with friends
  • GroupTrack displays the location and telemetry of up to 50 contacts with compatible Garmin devices
  • Active weather provides real-time radar tracking (via a connected phone running Garmin Connect)
  • Geocaching Live uses the connection to your phone to provide live cache updates, cache descriptions, logs, and can even provide hints for those times you know you’re close and just need a little help
  • Bluetooth Smart and ANT+ compatibility
  • Garmin Explore website and app let you sync routes, tracks and waypoints to your device. You can download map data to your phone, use your phone to plan routes and tracks, and then send those plans to your GPS, all without cell reception
  • Satellite caching saves an extended predicted orbit path (EPO) file, so it knows where to look for satellites when you turn it on
  • Barometric altimeter tracks ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Tilt-compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you're stationary
  • Extended battery life, with multiple different GPS modes let you find the perfect balance of battery life and GPS accuracy
  • Internal Lithium-ion rechargeable battery provides up to 180 hours of battery life in GPS mode and more than a month in Expedition mode
  • 3in. colour screen is bright and clear even direct sun
  • 16GB internal memory can be increased via MicroSD cards (not included)
  • IPX7 waterproofing
  • Built-in LED flashlight has S.O.S setting
  • In the box: GPSMAP 67 preloaded with 100K TOPO Canada and US maps, USB cable (A-C), carabiner clip and documentation
title: Garmin GPSMAP 67

description:
