description:
Enjoy bike GPS goodness in the backcountry. This kit bundles the 830 with Garmin’s Edge remote and mountain bike mount so you always where you’re going. Get phone-free, turn-by-turn point of interest navigation, and worldwide trail maps on a compact, touchscreen GPS. Select where you want to go, by address, or browse categories (restaurants, locations, attractions). Garmin’s Trendline routing looks at other Garmin Connect user’s data to find the best rides and most efficient routes. Real-time Strava segment integration speaks to your competitive side, displaying nearby segments, showing how you compare to your PR and the current KOM or QOM. Live Tracking continues to evolve, with rider-to-rider pre-set messaging and real-time location. When connected to your phone via the free Garmin Connect app, you can receive texts, social media alerts, emails, download training plans, review activities, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • Searchable maps (North America) let you enter an address just like you would in your phone or in-car GPS. Once the 830 knows where you want to go, it will navigate you there and it will even re-route you if you get off course
  • Point of interest navigation includes restaurants, attractions, hospitals, accommodation and more
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of rider’s routes and tracks to find popular routes
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs, letting you know grade, total ascent, remaining ascent and elevation profile, so you get an idea of how to pace yourself
  • Mountain biking dynamics include 3 new metrics, jumps: number of jumps, hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail e.g. did you over brake in a corner
  • TrailForks™ integration lets you access and navigate through the immense TrailForks trail database without needing a cellular connection. You can even log into your account and save rides, check-in on trails, etc., all from your Edge!
  • ForkSight mode uses TraliForks data when you get to a fork in the trail, telling about your choices, e.g. trail rating, distance, elevation
  • Strava Segment integration (requires premium) preloaded or on-the-fly through your phone, shows starred segments and instantaneous results as segments end
  • Live Tracking during activities (through a connected smartphone) allows you to share your location, speed, and more
  • GroupTrack™ displays the location and telemetry of up to 50 of your contacts that are using compatible Garmin devices
  • Pre-set messaging between compatible Edge units, when combined with Live Tracking, means real-time location and messaging, no more stopping to check your phone
  • Find my Edge feature sends a lost-connection alert with location and exact GPS coordinates. Once in Bluetooth™ range you can trigger an alarm on your device to find it
  • Training plan takes you through the details of your ride: weather – including the recommended clothing for the conditions, food and water requirements based on your fitness levels – even providing reminders of when you should drink and eat, and much more
  • Environmental factors like heat and altitude acclimation are taken into consideration when calculating performance and recovery metrics
  • Training status helps you optimize your training, guiding you where you need to push and where you may need to dial it back
  • Bike alarm mode adds a bit of peace of mind to pit stops
  • Incident detection uses the Edge’s accelerometers to detect if an accident has occurred. In the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your paired smartphone to predefined emergency contacts
  • Included Edge remotes lets you navigate your 830 without ever taking your hands off the bars
  • Included mountain bike mount is designed for bikes with short stems, and lets you choose if you want your 830 out front of the bars, or tucked behind, in line with the stem
  • Speed sensor track your rides even when you aren’t using your phone or bike computer. Sensor start a session when you start and stop rolling, synching to your phone (running Garmin Connect) or computer when next in range
  • Speed Sensor attaches to a standard hub on either wheel and self-calibrates for accurate speed and distance while stationary (on a trainer) or on the move
  • Improved processor lets you spend less time fiddling with the computer and more time riding
  • Barometric altimeter helps you track your total elevation changes
  • Customizable screens let you choose what you want to see where
  • included out the front mount holds the Edge flush with the handlebars, and allows the connection to the external battery pack (sold separately)
  • In the box: Edge 830, mounts (MTB and standard), Edge remote, Speed Sensor 2, silicone case, USB cable, tether and manuals

description:
Make the most of everyday. How you start the day affects your whole day, the vívoactive 5 helps you start your day right. Each morning a personalized morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, body battery, weather and more. Underneath the sleek exterior and bright, beautiful AMOLED touchscreen, lies an array of technology that will do everything from tell you why the time between your heartbeats matters almost as much as how fast your heart beats, to play your favourite podcast on your bus ride to work. All of the heart rate data comes right off your wrist via the Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor. If you’re preparing for a race, be it a 5k fun-run or marathon, the onboard GPS provides you with speed and distance data. If you’re just run-curious, intervals can be set up right on your watch, making run/walk programs even easier to follow. When you get a quiet moment a built-in breathing exercises can help you relax. And when your phone is connected, a world of smartwatch functionality opens up. Garmin’s Connect app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • AMOLED colour touchscreen has deep blacks and vibrant colours making it crisp, clear, and easy to read in any light
  • 1 swipe access to your most used modes
  • Intuitive widgets display needed metrics
  • 30+ activity modes, including: hiking, biking, handcycling, running (with VO2 Max), HIIT (AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata and more), walking, swimming (indoor and outdoor), strength training, yoga, Pilates and more
  • Workout benefit feature summarizes how your previous workout contributes to your fitness goals and overall well-being
  • Garmin Coach personalized training plans: 5k, 10k, or just train smarter
  • Elevate™ 4.0 optical heart rate monitor has improved accuracy, more sensors for precise Pulse Ox data, and works while swimming
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, body battery, weather and more
  • Breathwork mode helps you relax and focus
  • Respiration tracking counts breaths per minute asleep, awake, during yoga or in a breathwork exercise
  • Listen to music over Bluetooth®, download playlists and podcasts via music services (Spotify®, Amazon Music or Deezer. Premium account may be required)
  • Playlists synced from streaming services update when in range of Wi-Fi
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels to aid training. See what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food)
  • Fitness age takes your activity level and heart rate into account to let you know if you are performance matches your age
  • Flashlight mode turns the screen into a flashlight with 3 white light levels and 1 red light level
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • LiveTrack™ during activities (through a connected phone) allows you to share your location and fitness data
  • Incident detection uses your phone to send an emergency alert or call your contacts, letting them know you need help and exactly where you are via GPS
  • Multi-GNSS signal reception supports: GPS, GLONASS, and Galileo satellite constellations, providing a faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Menstrual tracking logs physical and emotional symptoms to aid training and nutrition during phases of your cycle
  • 24/7 activity tracking learns your activity level and guides you towards a more active lifestyle
  • Weekly intensity minutes displayed against the ideal for health of 150
  • Sleep tracking both at night and while napping, monitoring total sleep time, periods of movement, and restful sleep, even offering insights for improving your sleep
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart sensors, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods (no power meters)
  • Connect IQ support for downloading apps, templates, data fields, watch faces, and more
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) come in via Bluetooth connection to your phone. Android users can respond to texts and view sent images on the watch
  • Rechargeable battery: 8 hours with GPS and music, 21 hours in GPS mode or up to 11 days in smartwatch mode
  • Internal accelerometer and other sensors track your steps, or pushes for people who use wheelchairs, so you know when you hit your daily goal
  • Scratch-resistant Corning® Gorilla® Glass 3
  • In the box: vívoactive 5, charging cable and documentation

  • Real-time pedaling cycling dynamics are available when paired to a compatible Garmin Edge computer
  • Detailed power metrics and graphs available through Garmin Connect software
  • O-ring sealed, updated battery caps thread into metal spindles, offering serious weather protection
  • Bulled about wake sleep updates for more reliable info in all conditions
  • Lightweight composite bodies with stainless steel wear-plate blends durability and lightweight
  • Pedal installation is quick and requires nothing but a pedal wrench

description:
The latest 9-series Forerunner is easier to use than ever, so you get to spend more time doing what you love and less time pushing buttons. Borrowing a feature from Garmin's fēnix line, the Forerunner 955 gets a touchscreen. The touchscreen makes scrolling and zooming through the pre-loaded maps, or any course you create, feel natural. With more satellites to choose from, the 955’s powerful GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While other sensors pay attention to where you train, not just how you train, factoring elevation and temperature into your performance. The new training readiness feature helps make the most of your training, guiding you away from overtraining or under training, so you reach your fitness goals faster than ever. Each morning the 955 delivers your morning report, summarizing sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and even provides a personalized daily workout suggestion. When you need more information, or motivation, you can download training plans through the free Garmin Connect app. Garmin Connect lets you review activities, receive texts and other notifications, keep an eye on the weather and more. Through the connection to your phone the 955 can connect to multiple music services and can even hold up to 1000 songs. With music and mapping right on your wrist, phone-free runs are looking better and better.

  • Built-in modes for biking, running, swimming (indoor and outdoor), multisport – transition between activities within a single workout at the press of a button, gym focused activities (strength training – with rep counter, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, indoor rowing and yoga) and more
  • Includes North American map data with room to add more maps
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places you may want to go, e.g restaurants, attractions, accommodation, etc
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the 955 will use tracks from other Garmin users to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Stream music through a paired smartphone using Spotify, iHeartRadio, Pandora or Deezer. Or, download playlists and podcasts via your favourite music service, e.g. Spotify (premium account required), you can even drag and drop MP3s from your computer – holds up to 1,000 songs (depending on sound quality)
  • Race widget helps make race day a little less stressful, providing course specific performance info, weather and more
  • Power alerts and lap data can come through to your paired Bluetooth™ headphones
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your activity, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, how much more you have to go and displays an elevation profile, so you know how to pace yourself
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment; by linking credit cards to your Garmin account, you can make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)
  • Strava Segment integration – both preloaded and on-the-fly (through your phone) – lets you know when your starred segment is about to begin and shows instantaneous data, how it compares to your PR and the current KOM or QOM, and then provides results once the segment is complete (requires Strava premium)
  • Connects to 4 different satellite constellations (GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, and Galileo) and caches satellite positions, giving you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal anywhere
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (through a connected smartphone) allows you to share your location and fitness data
  • Pre-set messaging between compatible Garmin units, when combined with Live Tracking, means real-time location and messaging
  • UltraTrac™ mode reduces the GPS recording rate in order to conserve battery, providing up to 80 hours of GPS use
  • Equipped with Garmin’s latest Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides reliable constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max – which takes ambient temperature and altitude into consideration, a race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • Training load and training readiness modes uses data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Compatible with running dynamics sensors (sold separately) for running power, cadence, ground contact time, stride length, vertical oscillation and vertical ratio
  • Incident detection uses the internal sensors to detect if an accident has occurred. In the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your paired smartphone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, letting you see your total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep in Connect
  • Free Garmin Connect™ app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more, all via Bluetooth connection to your phone
  • Bright colour touch screen plus an intuitive button layout
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 42 hours in GPS mode or 8 hours in GPS and music mode, 80 hours in UltraTrac mode and up to 15 days in smartwatch mode
  • In the box: Forerunner 955, charging cable and documentation

description:
Smartphone convenience in a rugged package, ready for life’s adventures, and misadventures. The 66i merges Garmin’s background in handheld GPS, with their inReach satellite communication, blending these technologies into a compact device for navigation and communication way, way off-grid. The Iridium satellite network lets you send and receive text messages and emails anywhere on the planet (subscription required). Each message contains your GPS location data, so followers can track your adventures. If things take a turn for the worse, a dedicated SOS button means that help is never out of range. Preloaded with TOPO maps for Canada and the US, the 66i helps smooth out bumps in backcountry navigation, and you can plan your trip on a computer or phone with the free Garmin Explore™ app. Use Explore to map your adventure then send your planned routes and tracks to your 66i, no cell network required. Explore is not the only app that makes life with the 66i better, the free Connect™ app works with your smartphone and opens up a whole new side of the 66i. Connect lets you review activities, set-up live tracking sessions, monitor weather, review satellite imagery, receive notifications and more.

  • Preloaded with Canadian and US topographical maps
  • Garmin Explore website and app let you synch routes, tracks and waypoints to your device. You can download map data to your phone and use your phone to plan routes and tracks, and then send those plans to your 66i, all without cell reception
  • LiveTrack™ (through a connected smartphone) and MapShare® (through your Iridium subscription) allows you to share your location and more, with friends, family, or followers
  • World SOS coverage that gives you a confirmation message from the rescue centre, letting you know help is on the way. 2-way texting allows you to stay in contact with rescue personnel
  • SOS messages are received by GEOS, a worldwide emergency response center with 24/7/365 staffing
  • SOS button has a hard-plastic cover, to prevent an accidental activation
  • Uses Iridium’s constellation of 66 satellites for coverage of the earth's entire surface. Messages are buffered for up to a day
  • Iridium’s worldwide coverage lets you send texts and emails from anywhere in the world, how many you send and how detailed they are, depends on what level plan you have
  • Messages have your GPS location embedded, letting your rescuers, friends, family or followers know exactly where you are
  • SOS/PLB functionality and all off-grid communication requires a separate satellite plan to activate, GPS functionality works all the time, no plan required
  • Monthly plans are available, as well as seasonal hibernation options that allow you to pay a minimal fee during months when you are not using the device
  • Active weather provides real-time radar tracking, via a connected smartphone running Garmin Connect. When not connected to your phone’s cellular network, detailed weather forecasts for your location, a specific waypoint, or a GPS coordinate, can be accessed via your Iridium satellite plan
  • Free Garmin Connect mobile app allows you to customize your 66i experience, choosing which widgets to show and when, reviewing stored activity data, selecting which apps can push notifications, loading and synching geocaching data and more
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts, etc.) come in via Bluetooth connection to your smartphone
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields and other features
  • Preloaded with a free trial of the Wikiloc app, that has more than 9 million trails available
  • Connects to GPS and Galileo satellite constellations for fast signal acquisition and a strong connection nearly anywhere
  • Satellite caching allows your 66i to save an extended predicted orbit path (EPO) file, this way it knows where to look for satellites when you turn it on, meaning a fast and accurate satellite signal
  • Bluetooth Smart, ANT+ and Wi-Fi compatibility let you explore smarter with compatible activity sensors and accessories
  • Barometric altimeter helps you track your ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Tilt compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you are stationary, ensuring that you are always facing the right direction
  • Rechargeable internal battery pack delivers up to 35 hours of battery life with 10-minute logging, or 200 hours with 30-minute logging
  • Large 3 in. screen is bright and clear making it easy to read in all conditions, even direct sun
  • 16GB of internal memory can be increased via MicroSD cards (not included)
  • IPX7 waterproofing protects your 66i from even the heaviest downpours
  • Built-in LED flashlight helps you get back safe if you get caught out after dark, there is even an S.O.S. mode should things take turn for the worse
  • In the box: GPSMAP 66i preloaded with TOPO Canada and US maps, USB cable, carabiner clip and documentation

description:
Maybe “off the grid” isn’t such a big deal. The Yeti 3000X gives you portable power – anywhere. Lightweight lithium batteries offer on-grid convenience without any of the fumes or noise of a generator. Wi-Fi integration lets you use the free Yeti app to check charge and discharge rates, turn ports on or off, monitor temperatures, update firmware and much more, from anywhere you have a signal. Or, if your phone isn't within reach, find the same information in the onboard digital display. With a full suite of charging ports, you can charge or run almost anything, from power tools out in the field, to an actual fridge in your camp kitchen.

  • Upgraded 2000W AC (3500W surge) inverter can power even the most power-hungry household devices
  • Wi-Fi lets you control the Yeti 3000X remotely, so you can check charging and discharging status, update firmware, turn ports on or off, and much more
  • LCD power status display for power use, battery charge capacity and time remaining under current load
  • Charges via included wall charger, going from 0 to full in 14 hours, or 6-72 hours from a compatible solar panel (bigger and more efficient panels take less time)
  • MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracker) technology enables more efficient charging via solar panels in low-light conditions
  • Li-NMC (lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide) battery offers a longer life than standard lithium-ion batteries and better inherent safety, and they're lighter than lead-acid batteries
  • Battery can be kept plugged into a power source during storage, or fully charge your Yeti 3000X Lithium every 3-6 months and store in a cool, dry place
  • Included Yeti cart makes moving your power from A-to-B a whole lot easier
  • Peak capacity is 3032 Wh (10.8V, 280.8Ah) and lasts through hundreds of cycles
  • Smart management system provides charging (solar or mains) and low-battery protection built-in
  • 4 USB ports (output): 2 x type-A at 5V, up to 2.4A (12W max), 2 x USB-C 1 at 5V, up to 3.0A (18W max), and 1 at USB-PD spec 5–20V up to 3.0A (60W max), all ports are regulated
  • 6mm port (output): 12V, up to 13A (120W max)
  • 12V car port (output): 12V, up to 13A (120W max)
  • 12V power pole port (output): 12V, up to 30A (360W max)
  • AC inverter (output, 60Hz, pure sine wave): 120VAC 16.5A (2000W, 3500W surge)
  • Provides pass-through power, so you can plug your Yeti into the wall and then your device into your Yeti to make sure your device stays powered should the power go out
  • Charging port (input, 8mm):14-50V, up to 10A (150W max)
  • Power-pole charging port (input): 14-50V, up to 50A 600W max)
  • Expansion port in the storage compartment, for use ONLY with Goal Zero modules
  • Storage compartment keeps cables and adapters close and where you need them
  • Operating temp is 0-40°C
  • Includes a Goal Zero Yeti 3000X Lithium Power Station, Yeti Cart and a wall charger
  • Do not attempt to charge your yeti lithium from a 12v source with anything but the yeti 12v car charging cable (sold separately). Doing so may cause damage to the unit
title: Goal Zero Yeti 3000X Portable Power Station

description:
Now Garmin not only watches for oncoming vehicles, it records them. The latest addition to the Varia line gets the addition of a camera. By pairing a video footage with the same rear facing radar that has been keeping riders safe for years, the RCT715 is like eyes in the back of your helmet. Much like a dashcam, the RCT715 can detect if an incident has occurred. Video is saved before, during and after the incident, even if you have the camera recording turned off. Each video is stamped with the date, time, location, and speed of the incident, giving you a little video evidence, just in case. Through the connection to your Edge or phone, the Varia radar adds an approaching car display on the screen. Great for long rides on quiet roads where you might need the RCT715 to snap you back to the reality of an approaching vehicle. The powerful LED makes sure that drivers are aware of you. When riding busy streets, the radar will tell you what you already know – you’re surrounded by cars, but you can still use it as a standalone bike light. Complete control is at your fingertips with the free phone app, or you compatible bike computer.

  • 1080p or 720p video at 30 frames per second with a 140° viewing angle
  • Free Varia app lets you choose recoding length, recording mode, overlays, audio, and more
  • Colour coded approaching vehicle display, green shows you're in the clear, yellow indicates a car at a normal speed, red when a car is approaching quickly
  • Display minimizes when no cars are around, for a full screen view of your Edge unit. Display pops out to show approaching vehicle until it passes
  • Audible alerts are also an option, where the beeps increase in frequency as the car approaches
  • 140m range lets you see cars long before you can hear them
  • Tracks multiple vehicles at a time, up to 6 – each represented by a white dot on the display
  • 4 lighting modes: steady 20 lumens (4h), peloton 8 lumens (5h), night flash 29 lumens (4h), and day flash 65 lumens (6h) – with 1080p recording
  • Peloton mode dims your light when riding in a pack
  • Up to 65 lumens and a 220° viewing angle
  • USB-C charging lets you top-up your taillight nearly anywhere
  • LED charging indicator lets you know how your light’s battery is doing, both charging and discharging
  • IPX7 waterproofing protects your RCT715 from even the heaviest downpours
  • 16GB microSD card included (up to 128GB cards supported)
  • Tool-free mount is easy to swap between bikes
  • Locking bike mount keeps your RCT715 secure
  • In the box: Varia RCT715, mounting kit (fits both round and aero seat posts), cables and documentation

description:
Get a clear view of where you’re going, on the trail and on your fitness journey. By learning some of the best features from Garmin’s fēnix and Forerunner line, and tossing in a few new ones, the epix has evolved. One of the epix Pro’s new features tackles the challenge of balancing GPS power and battery life. By matching your GPS signal to your terrain, SatIQ optimizes your runtime; flat land gets a low power signal, head into the mountains and your signal is boosted. The onboard multiband GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While the optical heart rate monitor and other sensors pay attention to how you train. When your favourite runs feel too easy, Hill score shows you why, breaking down the evolution of your running power and endurance. On those days you want to train but don’t have a workout in mind, the morning report is there. Each morning you get a summary of sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and a personalized daily workout. When you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through the free Garmin Connect app. And, classic smartwatch features help you stay connected, stream music, receive notifications, track the weather and more.

  • AMOLED screen is easy to read in any light, with deep blacks and vibrant colours
  • Smaller case watches are more comfortable and provide a more accurate heart rate signal on smaller wrists
  • Lightweight titanium bezel is paired with a virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face
  • Preloaded with routable North American TopoActive maps, with other regions available for free download
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym activities, skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations guide you through proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • SatIQ™ matches your current environment with the right GPS mode, optimizing battery life
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (via a phone) allows you to share your location and metrics
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the epix Pro will use tracks from other Garmin users to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Hill score displays your running strength and endurance, tracking your progress over time
  • Endurance score analyzes training data to map improvements to your overall endurance
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and provides a personalized daily workout
  • Training readiness, training status, and training load modes use data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Acute load compares recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Running dynamics info provides running power, cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor for constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor, real-time stamina tracking, and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) is a great tool to predict recovery and training response
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food)
  • Incident detection: in the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Stream music via a paired phone using Spotify, Deezer, or Amazon Music. Or, download playlists and podcasts, you can even drag and drop MP3s
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, providing total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep
  • Automatically sync your data to the free Garmin Connect app
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Flashlight with white and red light
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 10 hours with multi-band GPS, 28 hours with standard GPS, or up to 14 days in smartwatch mode

description:
Outfitted with a dual-band GPS, more memory, and an improved screen, Wahoo has made a good computer even better. With its intuitive navigation and preloaded maps, the ROAM lets you spend less time in menus and more time riding. Bundled with the TICKR heartrate sensor and RPM speed and cadence sensors this package offers complete metrics for performance cyclists. Standby features like the quick-read LED bezel, Strava segment integration and sleek out the front mount, make the ROAM a formidable addition to your cockpit. The dual-band GPS gives your computer more satellites than even to choose from, so you get a strong signal nearly anywhere. GPS provides speed and distance information, while a barometric altimeter covers ascent, decent, and grade. Equipped with ANT+, Bluetooth Smart and WiFi, there are a wide variety of sensors to tell you more about how you ride. When trainer season rolls around the ROAM is ready. Seamless smart trainer integration means the ROAM can take control of your smart trainer and help keep you in shape during the off-season. The free companion app makes set-up and customization easy. The app lets you choose how and where your rides are uploaded, what notifications are sent to your ROAM, what maps you have on your device and more.

  • TICKR heartrate belt sends data over both ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, letting it talk to a range of products. Heartrate data adds precise calorie data, training zones, and more
  • RPM speed and cadence magnet-less sensors send data over both ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart. RPM sensors add precise speed and cadence data, on the go, or standing still
  • Preloaded with a fully routable mapset, including street and trail names
  • Detailed re-routing is there for you should you get off course with turn-by-turn directions to get you back on track
  • Route-to-start mode finds the shortest way back to where you started or to where your planned ride begins
  • Summit mode displays the climbs on your route, displaying the grade, the total ascent, your real-time progress and an elevation profile
  • Dual-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, BEIDOU, Galileo, QZSS, SBAS, NavIC) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Free ELEMNT companion app lets you set-up different profiles, customize your ELEMNT ROAM and greatly opens up functionality, allowing you to synch routes, use apps (Strava, RideWithGPS, BestBikeSplit, Komoot, etc.) relay notifications, import .GPX, .TCX, or .FIT files and much more
  • Strava Live Segments lets you know when your starred segments are about to begin (via your phone). Real-time performance is displayed and how it compares to your PR and the current KOM or QOM, and then provides results (Strava premium required)
  • Live Tracking during activities (via your phone) allows you to share your location, speed, and more
  • Compatible with downloadable planned workouts that will take you through various fitness tests or training rides
  • Preloaded with 5 structured workouts for you to do indoors or outdoors – 2 FTP tests and 3 workouts
  • TrainerRoad, TrainingPeaks and Today’s Plan are fully integrated with ELEMNT ROAM, allowing you to download and upload rides and workouts
  • Pre-loaded with maps of North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, South America, and Africa. Maps for Russia and China can be downloaded over WiFi
  • Route sharing with other ELMNT users, letting you easily send planned routes on the fly
  • Group ride functionality displays other ELEMNT users on the map
  • Mountain bike features allow you to synch your To-Do List from MTB Project and your Wishlist from Singletracks to your ELEMNT ROAM from your phone over WiFi or Bluetooth
  • Configurable 12 LED display can relay various information, from navigation cues, power and heart rate zones, to acting as an alert light for notifications
  • Trainer support lets you control your smart trainer, with specific modes for Wahoo smart trainers. Non-Wahoo smart trainers equipped with ANT+ FE-C can also be controlled
  • Compatible with Supersapiens continuous glucose monitor and other ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart sensors, letting you greatly increase your available metrics
  • Works with electronic shifting systems: Shimano Di2, SRAM eTAP, FSA WE, and Campagnolo EPS
  • USB rechargeable battery has up to 17 hours of battery life while running GPS and external sensors
title: Wahoo Fitness Elemnt Roam V2 Bundle

description:
CNC machined from a block of grade 5 titanium and topped with a domed sapphire crystal, wrapped with a hardened ceramic bezel, the Marq is the best GPS smartwatch that Garmin can make. Know where you’re going, on the trail and on your fitness journey, the Marq gives you the power to live smarter. Built on the do-it-all Epix platform, you get everything you’d expect Garmin’s flagship to have. SatIQ tackles the challenge of balancing GPS power and battery life, automatically matching your signal to your environment. The onboard multiband GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While the optical heart rate monitor and other sensors pay attention to how you train. When your runs feel too easy, the Marq shows you why, breaking down the evolution of your running power and endurance. Each morning you are greeted with your morning report. This provides a summary of sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and a personalized daily workout. When you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through Garmin Connect. And, classic smartwatch features help you stay connected, stream music, receive notifications, track the weather and more.

  • Grade 5 titanium case is more durable than the grade 4, used on the fēnix and Epix lines
  • Sapphire crystal face and ceramic bezel are virtually scratchproof
  • Bezel features indices to track VO2 max and recovery time
  • AMOLED touchscreen has deep blacks and vibrant colours
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym activities, skiing (2000+ ski resort maps), golf (preloaded with 43,000 courses) and more
  • Activity animations guide you through proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • SatIQ™ matches your environment with the right GPS mode; flat land gets a low power signal, head into the mountains and your signal is boosted
  • Jetlag advisor predicts jetlag effects based on number of time zones crossed and offers suggestions to minimize the impact
  • Free TopoActive maps provide turn-by-turn directions in the city, and features like Nextfork™ keep you on track in the backcountry
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (via a phone) shares your location and metrics
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and data from other Garmin users is used to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Hill score displays your running strength and endurance, tracking your progress over time
  • Endurance score maps improvements to your overall endurance
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and provides a personalized daily workout
  • Training readiness, training status, and training load modes use data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Running dynamics info provides running power, cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your activity, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, how much more you have to go
  • Elevate™ v.4 optical heart rate monitor provides constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, acute load, race predictor, recovery advisor, real-time stamina tracking, and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) is used to predict recovery and training response
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food)
  • Stream music via a paired phone using Spotify, Deezer, or Amazon Music. Or, download playlists and podcasts
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, providing total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth: foot pods, speed and cadence pods, Varia lights, Rally power meters, etc
  • Lightweight silicone strap can handle even the harshest environments
  • Fast charge USB-C charging cable charges to 100% in less than 1 hour (vs. 2.5 hours for the fēnix and Epix)
  • Rechargeable battery lasts up to 20 hours with multi-band GPS, 42 hours with standard GPS, or up to 16 days in smartwatch mode

description:
In a world where something always needs charging, wouldn’t it be nice if your Edge didn’t? By incorporating efficient solar technology into these Edge units, Garmin lets you spend more time riding and less time charging. Building on GPS technology from the Fenix line, the latest Edge computers give you access to more satellites and more signals than ever before. These updates give you a stronger GPS connection anywhere you ride, from forests, to valleys of glass and steel. Free detailed maps provide turn-by-turn directions to local points of interest, so if there is gelato close by, you’ll find it. Garmin has incorporated their popularity routing into the latest map set, letting you ride the local’s favourite roads and trails, anywhere you go. Pre-loaded with TrailForks, you get access to incredible trail maps right on your Edge. description:
Get a clear view of where you’re going, on the trail and on your fitness journey. By learning some of the best features from Garmin’s fēnix and Forerunner line, and tossing in a few new ones, the epix has evolved. One of the epix Pro’s new features tackles the challenge of balancing GPS power and battery life. By matching your GPS signal to your terrain, SatIQ optimizes your runtime; flat land gets a low power signal, head into the mountains and your signal is boosted. The onboard multiband GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While the optical heart rate monitor and other sensors pay attention to how you train. When your favourite runs feel too easy, Hill score shows you why, breaking down the evolution of your running power and endurance. On those days you want to train but don’t have a workout in mind, the morning report is there. Each morning you get a summary of sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and a personalized daily workout. When you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through the free Garmin Connect app. And, classic smartwatch features help you stay connected, stream music, receive notifications, track the weather and more.

  • AMOLED screen is easy to read in any light, with deep blacks and vibrant colours
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym activities, skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations guide you through proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • SatIQ™ matches your current environment with the right GPS mode, optimizing battery life
  • Free downloadable routable TopoActive maps
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (via a phone) allows you to share your location and metrics
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the epix Pro will use tracks from other Garmin users to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Hill score displays your running strength and endurance, tracking your progress over time
  • Endurance score analyzes training data to map improvements to your overall endurance
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and provides a personalized daily workout
  • Training readiness, training status, and training load modes use data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Acute load compares recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Running dynamics info provides running power, cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor for constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor, real-time stamina tracking, and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) is a great tool to predict recovery and training response
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food)
  • Incident detection: in the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Stream music via a paired phone using Spotify, Deezer, or Amazon Music. Or, download playlists and podcasts, you can even drag and drop MP3s
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, providing total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep
  • Automatically sync your data to the free Garmin Connect app
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Flashlight with white and red light
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 38 hours with multi-band GPS, 82 hours with standard GPS, or up to 31 days in smartwatch mode
title: Garmin Epix PRO 51mm

description:
Bring the luxury of power to your adventure van, base camp or remote cabin. Known for its reliable and rugged power solutions, Goal Zero is a household, van-hold and yurt-hold name among off-grid adventurers. The Yeti 1500X lives up to expectations, using lightweight (vs. lead-acid) lithium batteries to give you on-grid convenience no matter where you are, without any of the fumes or noise of a generator. Wifi integration lets you use the free Yeti app to check charge and discharge rates, turn ports on or off, monitor temperatures, update firmware and much more, from anywhere you have a signal. The onboard digital display shows you the same information, in case you don't want to reach for your phone. Tons of female charging ports, including 12V (car cigarette lighter), 6mm plug, power pole plug, 2 x USB type C (one is even set-up for USB-PD), 2 x USB type A, and 2 x AC that accepts grounded and ungrounded plugs, let you charge or run almost anything, from blenders and freezers for backcountry margaritas, to a to laptop and projector for wall-sized movies at the cabin.

  • Wifi lets you control the Yeti 1500X remotely to check charging and discharging status, update firmware, turn ports on or off and much more
  • LCD power status display tells you how much power you're getting and using, as well as battery charge capacity and time remaining under current load
  • Charges easily via included wall charger, going from 0 to full in 14 hours, or 3-72 hours from compatible solar panels (bigger and more efficient panels take less time)
  • MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracker) technology enables a 30% more efficient charging via Goal Zero solar panels in low-light conditions
  • Li-NMC (lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide) battery offers a longer life than standard lithium-ion batteries and better inherent safety
  • Battery can be kept plugged into a power source during storage, or fully charge your Yeti 1500X every 3-6 months and store in a cool, dry place
  • Peak capacity is 1516Wh (10.8V, 140.4Ah), which lasts through hundreds of cycles
  • Smart management system provides charging (solar or mains) and built-in low-battery protection
  • 4 USB ports (output): 2 x type-A at 5V, up to 2.4A (12W max), USB-C 5-12V up to 3.0A (18W max), USB-C PD 5-20V up to 3.0A (60W max), All ports are regulated
  • 6mm port (output): 12V, up to 10A (120W max)
  • 12V car port (output): 12V, up to 13A (160W max)
  • 12V power pole port (output): 12V, up to 30A (360W max)
  • AC inverter (output, 60Hz, pure sine wave): 120VAC, 16.5A (2000W, 3500W surge)
  • Provides pass-through power, so you can plug your Yeti into the wall and then your device into your Yeti, making sure your device stays charged should the power go out
  • Charging port (input, 8mm):14-50V, up to 10A (120W max)
  • Power pole charging port (input): 14-50V, up to 50A (600W max)
  • Expansion port in the storage compartment for use ONLY with Goal Zero modules
  • Storage compartment keeps cables and adapters close at hand
  • Operating temp is 0-40°C
  • In the box: Goal Zero Yeti 1500X Lithium Power Station with Wifi and a wall charger
  • DO NOT ATTEMPT TO CHARGE YOUR YETI LITHIUM FROM A 12V SOURCE. Doing so may cause damage to the unit
title: Goal Zero Yeti 1500X Portable Power Station

description:

Building on GPS technology from the Fenix line, the latest Edge computers give you access to more satellites and more signals than ever before. These updates give you a stronger GPS connection anywhere you ride, from forests, to valleys of glass and steel. Free detailed maps provide turn-by-turn directions to local points of interest, so if there is gelato close by, you’ll find it. Garmin has incorporated their popularity routing into the latest map set, letting you ride the local’s favourite roads and trails, anywhere you go. Pre-loaded with TrailForks, you get access to incredible trail maps right on your Edge. Real-time Strava segment integration displays nearby segments, showing how you compare to your PR and the current KOM or QOM. When connected to your phone via the free Garmin Connect app, you can receive notifications, download training plans, review activities, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • Updated bike type specific mapping uses Garmin Connect’s database of rider’s routes and tracks, finding you the most popular way to get where you’re going, on road or off
  • Free global maps, with North America on the device and more regions downloadable for free from Garmin Express™, providing turn-by-turn routing
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places like restaurants, attractions, hospitals, accommodation, and more
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite caching gives you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your ride, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, remaining ascent, and displays an elevation profile (no course required)
  • Power specific features like targeted coaching: how you’re performing on that ride and at that moment, on-the-fly recommended power targets, and cycling ability information that highlights strengths and weaknesses. Note – these features require a not included power meter
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TrailForks™ integration for access to TrailForks trail database without a cell connection
  • Strava Segment integration (requires premium) preloaded or on-the-fly via your phone, shows starred segments and results
  • Live Tracking during activities (via phone) allows you to share your location, speed, course and more, with friends, family, or coaches
  • Training plan takes you through the details of your ride: weather conditions, food and water requirements based on your fitness levels – with reminders when you should drink and eat, and more
  • Environmental factors like heat and altitude acclimation are taken into consideration when calculating performance and recovery metrics
  • Training status and daily suggested workouts help you optimize your training, guiding you where you need to push and where you may need to dial it back
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max estimate, lactate threshold, race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • HRM-Dual, and Speed and Cadence sensors use both Bluetooth™ and ANT+™ communication
  • HRM-Dual soft chest strap is comfortable and accurate, adding another layer of precision to your training data
  • Speed sensor tracks rides without phone or bike computer and synchs when in range
  • Sensors are easy to install, maintain and move between bikes
  • Speed Sensor attaches to a standard hub on either wheel and self-calibrates for accurate speed and distance while stationary (on a trainer) or on the move
  • Cadence Sensor fastens to any crank arm size and measures pedal strokes per minute
  • Bike alarm mode sounds a loud, shrill, attention getting alarm if your bike is touched
  • Incident detection uses accelerometers to detect accident and uses you phone to send a signal to predefined emergency contacts
  • inReach® compatibility, connect to an inReach for messaging and SOS support when off the grid
  • Simplified user interface puts less in between you and that first ride
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields, and other features
  • Free Garmin Connect app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more

Is a no-compromise touring boot possible? Can it be amazing on the climb, but responsive and stiff on the descent? The Hoji Pro Tour is all that – and then some. Switch from tour to ski mode by flipping a single lever. For real: no messing around with power straps, tightening buckles and fixing your pant cuffs. Instead of relying on a pin to lock the cuff, the innovative Hoji Lock System uses a sliding tongue-in-groove spine to lock things up. This design allows the cuff to be supported by the shell directly, resulting in a stiff and much more progressive flex. When you switch to walk mode, the sliding spine is pulled up and out of the way to allow a 55° range of motion. The same ski/walk lever also controls the upper buckle.

  • Cuff and buckle catches prevent unwanted release
  • Master Step tech inserts allows for incredibly easy step-in to your bindings
  • 11 degrees of forward lean in ski mode provides a solid stance

  • Preloaded with road-routable TopoActive maps (Canada and US 100K resolution), featuring streets and trails, making front-country or backcountry navigation a lot easier

  • Integrated antenna for outstanding signal reception from GPS and GLONASS satellites

description:

An efficient solar panel could make charging a thing of the past. Regional TopoActive maps help you find your way or plan your route home or abroad. These watches blend smartwatch functionality with advanced heart rate-based training tools and a backcountry GPS. Onboard sensors breakdown every movement, comparing how often and how hard you train, how you rest, and even where you train – factoring in altitude and temperature. The data lets you map the evolution of your fitness, from stamina to improved recovery times. Sync to the free Connect app on your phone to download training plans, review activities, stream music, receive texts, social media alerts and emails, track weather and more. If you drop your keys or return late to camp, the integrated LED light cuts through darkness.

  • Lightweight titanium bezel and case back; virtually scratchproof Power Sapphire™ crystal face

  • Built-in modes for biking (road and mountain), running, swimming (indoor and out), multisport, HIIT (AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata and custom), climbing (bouldering and route, with selectable grading systems and difficulty), gym (strength training, cardio and elliptical, stair stepping, rowing and yoga), surfing (with SurfLine® integration) golfing (42,000+ course maps), skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations show proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga with preloaded structured workouts. And, more than 1600 exercise animations in the Connect app, so you can develop your own personalized workouts
  • Preloaded North American TopoActive map data with other continents downloadable for free
  • Up ahead feature offers at a glance performance metrics and a summary of upcoming trail features
  • Turn-by-turn and point of interest navigation
  • Round-trip mapping: choose a distance and get course options that start and stop in the same spot – great for set-distance runs
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin user’s route data to find the most popular route
  • Stream and download using Spotify (premium required), Amazon Music, and more, or add MP3s from your computer
  • Holds up to 2000 songs so you can leave the phone at home, just pair your Bluetooth™ headphones and hit play
  • Synched playlists can be updated via Wi-Fi

  • Multiband signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data

description:

An efficient solar panel could make charging a thing of the past. Loaded with regional TopoActive maps, the fēnix Sapphire Solar editions help you find your way or plan your route, at home or abroad. These watches blend smartwatch functionality with advanced heart rate-based training tools and a backcountry GPS. Onboard sensors breakdown every movement, comparing it to how often and how hard you train, how you rest, and even where you train – factoring in altitude and temperature. The data lets you map the evolution of your fitness, from stamina improvements to recovery times. And when synced to the free Connect app on your phone to download training plans, review activities, stream music, receive texts, social media alerts and emails, track weather and more.

  • Lightweight titanium bezel and case back paired with a virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face
  • Touchscreen plus an intuitive button layout
  • Solar panel charges 8 hours to 116 days or longer – runtime is feature dependent
  • Sun gauge displays solar charge status
  • Built-in modes for biking (road and mountain), running, swimming (indoor and out), multisport, HIIT (AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata and custom), climbing (bouldering and route, with selectable grading systems and difficulty), gym (strength training, cardio and elliptical, stair stepping, rowing and yoga), surfing (with SurfLine® integration) golfing (42,000+ course maps), skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations show proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga with preloaded structured workouts. And, more than 1600 exercise animations in the Connect app, so you can develop your own personalized workouts
  • Preloaded North American TopoActive map data with other continents downloadable for free
  • Up ahead feature offers at a glance performance metrics and a summary of upcoming trail features
  • Turn-by-turn and point of interest navigation
  • Round-trip mapping: choose a distance and get course options that start and stop in the same spot – great for set-distance runs
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin user’s route data to find the most popular route
  • Stream and download using Spotify (premium required), Amazon Music, and more, or add MP3s from your computer
  • Holds up to 2000 songs so you can leave the phone at home, just pair your Bluetooth™ headphones and hit play
  • Synched playlists can be updated via Wi-Fi
  • ClimbPro™ shows grade, total ascent and current position on an elevation profile
  • PacePro™, set your desired pace, then compare it to your distance splits, the Fēnix 7 compares your needed pace vs your goal pace for each split and for the course

  • Garmin Pay™, make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)

  • Multiband signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data

  • Pre-set and custom power profiles let you maximize your battery’s power

Longtime Garmin users will appreciate little touches, like a machined aluminum quarter-turn mount, and the change to USB-C. When connected to the free Garmin Connect™ app you can use your favourite fitness apps, receive notifications, download training plans and personalize daily workouts, review activities, and even keep an eye on the weather.

  • Up ahead feature shows upcoming cafes, viewpoints, etc. and provides ETA

  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail

description:
Updated with ACR’s Return link service, or RLS, this new generation of ResQLink View gives you confirmation that your distress call and location have been received, adding a little peace of mind when you need it most. The ResQLink View RLS displays your exact GPS coordinates and lets you know the help is on the way. Activation is simple: deploy the antenna and press the ON button. A 66-channel GPS signal calculates your position within 100 metres. Transmitting your location to first responders to the MEOSAR satellite constellation via the 406Mhz frequency. The beacon also broadcasts a local signal on 121.5 MHz that searchers can pinpoint once they're in your vicinity.

No paid subscription is required. The only additional expense is replacing the battery every 5 years. If you need to use the ResQLink View RLS, ACR will replace it with a PLB of equal or greater value in return for the old beacon and your rescue story.

  • RLS provides confirmation, both on the screen and via blue flashing light, that that your distress call and location have been received by search and rescue personnel
  • Screen displays the beacon’s status and GPS coordinates throughout the rescue operation
  • Broadcasts SOS to government funded satellite networks, so there is no monthly fee
  • Transmits a unique identifier, registered with the Rescue Coordination Centre, to speed response time and lets SAR teams know what to look for
  • MEOSAR compatibility means faster response time, an average of 46 minutes faster than previous LEOSAR beacons
  • Simple 1-button operation is easy to in the worst conditions, just release the antenna and push the on/off button
  • 66-channel GPS signal guides rescuers within 100m of your location (GPS and Galileo networks), the homing frequency and strobe bring them the rest of the way
  • UV resistant, durable polycarbonate composite housing
  • A built-in LED strobe and IR strobe help rescuers on final approach at night or in low visibility
  • Batteries are tested for a ~28 hour runtime at -20°C, are good for a total of 60 self-tests/20 GPS tests, and last for 5 years on standby. Batteries should be replaced after emergency use
  • Waterproof to 5m for 1 hour and 10 metres for 10 minutes. buoyant design exceeds RTCM waterproof requirements
  • Approvals: Cospas-Sarsat, FCC, USCG/NOAA, RED (Europe), AMSA (Australia), New Zealand, Canada
  • Included multi position clip system lets you put the beacon right where you want it
  • 5-year manufacturer warranty
  • Free registration is required with the Canadian Beacon Registry to ensure pertinent information about you, your group, travel plans, and medical history is available. Information can be updated at any time through canadianbeaconregistry.forces.gc.ca
title: ACR ResQLink View RLS

description:
Get a clear view of where you’re going, on the trail and on your fitness journey. By learning some of the best features from Garmin’s fēnix and Forerunner line, and tossing in a few new ones, the epix has evolved. One of the epix Pro’s new features tackles the challenge of balancing GPS power and battery life. By matching your GPS signal to your terrain, SatIQ optimizes your runtime; flat land gets a low power signal, head into the mountains and your signal is boosted. The onboard multiband GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While the optical heart rate monitor and other sensors pay attention to how you train. When your favourite runs feel too easy, Hill score shows you why, breaking down the evolution of your running power and endurance. On those days you want to train but don’t have a workout in mind, the morning report is there. Each morning you get a summary of sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and a personalized daily workout. When you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through the free Garmin Connect app. And, classic smartwatch features help you stay connected, stream music, receive notifications, track the weather and more.

  • AMOLED screen is easy to read in any light, with deep blacks and vibrant colours
  • Lightweight titanium bezel is paired with a virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face
  • Preloaded with routable North American TopoActive maps, with other regions available for free download
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym activities, skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations guide you through proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • SatIQ™ matches your current environment with the right GPS mode, optimizing battery life
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (via a phone) allows you to share your location and metrics
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the epix Pro will use tracks from other Garmin users to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Hill score displays your running strength and endurance, tracking your progress over time
  • Endurance score analyzes training data to map improvements to your overall endurance
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and provides a personalized daily workout
  • Training readiness, training status, and training load modes use data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Acute load compares recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Running dynamics info provides running power, cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor for constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor, real-time stamina tracking, and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) is a great tool to predict recovery and training response
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food)
  • Incident detection: in the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Stream music via a paired phone using Spotify, Deezer, or Amazon Music. Or, download playlists and podcasts, you can even drag and drop MP3s
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, providing total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep
  • Automatically sync your data to the free Garmin Connect app
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Flashlight with white and red light
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 38 hours with multi-band GPS, 82 hours with standard GPS, or up to 31 days in smartwatch mode

description:
The second generation Apex offers an improved GPS, free downloadable worldwide maps, a more precise heart rate monitor, music, and more. Thanks to a new GPS chipset and updated antenna design, you now get a single frequency connection to up to 5 satellite constellations. More connections, means better reception and more accurate tracks of your runs, rides, and swims. Outfitted with the next evolution in Coros’ optical heart rate monitor technology, the Apex 2 provides the most precise pulse metrics ever seen on a Coros device. Preloaded with dozens of sport profiles, for both indoor and outdoor activities, there’s a mode for everyone. While you use the Apex 2, it learns how you train, letting you know how to adjust your workout schedule and intensity, it will even let you know when you should take a rest day. No matter how hard you crush in in the gym or on the trails, there are factors we just can’t control, like the weather. The onboard barometer tracks environmental pressure changes, alerting you when a storm is on its way. And daily sun tracking lets you know how much daylight you have left, as well as sunrise and sunset times. Robust smartwatch functionality will keep the Apex 2 on your wrist outside of training hours. When synced with a phone running the free COROS app, you can receive texts, social media alerts and email, share and download workouts, review activities, and more.

  • Sport profiles include: running (indoor, outdoor and trail), cycling (indoor and outdoor), swimming (pool and open water), triathlon, gym cardio, strength training, hiking, snowsports and more
  • Multisport mode lets you transition between different activities within a single workout
  • Strength training program has more than 200 exercises, selectable muscle groups, auto-detects reps, counts sets and provides a comprehensive breakdown in the app with body-mapped exercise tracking, including how many reps you did for each muscle group
  • Integrated running power meter
  • Updated optical heart rate monitor uses an array of LEDs and sensors to provide more precise heart rate data than previous generations and can even provide blood oxygenation levels (SpO2)
  • Recovery advisor prevents over-training and helps maximize training intervals
  • Advanced training metrics: training status, 7-day load, race predictor (5k, 10k, half and full marathon), training focus, effort pace, and more
  • Free maps are available to download via the Coros web app via your computer
  • Music playback: load your favourite MP3s directly to your watch via USB connection to your computer. Holds up to 2000 songs so you can leave the phone at home, just pair your Bluetooth™ headphones or speaker and hit play
  • Camera control lets you control your action camera right from your wrist. Works with the select GoPro and Insta360 cameras
  • Touchscreen and intuitive dial, lets you scroll or swipe through modes, settings and metrics
  • Intelligent battery profiles provide 7 hours with single band GPS and music, 30 hours with standard GPS, and 17 days in smart watch mode
  • Fast charging can take the watch from 0% to 100% in less than 2 hours
  • Redesigned antenna connects to GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo, and QZSS satellite constellations, reducing connection time by up to 50%
  • Free COROS app has downloadable workouts, workout breakdowns, training plans, activity tracking information, third party training app integration e.g., Strava™, Training Peaks™, etc., watch customization and much more (via your phone’s Bluetooth™ connection)
  • Bluetooth Smart and Wi-Filets let you connect to a variety of different sensors, including: power meters (cycling and running), cadence and speed sensors, foot pods, heart rate belts and more
  • Daily activity tracking with calories burnt, steps, floors climbed and sleep tracking
  • ABC data via internal altimeter, barometer and compass
  • Light and strong titanium bezel with a scratch resistant PVD coating, paired with a virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face, protect the watch and keep your screen easy to read
  • Regular firmware updates add new features and improvements
  • Bright colour screen is easy to see in all conditions and is fully customizable
  • In the box: Apex 2, charging cable and documentation

Previously, if you wanted to ride a binding that performed like a downhill binding in the backcountry, you had to go for frame bindings – and the extra weight and limitations that come with them. Alternatively, if you wanted to take advantage of the lighter weight and freedom of movement that pin bindings offer, you had to sacrifice some of the safety and performance on the downhill. After 7 years of development, Salomon has released a binding that offers the best of both worlds: pins for the climb, step-in bindings for the ride down. At 1.77kg/pair, the S/Lab Shift MNC Bindings could be your one-binding quiver. Pair them with your favorite pair of boots and ski with confidence.

  • Carbon-infused PA is used to create a light and strong binding
  • 47mm of elastic travel prevents pre-release and matches Salomon's flagship STH2 binding
  • Sliding toe pedal allows for compatibility with all norm boots on the market
  • An anti-friction plate ensures reliable release, regardless of your boot type
  • Toe-piece uses pins for touring, and traditional step-in toe for skiing
  • Going from tour to ski is as easy as stepping in a downhill binding
  • Heel uses the same step-down system that is found on most downhill bindings
  • Easy-to-manipulate heel riser allows you to switch from 2° to 10° of rise
  • DIN settings of 6 to 13 offer a range wide enough for most aggressive skiers
  • Certified for downhill and alpine touring boots
  • Recommended for skiers weighing between 66 and 125kg

description:
Designed around your next adventure, the Provincial Trail Bicycle is much more than a road bike with big tires. If you're keen to leave traffic behind and explore gravel roads, this bike is the tool for the job. Its geometry is designed around the 650b wheels and 47mm-wide tires to provide the comfort of bigger-volume tires without messing up the feel of the bike. From the height of the bottom bracket to the shaping of the 7000-series aluminum tubing, no detail was overlooked. Outfitted with Shimano's GRX groupset, designed specifically for the demands of gravel riding. While the Provincial Trail Bike is outfitted with everything you need to go on your next gravel epic, turning this adventure bike into a Gran Fondo–capable one is quite easy. Get yourself a set of 700c road disc wheels with 28mm slick tires and you'll maintain the same bike geometry, but in a fast package that'll help you get your personal best.

  • Light, strong and reliable 7005-series frame is built around a 650B wheelset for a stable and confidence-inspiring ride
  • Internal cable routing uses alloy cable-stops that allow you to customize your setup and add a dropper post should you wish to do so
  • Carbon fibre fork with aluminum steerer features internal cable routing to keep things looking clean
  • Front fork features fender mounts and internal cable routing for a clean and snag-free look
  • Frame is equipped with eyelets for fenders, a rear rack, and 3 bottle cages for those long adventures
  • 12x100mm thru-axle fork and 12x142mm frame makes it easy to switch between these adventure-ready wheels and road-specific ones
  • Frame and fork clearance of 60mm allows for tires that measures up to 50mm in width
  • PF30 bottom bracket shell provides more room for internal cable routing and makes for a future-proof ride
  • Shimano 11-speed GRX drivetrain (600 and 800) pairs 46-30T chain rings with an 11-34T cassette
  • Shimano GRX 400 hydraulic disc brakes provide outstanding power and modulation regardless of weather
  • SLX 160mm rotors use Shimano’s ICE technology, sandwiching an aluminum core between 2 layers of stainless steel for greatly improved cooling, meaning more stopping power
  • GRX 46/30 crank is designed with tighter gear steps to make it easier to maintain and even cadence on the uneven terrain of gravel rides
  • 650b Alex Boondocks 3 wheels are tubeless ready and designed for the rigours of gravel grinds
  • Kenda Alluvium Pro tires are tubeless ready and use a tread that has been designed to maximize handling and speed on mixed terrain, like unpaved roads or potholed city streets
  • MEC carbon fibre post soaks up vibration for a comfortable ride
  • Fizik Aliante R5 saddle helps keep the ride comfortable on long days
  • Bikes are covered by MEC's Rocksolid Guarantee and Bike Service Agreement. You can bring your bike to any MEC bike shop for free adjustments and minor maintenance for a year after purchase
  • MEC bikes are designed in Canada. Everything from the frames to the graphics are developed at the MEC Head Office in Vancouver, BC
  • Due to challenges with supply chain, components may be substituted for comparable parts at any time. The listed build is how MEC intended your bike to arrive, though the manufacturer may need to make a tweak or two to get you riding sooner

description:
