description:
The latest 9-series Forerunner is easier to use than ever, so you get to spend more time doing what you love and less time pushing buttons. Borrowing a couple features from Garmin's fēnix line, the Forerunner 955 gets a touchscreen and an efficient solar panel that might just make charging a thing of the past. The touchscreen makes scrolling and zooming through the pre-loaded maps, or any course you create, feel natural. With more satellites to choose from, the 955’s powerful GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While other sensors pay attention to where you train, not just how you train, factoring elevation and temperature into your performance. The new training readiness feature helps make the most of your training, guiding you away from overtraining or under training, so you reach your fitness goals faster than ever. Each morning the 955 delivers your morning report, summarizing sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and even provides a personalized daily workout suggestion. When you need more information, or motivation, you can download training plans through the free Garmin Connect app. Garmin Connect lets you review activities, receive texts and other notifications, keep an eye on the weather and more. Through the connection to your phone the 955 can connect to multiple music services and can even hold up to 1000 songs. With music and mapping right on your wrist, phone-free runs are looking better and better.

  • Power Glass™ solar panel lets you go longer between charges, from 30 hours to 5 days longer – runtime is feature dependent
  • Sun gauge displays solar charge status
  • Built-in modes for biking, running, swimming (indoor and outdoor), multisport – transition between activities within a single workout at the press of a button, gym focused activities (strength training – with rep counter, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, indoor rowing and yoga) and more
  • Includes North American map data with room to add more maps
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places you may want to go, e.g restaurants, attractions, accommodation, etc
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the 955 will use tracks from other Garmin users to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Stream music through a paired smartphone using Spotify, iHeartRadio, Pandora or Deezer. Or, download playlists and podcasts via your favourite music service, e.g. Spotify (premium account required), you can even drag and drop MP3s from your computer – holds up to 1,000 songs (depending on sound quality)
  • Race widget helps make race day a little less stressful, providing course specific performance info, weather and more
  • Power alerts and lap data can come through to your paired Bluetooth™ headphones
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your activity, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, how much more you have to go and displays an elevation profile, so you know how to pace yourself
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment; by linking credit cards to your Garmin account, you can make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)
  • Strava Segment integration – both preloaded and on-the-fly (through your phone) – lets you know when your starred segment is about to begin and shows instantaneous data, how it compares to your PR and the current KOM or QOM, and then provides results once the segment is complete (requires Strava premium)
  • Connects to 4 different satellite constellations (GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, and Galileo) and caches satellite positions, giving you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal anywhere
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (through a connected smartphone) allows you to share your location and fitness data
  • Pre-set messaging between compatible Garmin units, when combined with Live Tracking, means real-time location and messaging
  • UltraTrac™ mode reduces the GPS recording rate in order to conserve battery, providing up to 80 hours of GPS use
  • Equipped with Garmin’s latest Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides reliable constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max – which takes ambient temperature and altitude into consideration, a race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • Training load and training readiness modes uses data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Compatible with running dynamics sensors (sold separately) for running power, cadence, ground contact time, stride length, vertical oscillation and vertical ratio
  • Incident detection uses the internal sensors to detect if an accident has occurred. In the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your paired smartphone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, letting you see your total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep in Connect
  • Free Garmin Connect™ app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more, all via Bluetooth connection to your phone
  • Bright colour touch screen plus an intuitive button layout
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 49 hours in GPS mode or 8.5 hours in GPS and music mode, 110 hours in UltraTrac mode and up to 20 days in smartwatch mode
  • In the box: Forerunner 955 Solar, charging cable and documentation
title: Garmin Forerunner 955 Solar

description:
Chase your next PR in style. Equipped with a bright and colourful AMOLED touchscreen display, the Forerunner 265 makes your fitness journey look better than ever. In a first for the 200-series Forerunners, the 265 provides running dynamics, including running power, right from your wrist. Heart rate data also comes off your wrist, care of Garmin’s Elevate optical sensor. The onboard multi-band GPS provides information on your speed and distance. And, all these sensors work together, turning your movement into data, giving you get credit for all you do, in the gym, the pool and on the trail. The 265 helps you start your day right, with a personalized morning report. This report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, and training effects, it even offers a daily workout suggestion. Between your morning report and the training readiness feature, the 265 helps you make the most of your training, guiding you away from overtraining or under training. Having the right soundtrack can make the difference between a regular training session, or one that leaves you smiling. When paired with your phone, your Forerunner can stream tunes to your Bluetooth headphones. And if you want to leave your phone on the sidelines… or at home, you can store up to 1000 songs right on your watch. When your phone is connected, a world of smartwatch functionality opens up. Garmin’s Connect app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • AMOLED colour touchscreen has deep blacks and vibrant colours making it crisp, clear, and easy to read in any light
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport – transition between activities within a single workout at the press of a button, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym focused activities (strength training – with rep counter, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, indoor rowing and yoga) and more
  • Stream music through a paired phone using Spotify, iHeartRadio, Pandora or Deezer. Or, download playlists and podcasts via your favourite music service, e.g. Spotify premium, you can even drag and drop MP3s from your computer – holds up to 1000 songs (depending on sound quality)
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite position caching, give you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (through a connected phone) allows you to share your location and heart rate with friends, family, or coaches
  • Race widget helps make race day a little less stressful, providing course specific performance info, weather and more
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and even provides a personalized daily workout suggestion
  • Training readiness and training load modes uses data from your recent workouts to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Running dynamics info right off your wrist, providing running power, cadence, ground contact time, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides reliable constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max – which takes ambient temperature into consideration, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Training status uses data from past workouts to learn your fitness level and tell you how effective your training is
  • Acute load compares the intensity of recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Incident detection uses the internal sensors to detect if an accident has occurred. In the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your paired phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, letting you see your total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep in Connect
  • Automatically sync your data to a paired phone running the free Garmin Connect app
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) come in via Bluetooth connection to your phone
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields, watch faces, and other features
  • Internal memory stores up to hundreds of hours of activities. Garmin Connect will store all of your activity data
  • User-friendly strap changes, thanks to quick-release pins
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 20 hours in GPS mode or up to 13 days in smartwatch mode
  • In the box: Forerunner 265, charging cable and documentation

description:
Go for a backpacking trip, run an ultra, or do a couple triathlons, all on a single charge. Equipped with Garmin’s efficient Power Glass, the fēnix 7 Pro uses the power of the sun to make regular charging a thing of the past. When using the muti-band GPS, Garmin’s SatIQ technology optimizes power usage. SatIQ matches your GPS signal to your environment; flat land gets a low power signal, head into the mountains and the signal is automatically boosted. Free downloadable shaded relief maps help you plan your next trip, and when connected to your phone, can even display live satellite weather. When it comes to navigating your fitness, 24/7 heartrate tracking and other metrics combine to give you a complete picture of how you train, how you recover and how you live. If you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through Garmin’s free Connect app. Connect lets you stream music, receive notifications, track the weather and more. The latest in fēnix line even has a white and red flashlight, making it easier to find your vacation rental’s hidden key.

  • Lightweight titanium bezel is paired with a virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face
  • Power Glass™ solar panel lets you go longer between charges, from 8 hours to 116 days or longer
  • Sun gauge displays solar charge status
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, multisport, swimming, gym activities, team sports, skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations display the proper form for strength training, yoga, etc
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • SatIQ™ matches your current environment with the right GPS mode, optimizing battery life
  • Preloaded with routable North American TopoActive maps, with other regions available for free download
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (via a phone) allows you to share your location and metrics
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the fēnix Pro will calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin’s database of routes to find the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Up ahead offers at a glance performance metrics and upcoming trail features
  • Hill score displays your running strength and endurance, tracking progress over time
  • Endurance score analyzes training data to map improvements to your overall endurance
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and provides a personalized daily workout
  • Training readiness, training status, and training load modes use your training history to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Acute load compares recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Running dynamics info provides running power, cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • PacePro™, GPS based pace guidance that compares your actual pace vs your goal pace
  • Mountain biking dynamics including jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: how smoothly you rode the trail
  • Elevate™ V5 optical heart rate monitor has improved reliability during wrist intensive activities like cycling, weightlifting, etc
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, pulse ox, an improved race predictor (5K, 10K, ½ marathon and marathon), recovery advisor, real-time stamina tracking, and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) helps predict recovery and training response
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains you (exercise) and recharges you (rest, food)
  • Incident detection: in the case of an accident the unit will send a signal via your phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know your location and that you need help
  • Stream music via a paired phone using Spotify, Deezer, or Amazon Music. Or, download playlists and podcasts, you can even drag and drop MP3s
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking learns your activity level and guides you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep

description:
A bigger brighter screen, stronger GPS, and some of the best runtimes available, Suunto’s latest smartwatch is easy to love. One of the most noticeable advancements comes from pairing cutting edge antenna technology with Suunto’s latest GPS chipset. This combination enables the Vertical to receive dual frequency and multi-band GPS signals, keeping you connected when your route winds through valleys and mountain ranges, or canyons of glass and steel. Preloaded with multi-layer topographical maps, you choose the view, whether you’re route planning, on the trail, or navigating urban jungles. When it is time to train, there are 95+ activity profiles, so the Vertical is ready for your next ride or your next open water swim. Updated environmental sensors keep you in the know, providing forecasts and even air quality information. Activity tracking records steps and calories, as well as monitors the quality of your sleep. All of this 24/7 performance data is used to calculate your recovery times and track fitness journey.

  • Made in a factory powered by 100% renewable, carbon-free energy
  • Each watch is fully carbon offset via trees planted by Tree-Nation, an internationally recognized non-profit dedicated to reforestation
  • Dual frequency and multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and BeiDou) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data, connecting simultaneously to up to 5 networks and 32 satellites
  • Shaded topographic maps for North America are preloaded with more regions available for free download over Wi-Fi
  • Point of interest navigation with ETAs
  • Snap-to-Route matches your GPS track to your preloaded route (aka a .GPX file), removing inaccuracies along the way, providing a precise track
  • Heatmaps display other Suunto user’s activities over local maps, making it easy to find the best runs, rides, trails, or swims, anywhere you go
  • FusedTrack™ uses data from the internal sensors to plot your route between GPS points. By combining the data, you get a track that mirrors your actual track, and fewer GPS check-ins equals longer battery life
  • FusedSpeed™ combines GPS and accelerometer data to provide a more stable running pace and normalized graded pace
  • Running power comes right off of your wrist, no pod needed
  • Optical heart rate monitor provides blood oxygen level info and constant heart rate data
  • Strava Live Segment integration lets you know when your starred segments are about to begin and displays your progress. Showing your performance in the moment, and how it compares to your PR and the current KOM or QOM, and then provides results once the segment is complete (Strava premium required)
  • Free Suunto app lets you plan trips, workouts, and connect with 200+ app partners, like Strava®, Training Peaks®, Komoot®, etc
  • Suunto app enables sharing metrics, opening up a whole world of digital training plans and tips
  • Loaded with 95+ different sport modes, from running, swimming, cycling, shallow water free diving (up to 10m), and many more
  • Pre-set intelligent battery profiles optimize features and runtimes
  • Battery runtimes: 60 hours with full GPS and heart rate, 90-500 hours with your choice of GPS (more GPS = less runtime), 30 days in smartwatch mode, or 60 days in time only mode
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • Sleep tracking monitors the quality of sleep and total sleep, rest data is used to calculate recovery times and progress
  • Tilt compensated digital compass
  • Barometric altimeter tracks ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Altitude acclimation calculated through altitude data and blood oxygenation data
  • Storm alarm tracks pressure changes
  • Bluetooth connects fitness sensors from power meters to foot pods
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) via Bluetooth
  • Virtually scratchproof sapphire crystal face and stainless steel bezel
  • Fits wrists 12.5-17.5cm
  • In the box: Vertical, USB cable and documentation
title: Suunto Vertical

description:
On-road or off-road, this little touchscreen GPS gets you where you want to go and tells you everything about how you got there. Building on GPS technology from the Fenix line, the latest Edge computers give you access to more satellites and more signals than ever before. These updates give you a stronger GPS connection anywhere you ride, from forests, to valleys of glass and steel. Free detailed maps provide turn-by-turn directions to addresses and points of interest, so if there is gelato close by, you’ll find it. Garmin has incorporated their popularity routing into the latest map set, letting you ride the local’s favourite roads and trails, anywhere you go. Pre-loaded with TrailForks, you get access to incredible trail maps right on your Edge. Real-time Strava segment integration displays nearby segments, showing how you compare to your PR and the current KOM or QOM. And if you’re the “never enough data” type, you can pair your Edge to a range of additional sensors to optimize your time in the saddle. When connected to your phone via the free Garmin Connect app, you can receive notifications, download training plans, review activities, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • Touchscreen plus an intuitive button layout for quick and easy navigation
  • Updated bike type specific mapping uses Garmin Connect’s database of rider’s routes and tracks, finding you the most popular way to get where you’re going, on road or off
  • Free global maps, with North America on the device and more regions downloadable for free from Garmin Express™, providing turn-by-turn routing
  • Address and point of interest navigation lets you search for places like restaurants, attractions, hospitals, accommodation, and more; the unit will even re-route you if you get off course
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite caching gives you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your ride, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, remaining ascent, and displays an elevation profile (no course required)
  • Power specific features like targeted coaching: how you’re performing on that ride and at that moment, on-the-fly recommended power targets, and cycling ability information that highlights strengths and weaknesses. Note – these features require a not included power meter
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TrailForks™ integration for access to TrailForks trail database without a cell connection
  • Strava Segment integration (requires premium) preloaded or on-the-fly via your phone, shows starred segments and results
  • Live Tracking during activities (via phone) allows you to share your location, speed, course and more, with friends, family, or coaches
  • Training plan takes you through the details of your ride: weather conditions, food and water requirements based on your fitness levels – with reminders when you should drink and eat, and more
  • Environmental factors like heat and altitude acclimation are taken into consideration when calculating performance and recovery metrics
  • Training status and daily suggested workouts help you optimize your training, guiding you where you need to push and where you may need to dial it back
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max estimate, lactate threshold, race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator (requires not included heartrate chest strap)
  • Bike alarm mode sounds a loud, shrill, attention getting alarm if your bike is touched
  • Incident detection uses accelerometers to detect accident and uses you phone to send a signal to predefined emergency contacts
  • inReach® compatibility, connect to an inReach for messaging and SOS support when off the grid
  • Simplified user interface puts less in between you and that first ride
  • Free Garmin Connect app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more

description:
Go for a backpacking trip, run an ultra, or do a couple triathlons, all on a single charge. Equipped with Garmin’s efficient Power Glass, the fēnix 7 Pro uses the power of the sun to make regular charging a thing of the past. When using the muti-band GPS, Garmin’s SatIQ technology optimizes power usage. SatIQ matches your GPS signal to your environment; flat land gets a low power signal, head into the mountains and the signal is automatically boosted. Free downloadable shaded relief maps help you plan your next trip, and when connected to your phone, can even display live satellite weather. When it comes to navigating your fitness, 24/7 heartrate tracking and other metrics combine to give you a complete picture of how you train, how you recover and how you live. If you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through Garmin’s free Connect app. Connect lets you stream music, receive notifications, track the weather and more. The latest in fēnix line even has a white and red flashlight, making it easier to find your vacation rental’s hidden key.

  • Power Glass™ solar panel lets you go longer between charges, from 8 hours to 116 days or longer
  • Sun gauge displays solar charge status
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, multisport, swimming, gym activities, team sports, skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations display the proper form for strength training, yoga, etc
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • SatIQ™ matches your current environment with the right GPS mode, optimizing battery life
  • Free downloadable routable TopoActive maps
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (via a phone) allows you to share your location and metrics
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the fēnix Pro will calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin’s database of routes to find the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Up ahead offers at a glance performance metrics and upcoming trail features
  • Hill score displays your running strength and endurance, tracking progress over time
  • Endurance score analyzes training data to map improvements to your overall endurance
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and provides a personalized daily workout
  • Training readiness, training status, and training load modes use your training history to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Acute load compares recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Running dynamics info provides running power, cadence, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • PacePro™, GPS based pace guidance that compares your actual pace vs your goal pace
  • Mountain biking dynamics including jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: how smoothly you rode the trail
  • Elevate™ V5 optical heart rate monitor has improved reliability during wrist intensive activities like cycling, weightlifting, etc
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max, pulse ox, an improved race predictor (5K, 10K, ½ marathon and marathon), recovery advisor, real-time stamina tracking, and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) helps predict recovery and training response
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains you (exercise) and recharges you (rest, food)
  • Incident detection: in the case of an accident the unit will send a signal via your phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know your location and that you need help
  • Stream music via a paired phone using Spotify, Deezer, or Amazon Music. Or, download playlists and podcasts, you can even drag and drop MP3s
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment (if supported by your bank)
  • 24/7 activity tracking learns your activity level and guides you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep
title: Garmin Fenix 7 Pro Solar

description:
For the first time ever, Garmin’s most accessible full-feature Forerunner is ready to help you train for your first triathlon. Multi-sport mode was previously reserved for the top tier Forerunners, but now the 255S can take you through a swim, bike, and run training session all within a single workout file. Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate optical heart rate monitor, the 255S reads your pulse straight off your wrist, no need for a chest strap. Running metrics like speed and distance information are handled by the onboard GPS and internal accelerometers. These sensors all work together, turning your movement into data, making sure you get credit for all you do, in the gym, the pool and on the trails. The 255S can even give your training a soundtrack, with the ability to connect to multiple music services and storage for up to 500 songs. Having your phone on hand and connected via the free Garmin Connect app, opens a world of smartwatch functionality. Garmin Connect lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • S-series’ smaller case is more comfortable and offers a more accurate heart rate signal on smaller wrists
  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport – transition between activities within a single workout at the press of a button, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym focused activities (strength training – with rep counter, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, indoor rowing and yoga) and more
  • Stream music through a paired smartphone using Spotify, iHeartRadio, Pandora or Deezer. Or, download playlists and podcasts via your favourite music service, e.g. Spotify (premium account required), you can even drag and drop MP3s from your computer – holds up to 500 songs (depending on sound quality)
  • A powerful, internal antenna connects to 3 different satellite constellations, GPS, GLONASS and Galileo. Multiple networks, combined with satellite position caching, give you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal wherever you are
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (through a connected smartphone) allows you to share your location and heart rate with friends, family, or coaches
  • Race widget helps make race day a little less stressful, providing course specific performance info, weather and more
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and even provides a personalized daily workout suggestion
  • UltraTrac™ mode allows you to stay in the field longer, reducing the GPS recording rate in order to conserve battery
  • Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides reliable constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max – which now takes ambient temperature into consideration, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Training status uses data from past workouts to learn your fitness level and tell you how effective your training is
  • Acute load compares the intensity of recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Compatible with running dynamics sensors (sold separately) for running power, cadence, ground contact time, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Incident detection uses the internal sensors to detect if an accident has occurred. In the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your paired smartphone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment; by linking credit cards to your Garmin account, you can make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)
  • Stress level score monitors heart rate variability while inactive to produce a stress score from 0-100, the lower the score, the lower your stress. When stress levels are high, the 255’s relaxation timer will take you through steps to lower your stress levels
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, letting you see your total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep in Connect
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) come in via Bluetooth connection to your smartphone
  • Automatically sync your data to a paired smartphone running the free Garmin Connect app
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields, watch faces, and other features
  • Always-on, colour display is bright and clear in any conditions
  • Internal memory stores up to 200 hours of activities. Garmin Connect will store all of your activity data
  • User-friendly strap changes, thanks to quick-release pins
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 20 hours in GPS mode or up to 12 days in smartwatch mode
  • In the box: Forerunner 255S Music, charging cable and documentation
title: Garmin Forerunner 255S Music

description:

(You can still use the Duffle without the snaps, so we’re offering them at a discount for you to enjoy) Unstrapped from a roof rack, tossed in a cargo hold, and splashed onto the floor of a canoe – just another day for this rugged expedition dry bag. The rectangular shape is stable, stackable and makes it easy to find small items. The upper flap unzips to reveal a wide roll-top closure that can be sealed to keep water out, or strapped out of the way for use as a conventional duffle. Multiple lash points let you secure the Scully to any surface. Members asked for a bigger size, and 150L should give you room to carry just about anything.

  • Coated nylon fabric is super rugged and PVC-free
  • Top flap zipper has oversized pull loops to accommodate gloved hands or chilled fingers
  • Inside top flap has a zippered mesh pocket for quick-access items
  • Snaps hold the wide roll-top closure strips in place to ensure easy rolling and an effective seal
  • Purge valve allows air evacuation to make the bag as small as possible
  • Carrying options include top, side and end handles or comfortable, stow-away shoulder straps
  • All materials are PVC-free except for the purge valve, which is hard PVC. Hard PVC contains fewer eco-hazardous plasticizers than soft PVC, and is fully recyclable
  • Note: these dry bags do not provide submersible waterproof protection or impact protection. For electronics, we recommend hard cases with gasket seals
  • Rocksolid Guarantee still applies, however returns will not be accepted for missing snaps

description:

Every aspect of this lock’s construction has been optimized to protect your property, from its square shackle, to its compact lock opening. Whether you’re protecting a pedal bike, an e-bike, or a motorbike, the D1000 is some of the best protection you can buy.

  • Rated Diamond level protection (that’s the best) by Sold Secure – an independent 3rd party lock testing group. This means it can withstand more than 90 seconds of an attack by an angle grinder, and if you look at the videos, it lasts a lot longer than that

  • 15.5 x 9.2cm opening leaves room for you bike and what you’re locking it to, with no room leftover for leverage tools
  • Silicone sleeve on the shackle protects your bike’s paint
  • 3 coded keys are included

description:
In a world where something always needs charging, wouldn’t it be nice if your Edge didn’t? By incorporating efficient solar technology into these Edge units, Garmin lets you spend more time riding and less time charging. Building on GPS technology from the Fenix line, the latest Edge computers give you access to more satellites and more signals than ever before. These updates give you a stronger GPS connection anywhere you ride, from forests, to valleys of glass and steel. Free detailed maps provide turn-by-turn directions to local points of interest, so if there is gelato close by, you’ll find it. Garmin has incorporated their popularity routing into the latest map set, letting you ride the local’s favourite roads and trails, anywhere you go. Pre-loaded with TrailForks, you get access to incredible trail maps right on your Edge. Real-time Strava segment integration displays nearby segments, showing how you compare to your PR and the current KOM or QOM. And if you’re the “never enough data” type, you can pair your Edge to a range of additional sensors to optimize your time in the saddle. When connected to your phone via the free Garmin Connect app, you can receive notifications, download training plans, review activities, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • Power Glass™ solar panels let you go longer between charges, from 6 to 18 hours longer – on daytime rides, solar can add up to 25 minutes per hour in battery saver mode. Runtime is feature and weather dependent
  • Solar panels collect energy until the battery is full, even when the unit is asleep or off
  • Post ride summary includes solar intensity and the amount of time your battery gained from that solar energy
  • Touchscreen plus an intuitive button layout for quick and easy navigation
  • Updated bike type specific mapping uses Garmin Connect’s database of rider’s routes and tracks, finding you the most popular way to get where you’re going, on road or off
  • Free global maps, with North America on the device and more regions downloadable for free from Garmin Express™, providing turn-by-turn routing
  • Address and point of interest navigation lets you search for places like restaurants, attractions, hospitals, accommodation, and more; the unit will even re-route you if you get off course
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite caching gives you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your ride, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, remaining ascent, and displays an elevation profile (no course required)
  • Power specific features like targeted coaching: how you’re performing on that ride and at that moment, on-the-fly recommended power targets, and cycling ability information that highlights strengths and weaknesses. Note – these features require a not included power meter
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TrailForks™ integration for access to TrailForks trail database without a cell connection
  • Strava Segment integration (requires premium) preloaded or on-the-fly via your phone, shows starred segments and results
  • Live Tracking during activities (via phone) allows you to share your location, speed, course and more, with friends, family, or coaches
  • Training plan takes you through the details of your ride: weather conditions, food and water requirements based on your fitness levels – with reminders when you should drink and eat, and more
  • Environmental factors like heat and altitude acclimation are taken into consideration when calculating performance and recovery metrics
  • Training status and daily suggested workouts help you optimize your training, guiding you where you need to push and where you may need to dial it back
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max estimate, lactate threshold, race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator (requires not included heartrate chest strap)
  • Bike alarm mode sounds a loud, shrill, attention getting alarm if your bike is touched
  • Incident detection uses accelerometers to detect accident and uses you phone to send a signal to predefined emergency contacts
  • inReach® compatibility, connect to an inReach for messaging and SOS support when off the grid
  • Simplified user interface puts less in between you and that first ride
  • Free Garmin Connect app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 32 hours in with full GPS and sensor support, or up to 60 in battery saver mode

description:
Achieving and exceeding your fitness goals, has never looked so good. Outfitted with a brilliant AMOLED display the Forerunner 965 brings a new level of clarity and detail to your training sessions. With features like training readiness, that lets you know if your body is ready for that next training session, and evolving personalized daily workouts, the 965 makes it easier than ever to find your next level. The touchscreen makes scrolling and zooming through the pre-loaded maps, or any course you create, feel natural. Onboard multiband GPS pulls in speed, distance, and location data. While other sensors pay attention to how and where you train, factoring elevation and temperature into your performance. Running power and running dynamics now come right from your watch, no more accessories needed. Each morning the 965 delivers your morning report, summarizing sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and other clutch training data. When you need extra information, or motivation, you can download training plans through the free Garmin Connect app. Connect lets you review activities, receive texts and other notifications, and more. Through your phone, the 965 can connect to multiple music services and can even hold up to 1000 songs. With music and mapping right on your wrist, phone-free runs are looking better and better.

  • AMOLED colour touchscreen has deep blacks and vibrant colours making it crisp, clear, and easy to read in any light
  • Tough, non-reflective Gorilla Glass® 3 DX face and a rugged titanium bezel
  • Built-in modes for biking, running, swimming (indoor and outdoor), multisport, gym focused activities (strength training – with rep counter, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, indoor rowing and yoga) and more
  • Running dynamics off your wrist, providing running power, cadence, ground contact time, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Free global maps include streets and trails, with North America on the device and more regions downloadable from Garmin Express™
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places you may want to go
  • Round-trip mapping: enter a distance and the 965 will use tracks from other Garmin users to calculate multiple course options that start and stop right were you are
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of routes and finds the most popular way to get you where you are going
  • Stream music through a paired smartphone using Spotify, iHeartRadio, Pandora or Deezer. Or, download playlists and podcasts via your favourite music service, e.g. Spotify (premium account required), you can even drag and drop MP3s from your computer – holds up to 1,000 songs (depending on sound quality)
  • Race widget helps make race day a little less stressful, providing course specific performance info, weather and more
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and even provides a personalized daily workout suggestion
  • ClimbPro™ mode breaks down the climbs in your activity, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, how much more you have to go and displays an elevation profile
  • Strava Segment integration (requires premium) preloaded or on-the-fly via your phone, shows starred segments and results
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS)
  • Live Tracking during activities (via phone) allows you to share your location and heart rate
  • UltraTrac™ mode reduces the GPS recording rate, providing up to 34 hours of use
  • Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor provides heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max – which takes ambient temperature and altitude into consideration, a race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • Training readiness and training load modes uses data from your recent workouts (up to 28 days worth) to let you know how ready your body is to train, and if you are overtraining, under-training, or on the right path
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Incident detection uses the internal sensors to detect if an accident has occurred. In the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your paired phone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Activity and sleep tracking
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 24 hours in GPS mode or 8.5 hours in GPS and music mode, 34 hours in UltraTrac mode and up to 23 days in smartwatch mode – all values based on default display mode
  • In the box: Forerunner 965, USB-C charging cable and documentation

description:
A respectfully kitted out trail bike that can keep up with the pack at your weekly group rides. The Siskiu T7 is an all-purpose trail weapon that isn't afraid to drop-in, or get a little sendy. RockShox suspension front and back smooths out the trail. The 12-speed Shimano Deore drivetrain has plenty of mechanical advantage, making even the steepest climbs a little less miserable. Tektro Orion brakes give you a 4-piston caliper up front in a 2-piston caliper out back, so you can keep your velocity exactly where you want it. And, dialed in geometry delivers a natural riding position that feels great in the climbs, and is confidence inspiring in the descents.

  • RockShox Recon RL front fork has motion control damping allowing low-speed compression adjustment and lockout
  • RockShox Deluxe Select+ rear shock has been custom tuned to match the Siskiu T7’s geometry and Polygon’s Faux Bar linkage. Equipped with the highly tunable DebonAir™ spring that offers a coil-like consistent feel throughout the travel
  • One piece suspension linkage increases stiffness while reducing weight. Delivering a ride that is poppy and supportive, with excellent small bump compliance, yet is still efficient in the climbs
  • 12-speed Shimano Deore drivetrain is rugged, reliable, and affordable, providing fast accurate shifts even in rough terrain
  • Tektro Orion brakes have a 4-piston caliper up front and a 2-piston caliper out back, giving you extra stopping power where you need it most
  • Tektro Orion levers have adjustable reach
  • ALX Alloy frame is uses hydro-formed, triple butted 6061 aluminum that has been heat treated for improved strength and durability
  • FWG frame geometry has been optimized for aggressive trail riding, steep descents, and comfortable climbs
  • Tapered head tube broadens towards the bottom leading to better force transfer from the fork to the frame. The increased stiffness of the tapered head tube provides improved handling
  • Internal cable routing keeps your cables safe from trail hazards and has a nice clean look
  • Polygon’s wheel fit system equips small bikes with 27.5in. wheels, and medium to extra large bikes with 29in. wheels. Polygon feels this balance offers the rider the most efficient power delivery and ergonomics for their size
  • Suspension travel varies by size, with the 29in. having 140mm of travel up front and 135mm of rear travel, and the 27.5in. 150mm of travel up front and 140mm of rear travel
  • Tranz-X dropper posts with internal cable routing, give you somewhere to sit when you need it and get your seat out of the way when you don't. 29in. – 170mm drop. 27.5in. – 150mm drop
  • Entity XL2 aluminum wheels are tubeless ready
  • Boost hub spacing offers improved rigidity and strength, and paves the way for easy upgrades down the road
  • Schwalbe Hans Dampf tires with the Addix compound keep you glued to the ground, offering low rolling resistance and great traction in a variety of conditions
  • Short chainstays make the bike feel nimble on the trail and flickable in the corners
  • Bikes are covered by MEC's Rocksolid Guarantee and Bike Service Agreement. You can bring your bike to any MEC bike shop for free adjustments and minor maintenance for a year after purchase
  • Based in Indonesia, Polygon has been making bikes for more than 25 years. Polygon makes all of their own frames in-house, allowing them to control the design and construction of their bikes from inception to shipping. You will find Polygons ridden in the Red Bull Rampage, UCI Downhill World Cup, and other major mountain bike events all around the world
  • Due to challenges with supply chain, components may be substituted for comparable parts at any time. The listed build is how MEC intended your bike to arrive, though the manufacturer may need to make a tweak or two to get you riding sooner

description:
Outfitted with a dual-band GPS, more memory, and an improved screen, Wahoo has made a good computer even better. With its intuitive navigation and preloaded maps, the ROAM lets you spend less time in menus and more time riding. Standby features like the quick-read LED bezel, Strava segment integration and sleek out the front mount, make the ROAM a formidable addition to your cockpit. The dual-band GPS gives your computer more satellites than even to choose from, so you get a strong signal nearly anywhere. GPS provides speed and distance information, while a barometric altimeter covers ascent, decent, and grade. Equipped with ANT+, Bluetooth Smart and WiFi, there are a wide variety of sensors that can tell you more about how you ride. When trainer season rolls around the ROAM is ready. Seamless smart trainer integration means the ROAM can take control of your smart trainer and help keep you in shape during the off-season. The free companion app makes set-up and customization easy. The app lets you choose how and where your rides are uploaded, what notifications are sent to your ROAM, what maps you have on your device and more.

  • Preloaded with a fully routable mapset, including street and trail names. Enter a course or destination and the ELEMNT ROAM will navigate you there
  • Detailed re-routing is there for you should you get off course with turn-by-turn directions to get you back on track
  • Route-to-start mode finds the shortest way back to where you started or to where your planned ride begins
  • Summit mode displays the climbs on your route, displaying the grade, the total ascent, your real-time progress and an elevation profile
  • Dual-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, BEIDOU, Galileo, QZSS, SBAS, NavIC) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Free ELEMNT companion app lets you set-up different profiles, customize your ELEMNT ROAM and greatly opens up functionality, allowing you to synch routes, use apps (Strava, RideWithGPS, BestBikeSplit, Komoot, etc.) relay notifications, import .GPX, .TCX, or .FIT files and much more
  • Strava Live Segment integration lets you know when your starred segments (via your phone) are about to begin and shows instantaneous data. Showing your performance in the moment, and how it compares to your PR and the current KOM or QOM, and then provides results (Strava premium required)
  • Live Tracking during activities (via your phone running the ELEMNT app) allows you to share your location, speed, and more
  • Compatible with downloadable planned workouts that will take you through various tests or training rides
  • Preloaded with 5 structured workouts for you to do indoors or outdoors – 2 FTP tests and 3 workouts
  • TrainerRoad, TrainingPeaks and Today’s Plan are fully integrated with ELEMNT ROAM, allowing you to download and upload rides and workouts
  • Pre-loaded with maps of North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, South America, and Africa. Maps for Russia and China can be downloaded over WiFi
  • Route sharing with other ELMNT users, letting you easily send planned routes on the fly
  • Group ride functionality displays other ELEMNT users on the map
  • Mountain bike features allow you to synch your To-Do List from MTB Project and your Wishlist from Singletracks to your ELEMNT ROAM from your phone over WiFi or Bluetooth
  • Configurable 12 LED display can relay various information, from navigation cues, power and heart rate zones, to acting as an alert light for notifications
  • Trainer support lets you control your smart trainer, with specific modes for Wahoo smart trainers. Non-Wahoo smart trainers equipped with ANT+ FE-C can also be controlled
  • Compatible with Supersapiens continuous glucose monitor and other ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart sensors, letting you greatly increase your available metrics
  • Works with electronic shifting systems: Shimano Di2, SRAM eTAP, FSA WE, and Campagnolo EPS
  • 6.9cm 64 colour display protected by a tough, non-reflective Gorilla Glass© screen
  • IPX7 weatherproofing fends off even the heaviest downpour
  • Integrated out-the-front mount has a sleek, aerodynamic profile
  • USB rechargeable battery has up to 17 hours of battery life while running GPS and external sensors

description:
Combining the powerful Edge 1040 with 3 of Garmin’s most popular sensors, this bundle helps you make the most out of your time in the saddle. Sensors track speed, heart rate and cadence on the go, or at home on your trainer. An improved GPS chipset takes care of all of your speed and distance data. Free detailed maps make planning routes for your next ride, or your next tour, nice and simple. And an updated user interface and faster processor have made swiping through the 1040 more intuitive than ever. Longtime Garmin users will appreciate little touches, like a machined aluminum quarter-turn mount, and the change to USB-C. When connected to the free Garmin Connect™ app you can use your favourite fitness apps, receive notifications, download training plans and personalize daily workouts, review activities, and even keep an eye on the weather.

  • Free global maps, with North America preloaded and more regions downloadable, for turn-by-turn routing to local points of interest, including cycling specific features like bike shops
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places like restaurants, attractions, hospitals, accommodation and more
  • Up ahead feature offers at a glance a summary of upcoming ride features, like cafes, viewpoints, etc. and provides an ETA
  • Popularity routing uses Garmin Connect’s database of rider’s routes and tracks to let you ride local, anywhere you go
  • Cycling ability and course demands uses data from previous rides on the 1040 to classify your ability level, when you load a course the course demands will compare that level to the course’s terrain, giving you an idea of how hard or how easy you'll find the ride
  • ClimbPro™ mode shows grade, total ascent, remaining ascent and elevation profile
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TrailForks™ integration for access to TrailForks trail database without a cell connection
  • ForkSight mode uses TraliForks data when you get to a fork, telling about your choices, e.g., trail rating, distance, elevation, etc
  • Strava Segment integration (requires premium) preloaded or on-the-fly through your phone, shows starred segments and results
  • LiveTrack share your course with contacts
  • GroupTrack displays the location and telemetry of contacts using compatible Garmin devices, you can even send pre-set messages within your group
  • Training plan takes you through the details of your ride: weather – including the recommended clothing for the conditions, food and water requirements based on your fitness levels – even providing reminders of when you should drink and eat, and much more
  • Environmental factors like heat and altitude acclimation are taken into consideration when calculating performance and recovery metrics
  • Training status and daily suggested workouts help you optimize your training, guiding you where you need to push and where you may need to dial it back
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max estimate, lactate threshold, race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator (requires included heartrate chest strap)
  • Incident detection uses accelerometers to detect accident and uses you phone to send a signal to predefined emergency contacts
  • inReach® compatibility provides messaging and SOS support when you ride takes you away from cell signal
  • Multiband signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, and Galileo) and caches satellite positions, giving you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal anywhere
  • Shimano Steps e-bike integration displays, range, battery status, gearing, and more
  • Trainer support provides ride data during your indoor training sessions when using a compatible smart trainer
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields, and other features
  • Soft (ANT+ & Bluetooth) heart rate chest strap is comfortable and accurate
  • Speed and Cadence sensors use Bluetooth™ and ANT+™ transmission technology
  • Speed sensor tracks rides, even when you aren’t using your phone or Edge computer. Sensor starts when you start rolling or stop, synching that ride to your phone (running Garmin Connect) or computer when in range
  • Sensors attach with no magnets or exposed parts, making them easy to install, maintain and move between bikes
  • Speed Sensor attaches to a standard hub on either wheel and self-calibrates for accurate speed and distance while stationary (on a trainer) or on the move
  • Cadence Sensor fastens to any crank arm size and measures pedal strokes per minute
  • Barometric altimeter helps you track your ascents, descents, and total elevation changes
  • In the box: Edge 1040, HRM Dual heart rate sensor, cadence sensor, speed sensor, mounts (standard and extended out-front), USB cable, tether and manuals
title: Garmin Edge 1040 Bundle

description:
Let Garmin watch your 6. The RTL515 taillight gives your bike radar for what's coming up behind you. Using ANT+ or Bluetooth® Smart to talk to your Edge or your phone, the RTL515 displays approaching cars on the screen. The powerful LED makes sure that drivers are aware of you. Great for long rides on quiet roads where you might need the RTL515 to snap you back to the reality of an approaching vehicle. When riding busy streets, the radar will tell you what you already know – you’re surrounded by cars, but you can still use it as a standalone bike light. In light only mode, you can control the unit from your paired device, or with the 1-button control on the light itself.

  • Bluetooth Smart and ANT+ communication to your compatible Garmin device, other Bluetooth compatible computer (ELEMNT™ series, HammerHead™, etc.), or phone with Garmin Connect app (or other 3rd party apps) allows your speed to control your light
  • Colour coded approaching vehicle display, green shows you're in the clear, yellow indicates a car at a normal speed, red when a car is approaching quickly
  • Display minimizes when no cars are around, for a full screen view of your Edge unit. Display pops out to show approaching vehicle until it passes
  • Audible alerts are also an option, where the beeps increase in frequency as the car approaches
  • 140m range lets you see cars long before you can hear them
  • Tracks multiple vehicles at a time, up to 6 – each represented by a white dot on the display
  • 4 modes: steady 20 lumens (6h), peloton 8 lumens (8h), night flash 29 lumens (6h), and day flash 65 lumens (16h)
  • Peloton mode dims your light when riding in a pack
  • Up to 65 lumens and a 220° viewing angle
  • Micro-USB charging lets you top-up your taillight nearly anywhere
  • LED charging indicator lets you know how your light’s battery is doing, both charging and discharging
  • IPX7 waterproofing protects your RTL515 from even the heaviest downpours
  • Tool-free mount is easy to swap between bikes
  • Uses Garmin’s quarter-turn mounting brackets
  • In the box: Varia RTL515, mounting kit (fits both round and aero seat posts), cables and documentation

description:
Building that off-the-grid cabin just got easier. Whether you are looking to use power tools in the middle of nowhere, or just bring movie night – complete with popcorn and cold drinks, to van life, the BaseCharge 1500 has the power you need. With years of creating clever off-grid power solutions and powerbanks, BioLite has created a line of all-in-one power station that lets you plug-in your favourite at home electronics, wherever you roam. The onboard digital display provides you with all the information you need: input/output Watts, battery capacity, runtimes, charge times, and more. Wireless charging and tons of female charging ports, including 12V (car cigarette lighter), 3 x USB type C (one is even set-up for USB-PD), 2 x USB type A, and 3 x AC that accepts grounded and ungrounded plugs, mean that if you can recharge it, you can probably recharge it with the BaseCharge.

  • LCD power status display tells you how much power you're getting and using, as well as battery charge capacity and time remaining under current load. Resettable energy odometer lets you track your power usage, making it easy to manage remaining power
  • Wireless charging via the top mounted charging panel (1 device at a time, 10W max)
  • Charges easily via included wall charger, going from 0 to full in 13.5 hours, USB-C PD in 15 hours, combine a wall charger and USB-C PD to charge in 8 hours, or 4 hours from a compatible solar panel (4 hours is the power from four SolarPanel 100s in ideal conditions)
  • MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracker) technology enables a 30% more efficient charging via solar panels in low-light conditions
  • 12 checkpoint safety system constantly monitors all incoming and outgoing power, battery’s status, and provides over-charge and under-charge protection
  • Li-NMC (lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide) battery offers a longer life than standard lithium-ion batteries and better inherent safety
  • Battery can be kept plugged into a power source during storage, or fully-charge your BaseCharge every 3-6 months and store in a cool, dry place
  • Peak capacity is 1521Wh (21.6V, 70.4Ah) and lasts through hundreds of cycles
  • 5 USB ports (output): 2 x type-A at 5V, up to 3A, 2 x USB-C 5V up to 3A, USB-C PD 5-20V up to 5A (100W max), All ports are regulated
  • 12V car port (regulated output): 12V (120W max)
  • 12V barrel port (output): 12V (120W max) 5.5mm OD and 2.1mm ID
  • AC inverter: 3 x 110V (1200W, 2400W surge)
  • Provides pass-through power, so you can plug your BaseCharge into the wall and then your device into your BaseCharge, making sure your device stays powered should the power go out
  • Charging ports: wall/solar input, 400W (12-30V DC), up to 20A max, and USB-C PD 100W
  • Not waterproof and should not be used in the rain
  • Operating temp is 0-40°C
  • In the box: BaseCharge, wall charger, documentation
title: BioLite BaseCharge 1500

description:
After taking a few years off, the epix is back. This latest generation of Garmin’s svelte do-it-all watch incorporates some the best features of the fēnix line and tucks them under the stunning AMOLED touchscreen of the Venu 2. Downloadable North American topo maps (included) and a powerful GPS keep you headed in the right direction, and track your speed and distance while training. Data from the GPS is analyzed with readings from the barometric pressure altimeter for precise elevation data. Elevation data and pulse metrics show how well acclimated you are at your current altitude. Dozens of onboard training profiles help your develop stamina, crush that next 5k, or track your sport climbing progress. When you’re not training or in the backcountry, the epix analyzes your daily routine, from how you sleep, to your breathing patterns, and even when you should drink more water. Smartwatch features help you stay connected, stream music, receive texts, social media alerts and emails, track the weather and more.

  • Touchscreen plus an intuitive button layout make navigating your watch quick and easy
  • 3cm AMOLED colour display has deep blacks and vibrant colours making it crisp and clear in any light
  • Rugged stainless steel bezel and case back, pair nicely with a Gorilla® Glass DX face
  • Built-in modes for biking (road and mountain), running, swimming (indoor and out), HIIT (AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata and custom), climbing (bouldering and route, with selectable grading systems and difficulty), gym (strength training, cardio and elliptical, stair stepping, rowing and yoga), surfing (with SurfLine® integration) golfing (42,000+ course maps), skiing (2000+ ski resort maps) and more
  • Activity animations show proper form for strength training, cardio, Pilates and yoga with preloaded structured workouts. And, more than 1600 exercise animations in the Connect app, so you can develop your own personalized workouts
  • Downloadable TopoActive multi-continent map data
  • Up ahead feature offers at a glance performance metrics and a summary of upcoming trail features
  • Turn-by-turn and point of interest navigation
  • Round-trip mapping: choose a distance and get course options that start and stop in the same spot – great for set-distance runs
  • Trendline™ routing uses Garmin user’s route data to find the most popular route
  • Stream and download using Spotify (premium required), Amazon Music, and more, or add MP3s from your computer
  • Holds up to 2000 songs so you can leave the phone at home, just pair your Bluetooth headphones and hit play
  • Synched playlists can be updated via Wi-Fi
  • ClimbPro™ shows grade, total ascent and current position on an elevation profile
  • PacePro™, set your desired pace, then compare it to your distance splits, the Fenix 6 compares your needed pace vs your goal pace for each split and for the course
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Garmin Pay™, make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)
  • LiveTrack, share your location and fitness data during activities (through a phone)
  • Connects to 3 satellite constellations (GPS, GLONASS and Galileo) and caches satellite positions
  • Elevate™ 4.0 optical heart rate monitor has improved accuracy and twice the number of infrared sensors for more precise Pulse Ox data, and even works while swimming
  • Physiological data: VO2 max, a visual race predictor, real-time stamina tracking, recovery advisor and performance indicator

Built on fast rolling 700C wheels wearing 42mm wide tires, this bike delivers the grip and comfort of a gravel bike, and the potential speed of road bike. Equipped with SRAM’s gravel focused 12-speed Apex groupset, you get tons of mechanical advantage to help flatten out the climbs. By moving to a 1x12 drivetrain, we have removed a potential point of failure in the front, derailleur, giving you the durability enjoyed by mountain bikers for years. While the Provincial Trail Bike is outfitted with everything you need to go on your next gravel epic, turning this adventure bike into a Gran Fondo–capable one is quite easy. description:
No one wants to waste time being lost, not when there are vistas to be had. The latest addition to Garmin’s eTrex line helps you make the most out of your time outside. Improved antenna technology gives you the strongest GPS signal the eTrex has ever seen. Multi-GNSS signal reception allows more simultaneous satellite connections and gives the eTrex SE more satellites to choose from. More satellites for the GPS, means a stronger signal for you, a real plus when under heavy tree cover or in other challenging terrain. Improved battery life is another huge plus for the SE. Previous eTrex GPS would run for about 25 hours, the SE offers nearly 7x that in regular mode, and 72x that in expedition mode. Connectivity has made it to the eTrex line in a big way. When paired with your phone or tablet running the free Garmin Explore app, you can plan trips, access topographical maps, create waypoints and routes, then sync it all to your GPS. Your phone’s connection also gives you access to active weather information. Detailed weather forecasts for your location, a specific waypoint, or a GPS coordinate, as well as real-time radar tracking, help you to stay one step ahead of bad weather. Your phone will even send alerts, notifications, and more, helping you stay as connected (or disconnected) as you want to be.

  • Multi-GNSS signal reception supports: GPS, GLONASS, and Galileo satellite constellations, providing a faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Garmin Explore™ website and app let you sync routes, tracks and waypoints to your device. You can download map data to your phone, use your phone to plan routes and tracks, and then send those plans to your GPS, all without cell reception
  • Breadcrumb trails track your trek, navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing), or navigate you on the trail you took back to where you started
  • Geocaching Live uses the connection to your phone to provide live cache updates, cache descriptions, logs, and can even provide hints for those times you know you’re close and just need a little help
  • Active weather provides real-time radar tracking (via a connected phone running Garmin Explore)
  • Compass helps keep you headed in the right direction, even when you’re standing still
  • Rugged housing is IPX7 water-resistant, dustproof and has an easy-to-read display
  • 2 AA batteries run for 7 days in regular mode, or 3 months in expedition mode (less frequent GPS check-ins). And, as the AA is the world’s most common battery it is simple to keep your GPS up and running nearly anywhere
  • Improved display provides sharper contrast, making it easy to read in all conditions
  • USB-C connectivity
  • In the box: eTrex SE and documentation

Multiple sport profiles add custom metrics to your training data, letting you train smarter for all your activities.   • Connects to GPS, GLONASS and Galileo satellite constellations for fast signal acquisition and a strong connection nearly anywhere

  • Tilt compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you're stationary, so you're always facing the right direction
  • Barometric altimeter helps you track your ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Storm alarm tracks pressure changes and alerts you when it’s time to find shelter. Extended weather data can also come in via the connection to your smartphone
  • Extend battery life by selecting different GPS modes to find the perfect balance of GPS accuracy and time until your next recharge
  • UltraTrac™ mode reduces the GPS recording rate to conserve battery life, allowing you to stay in the field longer (up to 40 hours)
  • Built-in activity modes for hiking, biking, running, strength training (with rep counter), walking, swimming (indoor only) and more. Each activity has a fully customizable display
  • Pre-loaded and customizable workouts help you hone your training, plus you can even race past activities
  • Move IQ intelligently detects your activity and tracks it in your Connect timeline to ensure you get credit for all of your daily exercise
  • Course navigation via created or downloaded courses
  • Breadcrumb trails track your trek, navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing), or navigate you on the trail you took back to where you started
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (through a connected smartphone) allows you to share your location and heart rate with friends, family or coaches
  • Equipped with Garmin’s new lower profile Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides more reliable constant heart rate data and allows you to train without a chest strap
  • Optical heart rate sensors measure changes in blood volume under the skin, and work best when worn snugly, 1 to 3 finger-widths above your wrist bone
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • With 24/7 activity tracking, Instinct learns your activity level and helps guide you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On-board sleep-tracking mode monitors your rest, letting you see your total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep in your Connect profile
  • Counts flights of stairs with internal barometric altimeter data that’s combined with your step data
  • Weekly intensity minutes are displayed against the ideal of 150 needed to maintain a healthy life
  • Automatically sync your data to paired smartphone running the free Connect app

  • Customizable button setups let you program “hot-keys”, setting long-presses of buttons to take you directly to certain modes or perform certain actions
  • Rugged construction with MIL-STD-810G certification for thermal, shock and water resistance (100m)
  • User-friendly strap changes (compatible with QuickFit bands)
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 14 hours in GPS mode or 14 days as an activity-tracking smartwatch

description:
Building on GPS technology from the Fenix line, the latest Edge computers give you access to more satellites and more signals than ever before. These updates give you a stronger GPS connection anywhere you ride, from forests, to valleys of glass and steel. Free detailed maps provide turn-by-turn directions to local points of interest, so if there is gelato close by, you’ll find it. Garmin has incorporated their popularity routing into the latest map set, letting you ride the local’s favourite roads and trails, anywhere you go. Pre-loaded with TrailForks, you get access to incredible trail maps right on your Edge. Real-time Strava segment integration displays nearby segments, showing how you compare to your PR and the current KOM or QOM. And if you’re the “never enough data” type, you can pair your Edge to a range of additional sensors to optimize your time in the saddle. When connected to your phone via the free Garmin Connect app, you can receive notifications, download training plans, review activities, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • Updated bike type specific mapping uses Garmin Connect’s database of rider’s routes and tracks, finding you the most popular way to get where you’re going, on road or off
  • Free global maps, with North America on the device and more regions downloadable for free from Garmin Express™, providing turn-by-turn routing
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places like restaurants, attractions, hospitals, accommodation, and more
  • Multi-band signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) provide faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite caching gives you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal
  • ClimbPro™ ascent planner breaks down the climbs in your ride, letting you know the grade, the total ascent, remaining ascent, and displays an elevation profile (no course required)
  • Power specific features like targeted coaching: how you’re performing on that ride and at that moment, on-the-fly recommended power targets, and cycling ability information that highlights strengths and weaknesses. Note – these features require a not included power meter
  • Mountain biking dynamics include specific metrics, jumps: hangtime, distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TrailForks™ integration for access to TrailForks trail database without a cell connection
  • Strava Segment integration (requires premium) preloaded or on-the-fly via your phone, shows starred segments and results
  • Live Tracking during activities (via phone) allows you to share your location, speed, course and more, with friends, family, or coaches
  • Training plan takes you through the details of your ride: weather conditions, food and water requirements based on your fitness levels – with reminders when you should drink and eat, and more
  • Environmental factors like heat and altitude acclimation are taken into consideration when calculating performance and recovery metrics
  • Training status and daily suggested workouts help you optimize your training, guiding you where you need to push and where you may need to dial it back
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max estimate, lactate threshold, race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator (requires not included heartrate chest strap)
  • Bike alarm mode sounds a loud, shrill, attention getting alarm if your bike is touched
  • Incident detection uses accelerometers to detect accident and uses you phone to send a signal to predefined emergency contacts
  • inReach® compatibility, connect to an inReach for messaging and SOS support when off the grid
  • Simplified user interface puts less in between you and that first ride
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields, and other features
  • Free Garmin Connect app lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 26 hours in with full GPS and sensor support, or up to 42 in battery saver mode
  • In the box: Edge 540, mounts (flush out-front and standard), USB-C cable, tether and documentation
