description:
For the first time ever, Garmin’s most accessible Forerunner helps you train for your first triathlon. Multi-sport mode was previously reserved for the top tier Forerunners, but the 255 can take you through a swim, bike, and run training session all within a single workout file. Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate optical heart rate monitor, the 255 reads your pulse straight off your wrist. Running metrics like speed and distance information are handled by the onboard GPS and internal accelerometers. These sensors all work together, turning your movement into data, making sure you get credit for all you do, in the gym, the pool and on the trails. Having your phone on hand and connected via the free Garmin Connect app, opens a world of smartwatch functionality. Garmin Connect lets you review activities, receive texts, social media alerts, emails, etc., download training plans, keep an eye on the weather and more.

  • Built-in activity modes for biking, running, walking, multisport – transition between activities within a single workout at the press of a button, swimming (indoor and outdoor), gym focused activities (strength training – with rep counter, cardio and elliptical training, stair stepping, indoor rowing and yoga) and more
  • Connects to 3 different satellite constellations, GPS, GLONASS and Galileo. Multiple networks, combined with satellite position caching, give you a fast connection and a strong GPS signal wherever you are
  • Internet Live Tracking during activities (through a connected smartphone) allows you to share your location and heart rate with friends, family, or coaches
  • Race widget helps make race day a little less stressful, providing course specific performance info, weather and more
  • Morning report summarizes sleep quality, recovery level, training effects, and even provides a personalized daily workout suggestion
  • UltraTrac™ mode allows you to stay in the field longer, reducing the GPS recording rate in order to conserve battery
  • Equipped with Garmin’s Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor which provides reliable constant heart rate and pulse ox data
  • Physiological metrics includes VO2 max – which now takes ambient temperature into consideration, an improved race predictor, recovery advisor and performance indicator
  • Heart rate variability (HRV) monitoring is a great tool to predict recovery and how your body is responding to your training
  • Training status uses data from past workouts to learn your fitness level and tell you how effective your training is
  • Acute load compares the intensity of recent workouts against your fitness level and training schedule, keeping you on track to reach your goals
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Compatible with running dynamics sensors (sold separately) for running power, cadence, ground contact time, stride length, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio and ground contact time
  • Incident detection uses the internal sensors to detect if an accident has occurred. In the case of an accident the unit will send a signal through your paired smartphone to your emergency contacts, letting them know where you are and that you need help
  • Garmin Pay™ contact-less payment; by linking credit cards to your Garmin account, you can make payments with your watch (if supported by your bank)
  • Stress level score monitors heart rate variability while inactive to produce a stress score from 0-100, the lower the score, the lower your stress. When stress levels are high, the 255’s relaxation timer will take you through steps to lower your stress levels
  • 24/7 activity tracking, learning your activity level and guiding you towards a more active lifestyle
  • On board sleep tracking mode monitors your rest, letting you see your total sleep hours as well as periods of movement and restful sleep in Connect
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) come in via Bluetooth connection to your smartphone
  • Automatically sync your data to a paired smartphone running the free Garmin Connect app
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart, from foot pods, to speed and cadence pods, to Varia lights, and Rally power meters
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields, watch faces, and other features
  • Always-on, colour display is bright and clear in any conditions
  • Internal memory stores up to 200 hours of activities. Garmin Connect will store all of your activity data
  • User-friendly strap changes, thanks to quick-release pins
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 30 hours in GPS mode or up to 14 days in smartwatch mode
  • In the box: Forerunner 255, charging cable and documentation
title: Garmin Forerunner 255

The magic of the OneUp bar comes from making the stiffest part of the bar, the center, as small as possible and by rethinking the classic profile. By making the transition in the rise an oval, instead of circle, these bars flex in a way that you don’t notice when riding but you will notice in comfort, it is almost like suspension for your hands.

  • Oval transition absorbs vibrations, keeping your hands and wrists happy
  • Stiff in where it counts, providing optimized steering response and control
  • Tested against leading carbon bars and foam filled aluminum bars. The results were, on average, a 21% increase in vertical compliance (comfort) coupled with a 28% increase in steering stiffness (responsiveness)

description:
Still tipping the scales at less than 40g, the latest generation of Coros’ budget-friendly multisport watch, gets improved GPS, a touchscreen, and a more precise heart rate monitor. You see these GPS benefits in precise tracks and a stronger connection under heavy tree cover and in dense cities. The touchscreen allows you swipe around your preloaded courses, while the signature dial lets you zoom in and out, making it easy to review your route with a single finger. By adding additional sensors to the optical heart rate monitor, your heart rate data is more complete than ever and adds the ability to track blood oxygen levels. And when you want even more, you can synch with the free COROS app to build, share and download custom routes and workouts, review activities, receive texts, social media alerts and email.

  • Dual frequency GNSS support, connecting to GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou and QZSS satellite constellations providing faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Sport profiles include: running (indoor and outdoor), cycling (indoor and outdoor), swimming (pool and open water), triathlon, multisport, gym cardio, strength training and more
  • Multisport lets you transition and track different activities within a single workout
  • Strength training program has more than 200 exercises, selectable muscle groups, auto-detects reps, counts sets and provides a comprehensive breakdown in the app with body-mapped exercise tracking, including how many reps you did for each muscle group
  • Updated optical heart rate monitor measures heart rate right off your wrist and even works while swimming
  • Recovery advisor prevents over-training and helps maximize training intervals
  • Advanced training metrics: SpO2, VO2max, training effect, training load, threshold pace and more
  • Music playback via the internal storage, letting you drag-and-drop owned .mp3 files from your computer to your watch. Note – there is no music service support
  • Digital dial scrolls through modes, settings and metrics with a single finger
  • Battery profiles provide 15 hours of continuous training use with dual frequency GPS mode and 24 days in smart watch mode
  • Breadcrumb style navigation tracks your activities, can navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing), or give you a trail to follow back to where you started
  • Free COROS app has downloadable workouts, workout breakdowns, activity tracking information, third party training app integration e.g., Strava™, Training Peaks™, etc., and much more
  • Bluetooth Smart lets you connect to a variety of different sensors, including: power meters (cycling and running), cadence and speed sensors, foot pods, heart rate belts and more
  • Daily activity tracking with calories burnt, steps, floors climbed and sleep tracking
  • Night mode backlights low-light sessions, turns off when activity is complete or 1 hour after sunrise
  • ABC data via internal altimeter, barometer and compass
  • 50m water resistance
  • In the box: Pace 3, charging cable and documentation

description:
With communication, navigation and a camera, the Rino 755t is like a smartphone for your off-grid adventures. Preloaded with 100K resolution TOPO maps for Canada, it simplifies backcountry navigation and trip planning. The 8-megapixel camera means you can take pictures of your adventure without needing to carry another device. Each picture you take is automatically geotagged with location data via the quad-helix antenna’s excellent GPS reception. Free BaseCamp software lets you map out your adventures and pins your photos on the map. The integrated FRS/GMRS radio lets you stay in contact with other Rino units in your party, so you can communicate via talk or text without needing cell reception. Share your location with other Rino users to take the guesswork out of meeting up in the backcountry. Before heading to the trailhead, pair your device with a smartphone running the free Garmin Connect app to unlock even more potential, including real-time weather tracking, satellite terrain imagery, trip planning, fitness modes, and much more.

  • 2 Watt FRS/GMRS 2-way radio lets you communicate by voice or unit-to-unit texting regardless of cellular signal (range: 3.2km FRS and 32km GMRS)
  • NOAA and S.A.M.E. technology (Specific Area Message Encoding) prevent you from missing a weather alert. Alerts are only active when the weather radio is on, and you are on an active radio channel
  • Active weather provides real-time radar tracking (via a connected smartphone running Garmin Connect), which allows you to stay one step ahead of bad weather
  • 8-megapixel camera with a 4x digital zoom lets you record your adventures with geotagged images
  • Find your friends by sending other Rino users your exact location and viewing theirs on your map screen
  • Free Garmin Connect mobile app allows you to customize your Rino experience, choosing which widgets to show and when, reviewing stored activity data, selecting which apps can push notifications, and more
  • Connect IQ support allows you to download apps, templates, data fields and other features
  • Free BaseCamp navigation software lets you view and organize maps, waypoints, routes and tracks. BaseCamp will even place your geotagged photos on the correct map locations
  • BaseStation combines the power of BaseCamp with that of your laptop, acting as a full command centre that's capable of tracking multiple Rinos. View real-time GPS information on the larger display of your computer while the Rino serves as an antenna, meaning you're not dependant on internet or cell service
  • Compatible with Garmin Custom Maps, a free service that allows you to transform paper and electronic maps easily into downloadable maps for your device
  • Bluetooth Smart and ANT+ compatibility allow syncs with compatible activity sensors and accessories
  • Send smartphone notifications straight to your Rino via the Bluetooth connection to your paired smartphone
  • Compatible with all smartphones featuring Bluetooth 4.0 (iPhone 4S or higher, and Android 4.3 or higher)
  • Auto-rotating screen lets you mount your Rino horizontally or vertically
  • Integrated quad-helix antenna for enhanced signal reception from GPS and GLONASS satellites
  • Barometric altimeter helps you track your ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Tilt compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you are stationary, ensuring that you're always facing the right direction
  • IPX7 waterproofing protects your Rino from even the heaviest downpours
  • LED flash can double as a flashlight, should you get caught in the dark
  • Rechargeable lithium-ion battery lasts up to 14 hours with all modes active
  • Extend your power supply options with the AA battery pack option (sold separately), which accepts one of the most globally available batteries
  • Free 1-year subscription to BirdsEye Satellite Imagery allows users to download satellite images
  • In the box: Rino 755t preloaded with 100K TOPO Canada maps, lithium-ion battery pack, USB cable, AC charger, carabiner clip, documentation

description:
Packed with all the life saving and messaging capabilities of its predecessor, the inReach Mini 2 adds improved GPS reception and a longer battery life. By tapping into the power of Iridium’s® satellite constellation, you can send and receive text messages and emails anywhere on the planet, staying connected even where there’s no phone coverage. Should things take a turn for the worse, a dedicated SOS button lets you call for help, no matter where you are. The upgraded GPS chipset allows improved navigation to pre-set waypoints and breadcrumb style routing. If you get turned around on a hike, TracBack® has you covered, displaying an onscreen path that will take you right back to the trailhead. The onboard GPS also helps you stay connected, imbedding your location with each message, letting your followers track your adventures. When paired with the free Garmin Explore® app you can use your phone to plan trips, access topographical maps, create waypoints and then sync routes to your Mini.

  • Rugged housing is IPX7 water-resistant, dustproof and has an easy-to-read display
  • TracBack mode navigates you safely back to where you started
  • Compass helps keep you headed in the right direction, even when you’re stopped
  • Bluetooth Smart and ANT+ compatibility lets you explore smarter with compatible activity sensors and accessories
  • Garmin Explore™ website and app let you sync routes, tracks and waypoints to your device. You can download map data to your phone, use your phone to plan routes and tracks, and then send those plans to your inReach Mini 2, all without cell reception
  • Breadcrumb trails track your trek, navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing), or navigate you on the trail you took back to where you started
  • Uses Iridium’s constellation of 66 satellites for coverage of the Earth's entire surface. Messages are buffered for up to a day
  • Iridium’s worldwide coverage lets you send texts and emails from anywhere in the world. Your plan determines how many you can send and how detailed they are
  • GPS tracking feature allows your friends and community to follow your progress via a personalized MapShare® page
  • World coverage SOS feature gives you a confirmation message from the International Emergency Response Coordination Center (IERCC) if you use it to send an SOS. 2-way texting allows you to stay in contact with rescue personnel
  • SOS messages are received by IERCC, a worldwide emergency response coordination center with 24/7/365 staffing
  • SOS button has a hard plastic cover, greatly reducing chances of an accidental activation
  • Messages have your GPS location embedded
  • GPS enables basic on-screen grid navigation
  • GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou and QZSS satellite constellation support for strong signal anywhere
  • Optional weather forecasting service sends detailed weather data for your location, a specific waypoint or a GPS coordinate directly to your inReach, paired smartphone or tablet

description:
Updated with an improved GPS and a few tricks taken from the fēnix line, this is an Instinct you can trust. With the Instinct 2 Garmin has brought a multi-GNSS GPS and more activity profiles to their rugged Instinct line. By speaking to more satellites, you get a faster, more accurate signal in challenging conditions. GPS data is used both in navigation and in sport modes, getting you where you need to go and providing real-time speed and distance data along the way. Equipped with the latest Elevate™ optical heart rate monitor you get pulse information straight off your wrist, so there's no need to wear a chest strap. Sport profiles add custom metrics to how you train, letting you train smarter and evolve faster. When paired with the free Garmin Connect™ app on your phone, you can review activities, set up live tracking sessions, track real-time weather forecasts, receive notifications, control apps and much more.

  • Multi-GNSS signal reception supports: GPS, GLONASS, and Galileo satellite constellations, providing a faster and more accurate positioning and elevation data
  • Satellite caching saves satellite data, for fast, accurate satellite signal in any terrain
  • Tilt compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you are stationary, ensuring that you are always facing the right direction
  • Barometric altimeter tracks ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Storm alarm tracks pressure changes and alerts you when it’s time to find shelter. Extended weather data can also come in via the connection to your phone
  • Power manager uses pre-set and custom power profiles to balance battery life and GPS accuracy
  • Built-in activity modes for hiking, biking, running, strength training (with rep counter), walking, swimming, golf, yoga, climbing and more
  • Pre-loaded and customizable workouts, you can even race past activities
  • Move IQ detects and tracks activity; it appears in your Connect timeline to credit all your daily exercise
  • Mountain biking dynamics distance and speed, grit: overall trail difficulty, and flow: a score of how smoothly you rode the trail
  • TracBack mode navigates you safely back to where you started
  • Course navigation, via created or downloaded courses
  • Breadcrumb trails track your trek, navigate you to a saved location or entered coordinate (there are no maps for routing)
  • LiveTrack™, share your location and fitness data during activities (through a phone)
  • Elevate™ 4.0 optical heart rate monitor has improved accuracy and twice the number of infrared sensors for more precise Pulse Ox data, and even works while swimming
  • Physiological data: VO2 max, performance indicator and recovery advisor that takes altitude and temperature into consideration
  • Broadcast of your HR over ANT+ (so other devices can pick it up)
  • Body Battery™ tracks daily energy levels, monitoring what drains your energy (exercise) and recharges your energy (rest, food), letting you train smarter
  • Fitness age takes your activity level, heart rate and BMI into account to let you know if you are performance matches your age
  • 24/7 activity tracking, Instinct 2 learns your activity level and helps guide you towards a more active lifestyle
  • Sleep tracking and sleep score mode monitors rest, periods of movement, deep and light REM sleep stages and scores them in a glanceable widget
  • Counts flights of stairs with internal barometric altimeter data combined with step data
  • Weekly intensity minutes displayed against the ideal for health of 150
  • Incident detection uses sensors to detect accidents. In the case of an accident a message and your location will be sent through your paired phone to your emergency contacts
  • If you feel unsafe, assistance mode sends out a LiveTrack link letting your contacts know where you are
  • Automatically sync data to a phone running the Connect app
  • Smart notifications (emails, texts, alerts and more) via Bluetooth connection to a compatible phone
  • Connects with ANT+ and Bluetooth Smart sensors, from temperature pods, to speed and cadence pods
  • Customizable display lets you set-up your screen how you want it
  • Connect IQ allows you to download apps, widgets, templates, data fields and more
  • Rugged construction with MIL-STD-810G certification for thermal, shock and water resistance (100m)
  • Fits wrist circumference of 135-230mm
  • In the box: Instinct 2, charging/data cable and documentation

A solid bridging ski that rides stable on groomers or hardpack but has the lightness and float to take it touring. Reach all the best spots, pick your line and drop in.

  • Paulownia and poplar wood core reinforced with linen-fiber for power, energy, and dampness
  • Snowphobic scratch-resistant polyamide topsheet
  • ABS sidewalls are durable and shock resistant
  • Medium camber underfoot with rockered tip and tail, floats on soft snow and holds an edge on hardpack
  • Short turning radius allows control in variable conditions
  • Versatile 104mm waist
  • Sintered base for excellent glide and shock resistance
  • Hardened steel edges resist corrosion and nicks
  • Zag launched the ZAGreen program in 2017 to help lower the environmental impact of the ski industry. Their goal is to reduce its carbon footprint by further expanding the use of bio-based and recycled materials while sourcing them closer to the manufacturing facilities
title: ZAG Skis Slap 104 Skis - Unisex

description:
Powered by a single AA battery this lightweight headlamp hits way above its weight class. From a 4 lumen low that is just right for reading after dark, to a trail-illuminating 240 lumens, the HM23 has multiple modes to match your activity. Machined from durable aluminum and sealed against even the heaviest downpour, this compact light is built to last.

  • 3 modes: high (8h at 240 lumens), medium (16h at 70 lumens), low (100h at 4 lumens)
  • Single neutral white Cree LED balances contrast and colour reproduction
  • Powered by a single AA battery, light and easy to find all over the world
  • 1-button operation is easy to use, even in gloves
  • Rugged aluminum housing is tough and helps dissipate heat
  • Silicone headlamp housing offers infinite angle adjustment
  • Perforated, reflective headband wicks away sweat and helps keep you seen
  • IPX6 waterproofing means your light is ready for any weather
  • In the box: HM23, 1 x AA battery, spare battery compartment O-ring, manual and warranty card
title: Fenix HM23 Headlamp

description:
Sleep soundly with luxurious padding between you and the cold ground. The thick foam provides insulation for reliable 3.5 season use, with enough insulation for a comfortable sleep on warmer winter nights.

  • Quite polyester face fabric with a non-slip surface on the underside
  • Delta Core™ PU foam with cut-outs to reduce weight and packed size
  • Multi-fuctional one-way inflate valve flips over to prevent air re-entering during deflation
  • Includes stuff sack, repair kit, and PillowLock™ for use with Aeros™ pillows
title: Sea To Summit Comfort Plus SI Rectangular Sleeping Pad - Unisex

description:
A durable base layer for abrasive snow conditions below -1°C.

  • Great for granular snow that tends to wear wax
  • For use with VR and V-waxes
  • Rub on, iron in, finish with cork
title: Swix Base Binder

description:
Save space, weight, and money. This compact device combines three items required by Transport Canada into a single convenient pouch.

  • Includes 15m of 6mm high-quality floating line in a throwbag. Meets the requirement for buoyant heaving line
  • Built-in scooped bucket meets the requirement for a bailer or manual bilge pump. 1L capacity
  • Waterproof whistle built into handle buckle meets requirement for a sound-signalling device
  • Mil spec packcloth, durable mesh for quick drying and heavy duty webbing
  • High visibility reflective strip adds night-time safety
title: North Water 4-Bailer

description:
If you’re looking to toddle into the world of balance bikes, this is a great place to start. The Classic 12 has been designed to get little ones rolling and save you money. Strider bikes get kids riding without pedals or training wheels. They use their legs for balance and movement, which encourages speedy learning and allows them to feel the freedom and adventure that cycling brings. The transition to a pedal bike is much quicker as children have already mastered their balance.

  • Durable steel frame is still lightweight
  • EVA polymer tires require no maintenance
  • Solid seat is supportive and super durable
  • Best suited for ages 18 months to 3 years – inseam of 31-43cm (12-17in.)
  • Max rider weight of 27kg (60lbs)
  • 1 Allen key adjustment for handlebars and seat
  • Seat height adjusts from 28–40cm
  • Handlebar height adjusts from 46–56cm
  • Key differences from the 12 Sport: age range (1.5-3 years vs. 1.5-5 years), seat doesn't go as high, needs 1 tool to be assembled and adjusted, solid seat vs. padded seat, no handlebar pad, and smaller grips
title: Strider 12 Classic Balance Bike - Children

description:
Carbo-load for your next day on the trail with this rich pasta classic. Moist all-white chicken meat, toothsome tagliatelle and a creamy alfredo deliver a restaurant worthy dish to your camp kitchen.

  • Ingredients: freeze-dried tagliatelle pasta (durum wheat semolina, water, egg albumen, salt), sauce (romano cheese from cow's milk (cultured pasteurized part-skim milk, salt, enzymes, disodium phosphate, salt), rbst-free non-fat milk, rbst-free sweet cream solids, parmesan cheese (parmesan cheese (cultured part-skim milk, salt, enzymes), disodium phosphate, salt), butter sauce (modified corn starch, salt, whey solids, non-fat dry milk, dehydrated butter, natural butter flavor, sugar, xanthan gum, lactic acid), garlic, black pepper, parsley), freeze-dried cooked white meat chicken, red bell pepper
  • Allergens: contains rBST-free milk, wheat and eggs
  • Note - Rehydration time doubles every 5,000 feet of elevation gain. Backpacker’s Pantry estimated their rehydration times based on a 5,000 foot altitude
title: Backpacker's Pantry Fettuccini Alfredo with Chicken

description:
Mid-height, run-specific socks designed in partnership with ultrarunner Rob Krar. Thin and cushionless, they fit close-fitting shoes without sacrificing sensitivity.

  • Made of soft merino and synthetic blend
  • 4-degree elite fit system uses 2 types of elastic for stretch, recovery and to keep the sock in place
  • Indestructawool Technology in high-impact areas for comfort
  • Shred Shield™ reinforced toe cap adds durability
  • Mesh ventilation zones provide moisture management
  • Virtually Seamless™ toe for chafe-free wear
  • Narrower profile is designed to fit those with narrower feet
title: Smartwool Athlete Edition Run Print Crew Socks - Women's

description:
Rubber grip tape improves your grasp on the shaft of your tools. It also adds insulation, and dampens vibration that can sap your strength. Great for replacing chewed up rubber or worn out tape.

  • To apply, wrap the tape around the shaft stretching it as you go. The tape will adhere as it contracts, although it's not sticky like conventional tape
  • Dimensions are 19mm width x 1m length. Enough for a single tool
  • Same tape as the stuff used on Petzl® Nomic tools
title: Petzl Griptape

description:
The Ollan Sleeping Bag is perfect for the outdoor adventurer who wants to reduce their environmental impact without sacrificing performance. Made with a Pertex Bio-based fabric and recycled HL-ElixR™ ECO insulation, this sleeping bag is lightweight and packable, while still providing the warmth you need on cold nights.

  • Lightweight shell and lining are made with durable Pertex Quantum nylon ripstop
  • Plant-based Pertex fabric is sustainably sourced from Castor Beans
  • HL-ElixR Micro™ wool/polyester insulation maintains consistent warmth even in damp conditions
  • Adjustable drawcord to cinch the hood when it's chilly
  • Locking two-way anti-snag zipper is full-length
  • Internal stash pocket fits a headlamp or contact lenses
  • Includes a stuff sack
title: Marmot Ollan -9C WoolPoly Sleeping Bag - Unisex

description:
Enjoy the subtle heat of this meal and find out why the bright, lively flavours of Thai cuisine are a constant inspiration for Good To-Go’s founder.

  • Ingredients: green beans, jasmine rice, onion, broccoli, cauliflower, peas, coconut milk powder (freshly pressed coconut milk, maltodextrin (from corn), sodium caseinate), fish sauce (water, anchovy extract, salt, sugar), garlic, grape seed oil, lemongrass, dark brown sugar, tamarind concentrate (tamarind, water), ginger, turmeric powder, coriander, cumin, cinnamon, dried Thai chilies, cardamom, yellow mustard seeds, black peppercorns, fennel seeds, cloves, kaffir lime leaf powder, bay leaf
  • Contains: anchovy, coconut and milk
  • Made in a facility that handles: peanuts, dairy, eggs, soy, wheat and tree nuts
  • Good To-Go was founded by a professional chef who wanted better menu options in the great outdoors
title: Good To-Go Thai Curry

description:
Versatile glide wax for the track or the mountain. This melt-on wax penetrates your base for long-lasting glide in cooler conditions.

  • Fluor-free liquid paraffin wax
title: Swix PS6 Glide Wax (-12 to -6C)

description:
A favourite option for ultra-light hikers, the Scout tarp makes a fine shelter for two. The versatile design can be rigged as a roof, or pitched at an angle to create a comfortable shelter from the wind.

  • Multiple attachment points provide lots of rigging options
  • Nickel-plated solid brass grommets are rugged and corrosion-resistant
  • The stuff sack attaches to an attachment near the middle of the centre seam, so you can use a trekking pole, paddle, or length of wood as a centre pole
  • Centre loop lets you suspend it pyramid-style
title: MEC Scout Tarp

description:
When you need your chalk to last a few moves longer, slap on a bit of this. When used as a base for regular chalk, liquid chalk provides an extra layer of grip for friction dependent projects or super-hot days.

  • Creamy textures applies evenly and dries quickly
  • Made with 80% alcohol base
  • Contains Silica Gel to keep your hands dry for longer
  • Compact 100ml size fits in your chalk bucket pocket and is travel friendly
  • Bottles were updated for 2021 with an easy-to-close lid
title: Flashed Podium Chalk

description:
Enough space for the essentials to hit the trails. It includes a Hydraulics LT 2.5L hydration reservoir that rides in its own dedicated compartment to make refills a snap and protect your gear from accidental spills. Attachments for a standard or full-face helmet and a ventilated Airscape™ suspension keep you cool on the climbs. And if things go wrong, the interior has tool organizer slots.

  • Airscape back panel channels airflow while keeping the load close to your body for stability
  • Shoulder straps and back panel have breathable mesh overlay and soft edges
  • Front shove-it pocket lets you stash extra layers
  • Front organizer pocket opens wide so you can quickly grab tools, tubes and pumps
  • Internal pocket has a scratch-free lining to protect sunnies or electronics
  • Removable webbing waistbelt
  • Dedicated hydration compartment with included Osprey Hydraulics® LT 2.5L reservoir
  • Magnetic clip keeps the bite valve tethered
  • Low-profile helmet carry attachment slips through your helmet's vents to hold it securely in place
  • Loop for a blinky light. (not included)
title: Osprey Siskin 8 Hydration Pack - Men's

description:
With a radiant stove burner and heat exchanger built into the cooking pot, this WindBurner modular stove system is fast, fuel efficient and really shines when the conditions are challenging. Its internal regulator equalizes pressure so the burner operates at near max output at low fuel pressure and in cold temperatures. The 1.8L pot holds dinner for two, so this is a fantastic setup for two fast moving hikers. Nesting components keep it compact when packed, and the straining lid expands your menu options beyond ramen and rehydrated meals.

  • 1.8L pot with ceramic-coated non-stick surfaces and heat exchanger for versatile cooking
  • Pot lid has strainer holes plus locking latch to keep it on tight
  • Pressure regulator provides consistent performance at altitude or when fuel is low
  • Windproof radiant burner maintains heat levels
  • 227g canister burns for about 95 minutes and boils approximately 18L of water
  • 110g and 227g canisters fit inside
  • Stove and pot are an integrated system. Can't be used with standard flat-bottomed pots
  • Fuel canisters available separately
title: MSR WindBurner Duo Stove System

description:
Long the standard-issue protection for cameras, radios, and other delicate equipment. Canoeists and kayakers love Pelican Cases for keeping cameras easily accessible, yet utterly safe and secure. Because they are fully watertight they are also airtight. The larger cases have a finger-operated purge valve so after flying or climbing you can equalize the interior air pressure to make them easier to open.

  • Made of lightweight structural foam resin that won’t dent, crack, or corrode. Light enough to float in salt water with a load up to 5.6kg
  • Sturdy gasket around the rim makes them watertight
  • Removable pick-n-pluck foam is perforated into cubes, so you can customize the size and shape of inner compartment
  • Both the Pelican warranty and MEC's Rocksolid Guarantee cover this case itself. Neither guarantee covers the contents you put inside the case
title: Pelican 1300 Case

description:
The multi-tool of baselayers. Made using a soft recycled nylon and spandex blend, the Forge long sleeve is light, durable and stretchy. A relaxed fit means this can be worn as a baselayer or midlayer giving you versatility. With a zippered kangaroo pocket, you can store your essentials safely.

  • Recycled nylon with a hint of spandex for light, quick drying flex so you can focus on the adventure
  • Cozy fleeced fabric has a luxuriously soft feel
  • Zippered kangaroo pocket keeps your essentials close at hand
  • Elastic cuffs trap in heat to keep you going
  • Relaxed fit means you can wear this from the coffee shop to the trail
title: MPG Forge Front Pocket Thermal Long Sleeve - Men's

description:
Set up tubeless tires at home with this high volume floor pump. With its integrated pressure tank, the Tubeless Blaster can help you thump tubeless tire beads into place. A clever universal pump-head fits both Schrader and presta valves, and even has a lever pressure release for the air tank. This pump will help you keep all the family’s bikes, strollers, wheelbarrows, etc. pumped up and ready to roll.

  • Internal air tank for releasing a single high pressure blast, simply lock the valve with the lever on the pump-head, pressurize the tank, then flip the lever to release the pressure; great for setting up tubeless tires
  • Universal pump-head fits Schrader and presta valves
  • 6cm pressure gauge is easy to see and has an indicator to let you know when you get to your set pressure
  • Ergonomic steel handle
  • 128cm hose means less repositioning of the pump and less spinning wheels to get to the valve
  • Broad base with non-slip pads keeps the pump anchored in place while in use
title: MEC Tubeless Blaster Floor Pump

description:
The popular Keen™ Targhee light trail shoe without the waterproof-breathable membrane. The result is enhanced breathability and comfort for three-season use in warmer dryer conditions.

  • Uppers are full-grain leather and mesh, with moisture-wicking lining
  • Cleansport NXT™ antimicrobial treatment resists odour build-up
  • Contoured heel lock adds stability
  • Dual-density EVA insole adds cushioning
  • Dual-density, compression-moulded EVA midsole with torsion stability shank absorbs impacts and provides support
  • Non-marking carbon rubber outsoles with 4mm lugs grip whatever the trail throws at you
title: Keen Voyageur Light Trail Shoes - Women's

description:
Insulated mitts for warm hands and a good grip when hitting the slopes or swinging an ice axe. The Timeless Mitts feature a polyester shell with leather trim for extra durability, and a waterproof-breathable GORE-TEX® membrane to resist wetness. Primaloft® Gold insulation wraps hands in warmth, and a wool-blend lining wicks moisture to keep your fingers dry and comfortable. The palm is a mix of leather and synthetic leather for a firm grip on ice tools, ski poles or handshakes if you do some impromptu networking on the chairlift.

  • Shell is polyester with leather trim for durable weather protection
  • Waterproof-breathable GORE-TEX® membrane with Gore Warm technology to keep your hands warmer longer in all conditions
  • Primaloft® Gold polyester microfibre insulation offers 360 degrees of warmth
  • Leather and synthetic leather palm is durable and grippy
  • Wool-blend lining wicks moisture and is naturally antimicrobial
  • Adjustable wrist strap and cuff drawcord seals out snow and drafts
title: Kombi Timeless Mitts - Men's

description:
Delicious, clean water for those on the go. The Thru-Link high-flow filter system connects to your reservoir hose, so you just dip, drink and get back on the trail. Two-stage filtration gives you safe and taste-free water on demand, and the pump-free design can be used in a gravity system at basecamp.

  • Fast-flow hollow fibre technology uses polymer fibres remove particulate and pathogens
  • Activated carbon reduces chemicals and tastes
  • Quick-connect adapter can connect to any hydration reservoir system
  • Nominal 1000L filter life is for clear water
title: MSR Thru-Link In-Line Microfilter

description:
Quench your thirst with a hydration mix that contains all natural ingredients.

  • Ingredients: cane sugar, dextrose, sodium citrate, citric acid, raspberry juice, magnesium lactate, calcium citrate, malic acid, potassium citrate, lime oil, green coffee extract, lime juice, and ascorbic acid
  • 50mg of natural caffeine gives your energy an extra boost
  • Optimized glucose and fructose blend allows for more rapid absorption
  • Electrolyte profile closely mirrors what is lost in sweat, allowing you to recover faster
title: Skratch Labs Skratch Labs Sport Hydration Drink Mix Raspberry Limeade with Caffeine

description:
Help your little one become one with nature in this camouflage bucket hat. At UPF 50+, this hat helps keep little noggins sun safe.

  • Cotton is super comfy and “hand-me-down” durable
  • Breakaway chinstrap keeps the hat right where it should be when the wind kicks up
  • UPF 50+ stops more than 98% of harsh UV in its tracks
title: Headster Camo Bucket Hat - Children

description:
A quick and easy way to walk safely on icy streets and driveways. The one piece slip-on rubber harness attaches quickly and the steel cleats provide plenty of traction.

  • Rubber harness fits over most winter boots and shoes
  • 28 steel cleats provide grip
title: Life-Sports Sports Grip Cleats - Unisex

description:
Show off your trail builder cred. Moisture-wicking tech keeps things comfortable, and a drop-back hem means the back won’t ride up under a pack or during a big-air move.

  • Moisture wicking Cool Wik polyester is breathable and soft to the touch
  • Raglan sleeves give you unrestricted range of motion
  • Drop back hem adds coverage
  • Tapered fit is subtly feminine
title: Sombrio Grom's SE Alder Jersey - Girls' - Youths

description:
Head to the backcountry with confidence, this package has the essentials for travel in avalanche terrain. The package includes the Barryvox Transceiver, 280 Speed Probe and Alugator Ride SE Shovel. The Barryvox is an easy-to-read display and clear symbols, and the probe and shovel pack down small for stowing in your bag.

  • Transceiver is powerful and simple to use with gloves on
  • Automatic self-test, frequency check and function test ensures your beacon is always functioning properly
  • 70m search strips speeds signal pick-up
  • Buried beacons can be marked to speed up searching in multiple-burial scenarios
  • Includes carrying system
  • Probe uses glove-compatible Speed Lock system for quick deployment
  • Safety marking at 150cm acts as a visual guide
  • Shovel blade and shaft are hardened aluminum, handle is plastic
title: Mammut Barryvox Tour Package

description:
These boots were made for exploring the north. Waterproof leather uppers let you wander among snowdrifts and brave slick pavement. The Vibram® Icetrek outsole makes them secure on wet or dry surfaces while providing superior cushioning without significant weight.

  • Durable waterproof leather and textile upper
  • Waterproof membrane seals out water and lets moisture escape
  • 600 grams of Primaloft® Gold Eco Series synthetic insulation keeps feet toasty warm
  • Bellows tongue keeps out snow and trail debris
  • Molded nylon arch shank for added support
  • Protective toe cap
  • Vibram® Icetrek outsole provides the grip on very cold, icy, or snowy surfaces
title: Merrell Moab 3 Thermo Xtreme Waterproof Winter Boots - Unisex

description:
A versatile pack with cross-over potential. Great for gear-intensive trips to climb or tag summits, or for overnight backpacking, this pack easily handles up to 20kg. The LightWire™ frame transfers weight to a comfortable harness and hipbelt, and multiple access options lets you get to your gear without having to unpack everything.

  • Peripheral frame and framesheet transfers load to the hipbelt
  • Ridged foam back panel vents heat
  • Height-adjustable harness provides a fine-tuned fit
  • Women's specific harness fits female or narrow-framed hikers
  • Large front panel fully unzips for easy access
  • Bottom zippered compartment provides a dedicated home for your sleeping bag
  • Stretch-mesh front and side pockets to stash gear on the fly
  • Stow-on-the-Go trekking pole attachments let you stash your poles without removing the pack
  • Bottom sleeping bag straps, front daisy chain and lid webbing loops let you lash on extra gear
  • External-access hydration sleeve makes refilling easy and protects pack contents from spills
  • Integrated rain cover keeps your stuff dry during rainy trips
title: Osprey Kyte 56 Backpack - Women's

description:
Fast, fuel efficient, and virtually windproof, this stove system performs well in tough conditions. The stove has an integrated windscreen and a radiant burner with zero clearance between it and the pot. This minimizes heat loss and provides a stable flame. The heat exchanger is integrated into the cooking pot, so it's designed to be used as a system, and doesn't support standard flat-bottomed pots.

  • 1.7L pot is made of hard anodized aluminum
  • Burns for about 80 minutes and boils 22L of water with a 227g canister
  • Produces consistent heat output. The burner operates near max at lower fuel pressures and improves output in colder temperatures. An internal regulator equalizes pressure for consistent boil times throughout the life of a canister
  • Stove and the canister fit into the pot for travel, and a locking lid keeps it all secure
  • Operates to -15°C
  • Uses MSR LPG canisters (available separately)
title: MSR Reactor 1.7L Stove System

description:
Put together your own first aid kit to carry specialized items or just the items you need. These bags feature pockets, compartments and loops for organization. A hide-away belt on the large size convert it to a waistpack.

  • Small is 20 x 13.5 x 6.5cm. Large is 30 x 17.5 x 7cm, and doubles as a waistpack
  • High visibility colour
  • Does not include first aid supplies
title: MEC First Aid Bag

description:
Take your Chair One from comfortable, to luxurious. These rocking skids are pressure fit and require no tools to attach or remove.

  • Press-fit attachment is easy to take on and off
  • Works with all generations of the Chair One
  • Storage sack included
title: Helinox Chair One Rocking Feet

description:
Big wall worthy protection for little heads. The kid's Capitan contains a mix of foam that cushions heads from falling objects, with additional side and back coverage that meets UIAA helmet requirements. The hardtop shell protects against punctures and abrasion, with a complete sticker set for kids give their helmet some style.

  • Made of expanded polypropylene and expanded polystyrene, which has a high rate of energy absorption
  • MIPS technology reduces rotational forces to the head in the event of an impact, lessening the potential damage to the brain
  • 2-piece ABS shell provides scuff and impact protection
  • Increased coverage on back and sides for additional protection
  • Comfort pads are removable for washing
  • Lightweight adjustment system for a secure fit
  • Front hooks and rear elastic hold a headlamp
  • Included sticker pack lets little ones customize their look
title: Black Diamond Capitan Kids MIPS Helmet - Children

description:
The Reactor 4.0 lands in the middle of the Reactor series thickness-wise and warmth-wise. High-density foam provides soft cushioning and excellent insulation and the horizontal coring is lightweight and packable.

  • Durable polyester face fabric
  • Non-slip surface on the underside prevents sliding in your tent
  • Foam has horizontal cut-outs to reduce weight and packed size while retaining insulation
  • Oversized valve makes inflation and deflation easy and closes with a single twist
  • Includes stuff sack and repair kit
title: MEC Reactor 4 Sleeping Pad Long Wide - Unisex

description:
Quench your thirst without adding more plastic to your life. This cycling-specific stainless steel water bottle has a high-flow sport nozzle that uses gravity, rather than squeeze pressure, to deliver water when you need it. A silicone coating on the outside keeps it from slipping in your hands or rattling around in your waterbottle cage.

  • Single-walled stainless steel is durable and 100% recycleable
  • Silicone coating provides a solid grip and keeps bottle quiet and secure in your cage
  • Gravity-flow sport lid provides high-flow without the need to squeeze
  • Fits most standard bottle cages
title: Bivo Duo 740ml Water Bottle

description:
The RC7 provides classic flex to unlock that perfect kick. Thanks to the Quicklace™ system, you can fine-tune the fit on the go, and the waterproof zipper ensures your feet remain comfortably dry.

  • Thermo-formed heel counter for more stability and comfort
  • Quicklace™ system allows for easy-entry and on-the-fly adjustments
  • Lace cover has a sealed centre zipper
  • 102mm Performance Fit last
  • Outsole has useful flex, and torsional stiffness through the underfoot for stability
title: Salomon RC7 Classic Boots - Unisex

description:
Let 1000 lumens light your way. From dark trails to less than well lit bike lanes, the Micro Drive Pro 1000 sends an even blanket of light out in front of you. With 7 modes to choose from, you have the option of a subtle “be seen” amount of light, or a darkness melting amount of light, options are only a click away.

  • 7 lighting modes, 4 in steady and 3 in flashing; steady: 1000 lumens (1.5h), 600 lumens (3.25h), 300 lumens (6h), 125 lumens (11h), flash – 20 lumens (60h), pulse – 100 lumens (14h) and day flash – 700 lumens (40h)
  • 8 LED array creates a wide flood light
  • Easy 1-button interface takes you through all your light’s modes
  • Easy USB-C charging takes only ~4 hours
  • LED charging indicator lets you know light needs charging, when it’s charging and when it’s ready to go
  • Rugged aluminum body with integrated cooling fins dissipates heat well
  • Tool-free mounting is easy to pop on and off, or swap between bikes
  • IPX7 waterproofing protects your light from even the heaviest downpours
title: Lezyne Micro Drive Pro 1000 Front Light

description:
The full, off-the-ground sitting experience is no longer reserved for car campers. Technology transferred from high-end tents makes this chair light enough for regular backpackers, bike tourers, and paddlers. Sit in comfort as you dine or stare into the fire.

Made with light, strong DAC aluminum and breathable mesh.

  • Load capacity is 145kg
  • Packed size is 35 x 10 x 12cm
  • Assembled dimensions are 65 x 52 x 50cm
  • Seat measurements are 34cm from ground, 34cm deep
  • Carrying case included
title: Helinox Chair One

description:
10-speed drivetrains can also get massive gear range. This cassette is perfect for riders looking to convert their 2x10 drivertain to 1x. Slap this on your wheel and enjoy the simplicity of 1x.

  • Gearing is 11-46T
  • 6 sprockets on two alloy spider carriers
  • Largest sprocket is 7075 aluminum
  • Alloy lockring and spacers
  • Chain compatibility: 10-speed wide ratio
title: SunRace MX3 10 Speed 11-46T Cassette

description:
A spacious outdoor home for adventurous families. The Habitude's roomy interior provides a large space for card games or changing clothes, and the sturdy pole geometry stands up to blustery nights. The easy-to-setup design is big enough for a small family, and it has a large vestibule to store your wet gear.

  • Pole configuration provides lots of headroom
  • Fly and floor have a waterproof polyurethane coating
  • Single large door and spacious vestibule offers easy access and room to store your gear
  • Colour-coded webbing makes set up easy
  • Ventilating mesh panels reduce condensation
  • 6 mesh interior pockets keep you organized
  • Interior loops for hanging extra gear, lights or laundry
  • Integrated light in vestibule for easy night access. Requires 2 CR2032 batteries (not included)
  • Includes large stuff sack, stakes and guylines
title: MSR Habitude 4-Person Tent

description:
Kids crank, so we built one of our famous hydration packs in a size just for them. It comes with a plug-and-play reservoir so the tube can be left in the pack during refills.

  • Made of bombproof bluesign® polyester fabric with DWR and a PU coating for great water resistance
  • Shoulder straps are shorter and closer together to fit kids’ backs
  • Perforated Ridged foam back panel with mesh overlay keeps it breathable
  • Includes a 1.5L MEC reservoir with plug-and-play hose detachment button
  • Hydration sleeve with hook-and-loop hanger, hose port, and loops on shoulder straps for hose routing
  • 1 large compartment and a small, zippered accessory pocket
  • Front stretch mesh exterior pocket is great for stowing a jacket or extra gear
title: MEC Mountain Fountain JR Hydration Pack - Unisex

description:
Push your summer camping into shoulder season. Made with the same high-end materials as Therm-a-Rest® sleeping bags, the Corus -6 °C Down Quilt packs down small. Hydrophobic down retains less moisture than traditional down and is light and compressible. Elasticized footbox fits over a sleeping pad and perimeter loops let you fasten the quilt in place.

  • 650 fill-power Nikwax® hydrophobic down maintains loft, retains 90% less moisture and dries 3 times faster than traditional down
  • DWR-treated ripstop polyester shell repels water moisture and condensation
  • Box baffle construction maximizes loft and minimizes cool spots
  • Full-perimeter side baffles and an elasticized footbox keep cold air out
  • SynergyLink™ Connectors kit let you attach it to your Therm-a-Rest mattress for an efficient sleep system
  • Includes a stuff sack and a storage sack
title: Therm-a-Rest Corus -6 Down Quilt - Unisex

description:
A 4-in-1 spoon, fork, knife and extended utensil covers all your camping needs. Use the 2 pieces separately, or snap them together to form a long spoon or fork for reaching the last bits of food out of dehydrated meal bags (or for sneaking a bite of your campmates dessert).

  • Made of post-consumer polypropylene to handle the rigours of the trail
  • Knife-end on back of spoon lets you use it and the fork together
  • Spoon and fork nest together for storage, or flip the ends to create an extended utensil
  • Dishwasher and microwave safe
title: UCO Eco Switch Spork

description:
Mapping and communication for the backcountry. Merging the navigation power of the GPSMAP 67 with the communication and PLB functionality of an inReach, the 67i will keep you confident and connected. The Iridium satellite network lets you send and receive text messages and emails anywhere on the planet (subscription required). Each message contains your GPS location data, so followers can track your adventures. If things take a turn for the worse, a dedicated SOS button means that help is never out of range. Enhanced messaging functionality comes when paired with the free Garmin Messenger app you can use your phone to send and receive detailed messages. Great for setting up a group chat to keep family and friends up to date on your adventures. With access to 5 different satellite networks, class leading battery life, free topographical maps, and satellite imagery, the 67i helps smooth out bumps in backcountry navigation. Multiband GNSS technology gives the 67i more satellites and more signals to choose from, so you get fast and accurate positioning data, all over the globe. The free Garmin Explore™ app lets you plan trips on your computer, tablet, or phone. Once you're ready to start, send planned routes and tracks to your 67i, no cell network required, and it won’t cost you a thing.

  • Preloaded with routable TopoActive maps (Canada and US 100K resolution), featuring streets and trails
  • Multiband and multifrequency signal reception and expanded GNSS support (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS and IRNSS) has access to more satellites and more signals, this provides faster, more accurate positioning and elevation data, anywhere in the world
  • Point of interest navigation lets you search for places you may want to go, e.g., restaurants, attractions, accommodation, etc
  • Connects via Bluetooth to phones/tablets running the free inReach Messenger® app. When paired with the Messenger app you gain access to your phone’s keyboard, contacts and group text capabilities
  • Smart network switching technology sends and receives your messages via the most reliable available network, helping ensure your messages get though, and you only use your satellite subscription when you need it
  • Messages have your GPS location embedded, letting your rescuers, friends, family or followers know exactly where you are
  • GPS tracking feature allows your friends and community to follow your progress via a personalized MapShare® page
  • LiveTrack™ during activities (through a connected smartphone) shares your location with friends
  • GroupTrack displays the location and telemetry of up to 50 contacts with compatible Garmin devices
  • Active weather provides real-time radar tracking (via a connected phone running Garmin Connect)
  • World coverage SOS feature gives you a confirmation message from the International Emergency Response Coordination Center (IERCC) if you use it to send an SOS. 2-way texting allows you to stay in contact with rescue personnel
  • SOS messages are received by IERCC, a worldwide emergency response coordination center with 24/7/365 staffing
  • SOS button has a hard plastic cover, greatly reducing chances of an accidental activation
  • Uses Iridium’s constellation of 66 satellites for coverage of the earth's entire surface. Messages are buffered for up to a day
  • Iridium’s worldwide coverage lets you send texts and emails from anywhere in the world. Your plan determines how many you can send and how detailed they are. Note – some jurisdictions regulate or prohibit the use of satellite communication devices
  • SOS/PLB functionality and all off-grid communication requires a separate satellite plan to activate, GPS functionality works all the time, no plan required
  • Monthly plans are available, as well as seasonal hibernation options that allow you to pay a minimal fee during months when you are not using the device
  • Garmin Explore website and app let you sync routes, tracks and waypoints to your device. You can download map data to your phone, use your phone to plan routes and tracks, and then send those plans to your GPS, all without cell reception
  • Satellite caching saves an extended predicted orbit path (EPO) file, so it knows where to look for satellites when you turn it on
  • Barometric altimeter tracks ascents, descents and total elevation changes
  • Tilt-compensated 3-axis electronic compass shows your heading even when you're stationary
  • Extended battery life, with multiple different GPS modes let you find the perfect balance of battery life and GPS accuracy
  • Internal Lithium-ion rechargeable battery provides up to 165 hours of battery life in GPS mode and more than 2 weeks in inReach enabled Expedition mode
  • 3in. colour screen is bright and clear even direct sun
  • 16GB internal memory can be increased via MicroSD cards (not included)
  • IPX7 waterproofing
  • Built-in LED flashlight has S.O.S setting
  • In the box: GPSMAP 67i preloaded with 100K TOPO Canada and US maps, USB cable (A-C), carabiner clip, and documentation

description: Reinhold Messner: My Life at the Limit is a conversation between Messner and interviewer Thomas Hüetlin, an award-winning German journalist. Readers learn about Messner’s childhood, his thoughts about eating ice cream with girls (against), politics (mostly liberal), and his technique for killing chickens (sharp scissors).<br><br>Messner is known as one of history’s greatest Himalayan mountaineers, a man who pushed back the frontiers of the possible for a whole generation of climbers. description: Campfire Stories Deck is a collection of 50 cards with storytelling prompts to help people of all ages find engaging and meaningful ways to connect with family and friends. The cadence and authenticity of personal stories can help us reveal ourselves, allay fears, bring comfort, and pass the time. For example, "Tell a story about a time when you left something behind" might lead to a tale about a teddy bear, favorite shirt, well-worn book, or grandmother’s ring. Many of the deck’s prompts look to nature for inspiration: "Tell a story about your first visit to a national park"--or your first time in a tent, first encounter with a wild animal, or favorite beach experience. People dream of their next adventures by reminiscing about past ones, and these cards help bring those memories--and rich stories--to light, whether around a candlelit dinner table or under the stars. description: Winner of the Banff Mountain Book Competition: Climbing Literature Award<br><br>The first English-language biography of one of the most renowned Italian climbers, Emilio Comici, who bagged over 200 first ascents in the Eastern Alps prior to his death at 39 years of age in 1940.<br><br>Between 1925 and his death in 1940, Emilio Comici was the pre-eminent climber in the Eastern Alps, the hotbed of global rock climbing at that time. He made first ascents on some of the highest and most notorious walls in the Alps, including the northwest face of the Civetta, as well as dozens of other climbs.<br><br>Comici invented many modern big-wall techniques and the big-wall idiom itself that later took root in Yosemite Valley. Comici also made solo ascents of some of the hardest routes in the Alps, including his climb on the north face of the Cima Grande. He also designed the first artificial climbing wall that was ever actually built.<br><br>This book explores how family tragedy and growing up in working class Trieste under Austrian occupation shaped Comici’s complex personality and attitudes toward climbing. He was loyal to his friends, deeply concerned about the vulnerable, including his fellow climbers, and yet highly competitive, a born vagabond and yet also a dandy, irresistible to women, and yet unable to settle down, devoted to his mother and to the mountains, and finally, like many other Italian climbers of the period, a member of the Italian fascist party although he was profoundly anti-German and opposed to racial persecution.
title: Emilio Comici: Angel of the Dolomites

description: Explore the natural glory of hot springs with the updated 4th edition of Hot Springs of Western Canada.<br><br>Hot springs are among western Canada’s most enjoyable attractions. description: The hunt for powder is now on: The Tigard 110 Unisex ski touring boot is an aggressive, technical high-end Alpine Tech Boot for maximum downhill performance on- and off piste. Fast as a snow leopard and strong as a tiger, the Tigard 110 bootcombines Free Touring and Alpine skiing. The boot is the ultimate partner for all downhill-oriented athletes. It is compatible with not only frame bindings, but also tech and alpine bindings. <br><br>Thanks to its low weight of just 1,550 grams and a cuff rotation of 70 degrees for extraordinary freedom of movement, you can easily conquer several hundred meters of vert – and will be the first one to drop into the perfect line, guaranteed! This boot features the patented Hoji Lock System that merges the cuff and shell on the inside of the boot into one completely interlocking unit without any play. The unique Grilamid material with fiberglass offers great rigidity at a progressive flex of 110. <br><br>All of its features make the Tigard 110 the perfect companion so that you can fully enjoy your well-earned downhill. With a last width of 101 mm, the Power Strap and four micro-adjustable buckles hold the foot snugly in place. The ski-walk mechanism is connected by a technically clever cable system that combines the uppermost buckle and the Power Strap. With just one hand motion, you can transition between uphill and downhill. <br><br>In downhill mode, the Tigard 110 locks out at a max forward lean of 13 degrees, offering you a comfortable, yet still athletic and controlled ski position – whether you are pressing, carving or slashing. The Tigard is the first boot in the DYNAFIT collection that integrates Overlap construction. This guarantees the foot is enveloped perfectly for precision skiing and direct power transfer. Compared to alpine ski boots, entry is significantly easier with its Easy Entry features. <br><br>To ensure you make your way safely over rocks and icy flanks to your line, the Tigard 110 is equipped with the new sturdy, long-lasting Gripwalk sole. This offers perfect grip and ideal traction when walking out of the binding. To lend even more safety on tour, the Tigard is also compatible with fully automatic crampons. An additional special feature of the Tigard 110 is the optional thermo-moldable Dynafitter 15 boot liner. Thanks to PrimaLoft, your feet stay comfy even in icy temperatures. <br><br>At the same time, the liner lends the highest comfort and rigidity at a light weight. As with all DYNAFIT ski touring boots, the Tigard is made by hand in Italy’s Montebelluna.

description:
The Fieldsheer® powered by Mobile Warming® heating technology Backcountry Men's Heated Vest is their new synthetic down puffer Heated Vest available in 2 color options and featuring a new low-profile 7.4-volt battery. With a Waterpell™ water-resistant nylon outer shell, and at its core, our tried and true Mobile Warming® 7.4-volt heating system is enhanced with Primaloft® synthetic down insulation. Primaloft® is a down alternative made from recycled materials into ultra-fine insulative fibers.

The Backcountry is stylish enough to wear on its own during day-to-day use, but light and amply compressible to also wear as a base layer under your favorite rain or snow Heated Vest. The Backcountry 7.4-volt heating system can provide heating temperatures ranging from 135°F on high to 90°F on low. On high, expect up to 2+ hours of heat, and on low it can heat up to 10 hours! Temperature control is simple with 2 ways to adjust the heat. First, the built-in waterproof touch control button. With a simple button push, it lets you choose from 4 instant heat settings with multi-colored LED indicator. Plus, we’ve incorporated Bluetooth® control with our proprietary, free to download via App Store® or Google Play Store®, MW Connect™ app. Through the free MW Connect™ app, you can quickly toggle through all connected Fieldsheer® powered by Mobile Warming® technology garments and adjust individual heat levels to your liking. MW Connect™ app allows you to get real-time updates on battery levels and update your garments when new firmware becomes available. The Backcountry comes as a complete package with a 7.4-volt battery, charger, and stow bag. The Backcountry provides instant heat when the weather turns cold, keeping you outdoors and enjoying your favorite activity.

The Backcountry Heated Vest is powered by our Powersheer™ 7.4-volt Rechargeable Lithium-Ion Battery (7.4V 2200mAh) – Reliable power in a compact streamlined package. The Universal Micro USB (5V@2A) to USB cable allows for convenient charging anywhere you go. The 7.4V DC output port is compatible with all of our 7.4V heated gear.

description:
Modern styling, light and multifunctional – the Blueridge Low ES is a lightweight hiking shoe for a range of uses, loaded with innovative sustainability features. description:
Their lightest and most breathable midlayer.

This extremely lightweight fleece jacket is developed for ski touring, but is also great for general outdoor activities, especially mid to high-intensity, due to its excellent breathing and insulation properties.

The jacket is made in two premium fleece fabrics: Polartec Alpha and the lightest warm1. The Alpha provides excellent insulation and breathability, and the warm1 pulls moisture from the skin and transfers it to the outer surface to dissipate quickly.

The Alpha fabric is a highly open-knit recycled Polartec® Alpha® 90 (90 grams/m2), which offers consistent warmth while continuously releasing excess body heat and allowing excellent breathability during activity, both the "stop" and "go" phases. This fabric is used on the upper body and arms.

The lightweight warm1 fabric is a 103 g/m2 (94% recycled polyester, 6% elastane) advanced next-to-skin moisture management fabric using a bi-component knit construction for maximum efficiency. This fabric is placed on the lower torso and under the arms. Together, they make for a highly open and moisture-efficient structure, and the jacket works perfectly as a baselayer.

Key features include: A small chest pocket, elastic cuffs with thumbholes, and a high collar for extra comfort protection.

description:
The Makra Light GTX from Hanwag’s Makra family is an agile all-rounder in the ideal height for via ferratas and straightforward alpine tours. And it’s very versatile too. Because footwear to see you safely over iron pins, ladder rungs and rocky ledges has to be particularly solid to be able to withstand the constant loading. At the same time, it has to provide the wearer with a good ‘feel’ for the terrain underfoot. And if it’s going to be comfortable going uphill and downhill, then it has to be built on a well cushioned base that promotes good roll-off performance.

But that’s not all the mid-cut Makra Light GTX can do. It’s designed for mountain enthusiasts who appreciate the benefits of a low-cut model on the ascents but are unwilling to do away with the additional stability offered by a mid-cut design on the descents. By incorporating a special 2-zone lacing system with mechanical lace lock system, the upper is easily adapted to the demands of the terrain in question. Unlike conventional clamping lace hooks, this mechanical style of lace lock won’t slip once it’s locked in place – it requires manual intervention to unlock it.

This makes it possible to have tighter lacing at the ankle and more relaxed lacing at the upper section of the boot, for instance, for greater freedom of movement on ascents or when climbing. While on the descents, the entire lacing can be locked down above the ankle too, for greater stability. In addition to a flexible, adjustable upper, the Makra Light GTX also has a particularly lightweight, cushioning midsole that provides the stability required for demanding terrain.

*** All Hanwag boots are sold under UK sizing - Please see size chart for details/conversion
title: HanWag Makra Light GTX - Mens

description: From Canada’s most accomplished adventurer and storyteller comes a gripping journey into the vastness of Canada’s landscape and history.<br><br>Looking out his porch window one spring morning, Adam Shoalts spotted a majestic peregrine falcon flying across the neighbouring fields near Lake Erie. Each spring, falcons migrate from southernmost Canada to remote arctic mountains. Grabbing his backpack and canoe, Shoalts resolved to follow the falcon’s route north on an astonishing 3,400-kilometre journey to the Arctic.<br><br>Along the way, he faces a huge variety of challenges and obstacles, including storms on the Great Lakes, finding campsites in the urban wilderness of Toronto and Montreal, avoiding busy commercial freighter traffic, gale force winds, massive hydroelectric dams, bushwhacking without trails, dealing with hunger, multiple bear encounters, and navigating white-water rapids on icy northern rivers far from any help.<br><br>In his signature style, Shoalts roams as much across space as he does time, winding his way through a stunning diversity of landscapes ranging from lush Carolinian forests to lonely windswept mountains, salty seas to trackless swamps, pristine lakes to glittering mega-cities, as well as the sites of long ago battles, shipwrecks, forgotten forts, and abandoned trading posts. Through his travels, he reveals how interconnected wild places are, from the loneliest depths of the northern wilderness to busy urban parks, and the vital importance of these connections.<br><br>Where the Falcon Flies invites readers on an extraordinary armchair adventure that spans five ecoregions and centuries of fascinating history, and is a masterwork by one of Canada’s most successful and audacious authors.<br>

description: The hunt for powder is now on: The Tigard 130 Unisex ski touring boot is an aggressive, technical high-end Alpine Tech Boot for maximum downhill performance on- and off piste. Fast as a snow leopard and strong as a tiger, the Tigard 130 boot combines Free Touring and Alpine skiing. The boot is the ultimate partner for all downhill-oriented athletes. It is compatible with not only frame bindings, but also tech and alpine bindings. Thanks to its low weight of just 1,550 grams and a cuff rotation of 70 degrees for extraordinary freedom of movement, you can easily conquer several hundred meters of vert – and will be the first one to drop into the perfect line, guaranteed! This boot features the patented Hoji Lock System that merges the cuff and shell on the inside of the boot into one completely interlocking unit without any play. The unique Grilamid material with carbon fibers offers very high rigidity with a progressive flex of 130 so you can enjoy your well-earned downhill to the fullest. With a last width of 101 mm, the Power Strap and four micro-adjustable buckles hold the foot snugly in place. The ski-walk mechanism is connected by a technically clever cable system that combines the uppermost buckle and the Power Strap. With just one hand motion, you can transition between uphill and downhill. In downhill mode, the Tigard 130 locks out at a max forward lean of 13 degrees, offering you a comfortable, yet still athletic and controlled ski position – whether you are pressing, carving or slashing. <br><br>The Tigard is the first boot in the DYNAFIT collection that integrates Overlap construction. This guarantees the foot is enveloped perfectly for precision skiing and direct power transfer. Compared to alpine ski boots, entry is significantly easier with its Easy Entry features. To ensure you make your way safely over rocks and icy flanks to your line, the Tigard 130 is equipped with a sturdy, long-lasting Gripwalk sole. This offers perfect grip and ideal traction when walking out of the binding. To lend even more safety on tour, the Tigard is also compatible with fully automatic crampons. An additional special feature of the Tigard 130 is the optional thermo-moldable Dynafitter 15 boot liner. Thanks to PrimaLoft, your feet stay comfy even in icy temperatures. At the same time, the liner lends the highest comfort and rigidity at a light weight. As with all DYNAFIT ski touring boots, the Tigard is made by hand in Italy’s Montebelluna and includes a lifetime guarantee. Tigard 130 – First up. First down.<br>

description: All across the country, food processors, grocers, restaurants, and regular folks throw away perfectly edible food. However, the good news is that it’s easy to reduce waste—while saving money and eating healthier too!<br><br>Scraps, Peels, and Stems is a comprehensive and accessible guide to how you can reduce food waste in your daily life. Food journalist Jill Lightner shows how to manage your kitchen for less waste through practical strategies, tips, and advice on food purchasing, prep, composting, and storage. From beef bones, Parmesan rinds, and broccoli stems to bruised apples and party leftovers, Jill explains what to do with unused food, and how to avoid the extras in the first place. With attitude, a sense of humor, and the acceptance that none of us are perfect, Jill helps all of us understand some of the larger social, economic, environmental, and agricultural issues around food and its exorbitant waste. Topics and features include:<br>70+ recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, and drinks as well as items for your pantryMoney-saving tips throughoutThree levels of action for every topic, to help you figure out what’s doableComposting and recycling tipsPortioning to avoid leftovers on the plateMeal planning vs. freestyle cookingGrocery shopping and dining-out tacticsStorage strategies for small, urban kitchens—and how to read expiration datesInsight into “nose to tail” and “root to stem” cooking trends Through clear advice, quick tips, useful techniques, and easy recipes,Scraps, Peels, and Stems shows how, by looking at the food waste we encounter in our daily lives, we can save money and make a difference.

description: Choose a brighter future with the more sustainable Terra Expedition S - made from hemp and recycled plastics. The Terra Expedition S is your preferred choice of you need a mirror sighting compass with many features. It is high performing when it comes to accuracy, precision and durability and is developed for experienced users and professionals.<br><br>Terra Expedition S belongs to Silva Terra: a product series made of recycled materials with 90% less carbon emissions. The lid, grip ring and graduation ring on Terra Expedition S are made of REVO material.<br><br>If the terrain demands for a mirror sighting compass Expedition S is your optimal companion. SILVA Expedition S features easy-handling housing, silicon rubber feet for precision map work, detachable safety-release scale lanyard, night-enabling luminous markings, magnifying lens, map-measuring scales in mm or inches, 1:25,000, 1:50,000 and GPS scales – plus built-in adjuster for magnetic declination (including permanent local adjustment). The Expedition S can also map-measure 1:40,000 and it comes with a clinometer for measuring slope angle and 45-degree angle assistance on the mirror-sighting function.<br><br>This compass features a mirror that allows you to view the compass dial and the background at the same time. The fact that the compass dial can be seen at the same time the reference point is aligned makes mirror compasses more desirable for taking accurate bearings. A mirror-sighting compass is at its best in open terrain where you must determine direction over long distances.<br><br>The slope card is great both for detecting avalanche risk and for determining how challenging your journey will be. By knowing the slope you can also judge any extra distance that you need to go due to the slope. Always take caution in steep terrain. The risk of avalanches increase if the slope is steeper than 30 degrees. The slope card will help you detect this risk.<br><br>This compass model is equipped with a detachable scale lanyard made of recycled PET, that works like a ruler. The scale lanyard has two scales on it; 1:25, and 1:50, which makes it easier to measure the distance of your hike. Since its soft and bendable it’s easy to place directly on to your route on the map when you are out in the terrain – or when you are planning for your next adventure<br><br>SILVA TERRA – REUSE, REDUCE, RECYCLE<br><br>Terra means Earth, and products labelled Silva Terra have lower environmental footprint. description: With over one hundred full-color photographs comes a harrowing portrait of Canada’s most devastating wildfire season ever, the effects of which could be felt and seen across the world.<br><br>“All hell has broken loose.” That’s the phrase some fire officials use to describe the unprecedented 2023 wildfire season in Canada. Never before has the vast and rugged beauty of this country been ravaged by as many devastating wildfires. Never before have the fires been this big or moved this fast. Choking smoke blanketed the continent, including the United States, putting millions of people under air quality advisories, and even traveled as far as Norway.<br><br>The wildfire season started in the spring with most provinces and territories facing a drought. In early May, many parts of Canada grappled with a record-breaking number of fires. By the end of August, wildfires had devoured more than 15 million hectares (37 million acres) of Canadian forest—more than six times the average usually lost to fire. Provinces such as British Columbia and Nova Scotia experienced their largest wildfires ever. Quebec, Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Northwest Territories battled their most destructive wildfires ever.<br><br>Tens of thousands of Canadians—from coast to coast to coast—were chased from their homes by flames or the threat of flames, seeking shelter in evacuation centers across the country. People from Halifax, Yellowknife, Kelowna, Shuswap, and many other communities survived harrowing escapes along flame-lined roads, with embers raining down upon them. Thousands of firefighters from Canada and around the world risked their lives to battle the blazes, which already numbered almost 6,000 by the end of August. Four firefighters lost their lives doing so.<br><br>The Summer Canada Burned tells the dramatic story of Canada’s wildfires in 2023—a story that provides a case study of the changing climate and its impacts on our environment. It reflects evolving attitudes about approaches to wildfires and the role all people can play in prevention. Most importantly, however, the story of Canada’s wildfires is a story of loss and of survival. From the ashes, people rise, communities rebuild and seeds of new growth sprout.<br><br>A share of the sales from the book will be donated to the Canadian Red Cross.
title: The Summer Canada Burned
